company: BANDAI NAMCO ENTERTAINMENT ASIA PTE. LTD.
title: Localization Project Coordinator (Thai)
description:
Company Overview

As part of Bandai Namco Holdings Inc., a global leader in video games, toys, and amusement parks, Bandai Namco Entertainment Asia (BNE Asia) is a top publisher and distributor of PC and console games across Asia. We bring beloved titles like Elden Ring™, Tekken™, PAC-MAN™, and Little Nightmares™ to fans across the region.

We are united by our purpose: “Fun for all into the Future.” We aim to deliver quality entertainment experiences and connect fans both digitally and physically through unique IPs that only Bandai Namco can offer.

Job Purpose

The Localization Project Coordinator (Thai) is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, tracking and quality review of Thai localization and LQA projects across assigned titles and content scopes.

The role works closely with the Localization Manager, internal project teams, external translation vendors and LQA vendors to ensure timely delivery, linguistic consistency, clear documentation and continuous improvement of Thai localization quality.

This position will be responsible for seamlessly managing all localization and LQA activities for assigned titles, serving as the primary point of coordination across internal stakeholders, vendors, and QA teams. Responsibilities include project planning and execution, vendor management, linguistic quality oversight, issue tracking, reporting, knowledge-base maintenance, and ensuring timely delivery of localization milestones. Final budget, vendor, project, and commercial approval authority will remain with the Localization Manager and/or designated internal approver.

Why This Role Matters


This role supports BNEAS in building a scalable Thai localization model by strengthening vendor coordination, improving linguistic consistency, maintaining title-specific language assets, and ensuring knowledge continuity across projects and vendors. The role is important in reducing dependency on individual translators and supporting smoother vendor transition, project hand over and business continuity.

Key Responsibilities

1. Localization Coordination

  • Support localization projects across assigned titles, including planning support, task tracking, delivery follow-up and coordination with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Track project milestones, dependencies, risks, open issues and pending decisions, and escalate delays or quality concerns to the Localization Manager in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate project requests and workflows using memoQ and/or other CAT tools, TMS platforms or internal tracking tools, where applicable.
  • Support delivery alignment across translation, LQA, internal review and final submission stages.
  • Ensure translated materials and related deliverables are coordinated accurately and delivered according to agreed timelines.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for localization processes, tools, and workflows, including the evaluation and implementation of automation and AI-assisted solutions where appropriate.

2. Vendor Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate day-to-day communication with Thai translation and LQA vendors, including project briefing, query handling, delivery follow-up, issue tracking and feedback consolidation.
  • Brief vendors on project scope, schedule, source materials, style requirements, terminology expectations, delivery format and quality requirements.
  • Act as the day-to-day contact point for vendor queries and consolidate questions for internal clarification where required.
  • Maintain vendor communication records, open issue logs and action trackers to ensure clear follow-up and timely resolution.
  • Provide structured feedback to vendors and escalate quality, schedule, scope or delivery risks to the Localization Manager for decision-making.

3. Thai Linguistic Quality Review

  • Conduct Thai linguistic spot checks on vendor deliverables to review terminology, tone, consistency, cultural appropriateness, text accuracy and adherence to project guidelines.
  • Review translated content from vendors, including translation and LQA deliverables, to identify recurring linguistic or quality issues.
  • Provide practical and structured linguistic feedback to vendors to support quality improvement and calibration.
  • Recommend Thai linguistic acceptance or rejection for review by the Localization Manager, where required.
  • Support quality calibration with LQA vendors and internal stakeholders to improve consistency across titles and content types.

4. Localization Knowledge Base & Language Asset Management

  • Build and maintain Thai localization knowledge assets, including title-specific glossaries, translation memories, style guides, terminology notes, character/IP-specific translation rules and recurring issue logs.
  • Compile title-specific translation tips, vendor handover notes and project learning points to support continuity across vendors, projects and internal team changes.
  • Maintain and update Thai terminology references to ensure consistency across different documents, content types and project phases.
  • Support proper documentation of Thai language decisions, approved terminology and localization guidelines for future reference.
  • Assist in identifying gaps in existing language assets and recommend improvements to strengthen localization quality and efficiency.

5. Weekly Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare weekly Thai localization progress reports for the Localization Manager / BNEAS localization team, covering project status, vendor progress, key risks, quality issues, pending decisions and next actions.
  • Prepare post-project summaries, issue trends, quality observations and improvement recommendations to support future localization planning.
  • Document recurring vendor, process or quality issues and propose practical workflow improvements.
  • Support the development and maintenance of localization guidelines, best practices, reporting templates and project tracking documents.

6. Schedule and Cost Tracking Support

  • Track localization and LQA schedules, delivery milestones and vendor submission status, and highlight risks to the Localization Manager and relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Support cost tracking by maintaining records of vendor quotations, purchase requests, invoices and approved budget references, where applicable.
  • Coordinate with the Localization Manager and designated internal approvers on cost reporting, project status and required follow-up actions.
  • Monitor potential schedule or cost risks and provide timely updates; however, budget ownership, vendor commercial negotiation and approval authority remain with the Localization Manager and/or designated internal approver.

7. LQA Coordination Support

  • Support LQA coordination for all localized content, including issue follow-up, bug and defect clarification, vendor query management, and status tracking across assigned languages, including but not limited to Thai, Bahasa Indonesia, English, and other languages as required.
  • Assist in checking localized content for language-related issues, inconsistencies or terminology deviations during LQA review stages.
  • Coordinate with internal QA/LQA stakeholders and vendors on Thai language-related issues within the agreed project scope.
  • Support LQA reporting and quality feedback documentation for assigned Thai localization projects.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferably in Translation, Linguistics, Communications, Game Studies, Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the gaming industry, including at least 3 to 5 years in game localization, LQA, localization project coordination, translation project management or vendor coordination.
  • Experience working with external localization, translation or LQA vendors, including query handling, delivery tracking, feedback consolidation and issue escalation.
  • Experience supporting launched game titles or live/ongoing game localization projects will be an advantage.
  • Prior experience in PC, console, mobile game, entertainment, media or digital content localization will be highly relevant.

Language Skills

  • Professional fluency in Thai, with strong written and spoken proficiency and the ability to review Thai localization for tone, terminology, style, cultural appropriateness, consistency and player-facing language quality.
  • Strong professional proficiency in English for daily communication, reporting, documentation and coordination with regional stakeholders.
  • Professional proficiency in Japanese for regular communication and coordination with Japan-based stakeholders, including clarification of localization requirements, source content, terminology, cultural nuances, project queries and linguistic quality issues. JLPT N2 or equivalent proficiency is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with CAT tools, TMS or localization platforms such as memoQ, XLOC or equivalent systems.
  • Ability to manage translation memories, glossaries, terminology lists, issue trackers and project documentation accurately.
  • Familiarity with video game consoles. Able to maneuver and use debug functions.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel, Copilot, Word and PowerPoint, for reporting, tracking and documentation.
  • Good understanding of game localization workflows, LQA processes, vendor coordination, issue tracking and delivery management.


Business & Functional Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Asian and Western gaming markets, player expectations, cultural sensitivities and game localization requirements.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple projects, schedules, stakeholders and vendors while maintaining quality and documentation discipline.
  • Ability to translate localization requirements into clear vendor instructions, action trackers and follow-up items.
  • Strong project tracking capability, including timelines, dependencies, risks, open issues and escalation points.
  • Ability to identify linguistic quality risks and provide practical feedback for improvement.


Behavioral Attributes

  • Meticulous, organised and highly attentive to detail.
  • Strong ownership and follow-through on assigned tasks, open issues and project deliverables.
  • Clear, respectful and professional communication style with both internal stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Able to manage multiple deadlines and priorities, especially during peak release or submission periods.
  • Proactive in documenting knowledge, improving workflows and supporting team continuity.
  • Able to work independently in an offsite arrangement while maintaining regular communication and reporting discipline.
  • Team player with a constructive, service-oriented and problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

This role requires relevant experience in game localization, LQA, localization project coordination, vendor communication and Thai linguistic quality review, together with strong attention to detail and project management skills.

Relevant experience includes coordinating with external localization and LQA vendors, reviewing Thai-language content for accuracy, terminology, tone and consistency, maintaining glossaries and translation memories, preparing project status reports, and tracking project issues, risks and deliverables.

Knowledge of game localization workflows, LQA processes, title-specific terminology and language assets, and experience working with cross-functional and regional stakeholders would be advantageous. Familiarity with Asian and Western gaming markets, player expectations and localization quality standards would also be relevant to the role.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with well-loved Bandai Namco IPs and major PC/console game titles across Asia.
  • Exposure to regional localization workflows, external vendor coordination, LQA processes, and cross-market project communication.
  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of Thai localisation standards, glossaries, style guides, and title-specific knowledge assets.
  • A collaborative regional working environment with stakeholders across BNEAS and external localisation/LQA partners.

title: 2027 Analytics & Sales Graduate Programme (Thai speaker), Singapore
description:
The Analytics & Sales Program offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in financial markets, Bloomberg technology, and client engagement while developing a foundation for a long-term career within Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business. 

You will begin your career in Analytics, where you'll work directly with Bloomberg Professional Services clients across the global financial community. In our Analytics business, you will provide 24/7 support to Bloomberg users around the world and across multiple industries. Through Instant Bloomberg (IB) chat, you'll answer client questions, solve complex workflow challenges, and help clients maximize the value of Bloomberg's products and solutions.  

On any given day, our teams respond to tens of thousands of client inquiries in over 15 languages. From helping portfolio managers analyze risk to supporting traders as they uncover new sources of market liquidity, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of financial workflows while developing deep product, market, and client expertise.  

As Bloomberg continues to innovate, you'll partner with clients to introduce new products, deliver training, support onboarding and product rollouts, and help organizations utilize technology more effectively. You'll also collaborate closely with Sales teams on strategic client initiatives, building the skills and relationship management capabilities that prepare you for future opportunities across Financial Solutions. 

As your expertise grows, you'll have the opportunity to progress into Sales, the most common career path within the program. In Sales, you'll become a trusted advisor to clients, building long-term relationships, understanding business goals and workflows, and identifying opportunities to deliver Bloomberg solutions while driving business growth. 

What's In It for You? 

Industry-Leading Training 

From day one, you'll participate in one of the industry's most comprehensive training programs, building a foundation in financial markets, asset classes, Bloomberg technology, and client workflows.  

Client Exposure from Day One 

After training, you'll join one of our Analytics teams, where you'll continue learning through hands-on client exposure, mentorship, and specialized asset class and workflow training. Every client interaction is an opportunity to deepen your expertise, develop your problem-solving skills, and build confidence as a trusted advisor. 

Long-Term Career Growth 

The Analytics & Sales Program is designed to accelerate your professional development.  As your knowledge and experience grow, so do your opportunities. Most participants progress into Sales, where they build long-term client relationships and drive business growth, while others pursue specialist client-facing, product or leadership roles across Bloomberg's Financial Solutions business. 

Who You Are 

You are intellectually curious, client-focused, and energized by financial markets. You enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and understanding the drivers behind market-moving events. A strong communicator and relationship builder, you thrive in fast-paced environments, are passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, and are motivated to build a long-term career helping clients solve challenges and achieve their business goals. 

You’ll need to have: 

  • Bachelor's degree (or above) and the ability to start a full-time role in 2027 (Candidates graduating by July 2027 are welcome to apply) 
  • Up to 3 years of work experience 
  • Professional fluency in English and Thai (written and spoken), as the role requires regular communication and support business activities conducted in Thai.
  • Demonstrated academic coursework or work experience in financial markets, economics or fintech 
  • Experience in customer service roles (interacting with both internal and external clients) 
  • Experience with client interaction in sales or account management capacity 
  • Strong multitasking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
  • Interest in innovative technologies and their potential to enhance workflows and efficiencies. 
  • Flexibility to occasionally work weekends or on bank/public/federal holiday (weekday off in lieu). 

We’d love to see: 

  • Demonstrated practical exposure to Python or other coding languages preferably. 
  • Beginner to intermediate experience with Excel and/or Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) 
  • With 1-3 years of full-time work experience in the financial market or financial services industry, or in client-facing/relationship management/sales/consulting role 

This is a future opportunity for our 2027 graduate hiring program. 

AI tools can be useful for interview preparation and research. Use them to brainstorm practice questions, refine a study plan, or simulate a role play. During the interview, however, we ask that your responses reflect your own experiences, judgment, critical thinking, and communication skills, and that you do not use AI tools at any point during the interview process. This helps us accurately assess your skills and potential, while also ensuring a fair and consistent experience for all candidates. 

If this sounds like you: 

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime feel free to have a look at:  

https://www.bloomberg.com/company 

Learn more about our office and benefits: 

Singapore | www.bloomberg.com/singapore 

Bloomberg is committed to improving the communities, cities and countries in which we work, and we support various initiatives including hiring and developing local talent. So, we may prioritize candidates with legal authorization to work full-time in Singapore for this role, who do not require Bloomberg to sponsor their work authorization.

title: Product Deployment Engineer, gTech Ads (English, Bahasa or Thai) - Singapore
description:
Product area

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

Job description

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for  customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our  customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

Additional job description

As a Product Deployment Engineer, you will be a key advisor to Google’s customers and serve as the definitive regional service authority for a specific product area. You are the strategic bridge between “what a customer wants” and “what gTech Ads has to offer” within a specific product area, whether via the standing Menu of Service (MoS) or our gTech Ads engineering capabilities.

Application Instructions: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Qualifications

Job responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales and Engagement Managers to understand customer marketing objectives, infrastructure and first-party data management strategy, and pain points.
  • Lead deep-dive technical assessment/consultation sessions to uncover opportunities where bespoke solutions are required, ensuring solutions respect industry-specific data constraints and business cycles.
  • Translate complex customer requirements into clear technical specifications and solution designs, considering scalability, reusability, and best practices as well as a clear path to media activation.
  • Provide technical-product oversight during the implementation phase, ensuring the engineering build remains aligned with the original customer strategy, while deferring base code-level and system-building decisions to the Engineering team.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional gTech teams (e.g., Engineering teams, Solution Experts, Measurement Experts) to orchestrate bundled service delivery and ensure seamless customer outcomes.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
  • Experience in technical project management, stakeholder management, professional services, solution engineering, or technical consulting.
  • Experience in building proof-of-concepts using web/scripting technologies (e.g., JavaScript, Python, etc.) and SQL databases.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Thai or Bahasa Indoneisa fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working with Google Ads, Google Marketing Platform products (e.g., SA360, DV360, GA4), or Google Cloud services.
  • Expertise in one of the three core product pillars: Search+, YouTube+, or Measurement and Platforms.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

title: General Manager
description:
We are seeking a high-energy, experienced to oversee the operations of our three Thai restaurant outlets. You will be responsible for maintaining the authenticity of our brand, ensuring consistent food quality across all locations, and driving profitability. The ideal candidate balances a "boots-on-the-ground" leadership style with high-level strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities

1. Operational Excellence & Quality Control

  • Conduct regular site visits to all three locations to ensure brand standards, service speed, and Thai hospitality are consistent.

  • Enforce strict food safety and sanitation protocols (HACCP/Local Health Dept standards).

  • Coordinate with Head Chefs to ensure recipe adherence and ingredient consistency.

2. Financial Management

  • Oversee P&L for all outlets; manage labor costs, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), and wastage.

  • Develop and implement local marketing strategies to drive foot traffic and delivery sales.

  • Monitor inventory levels and negotiate with suppliers for bulk-buy discounts across the group.

3. People & Leadership

  • Recruit, train, and mentor Restaurant Managers for each outlet.

  • Foster a positive work culture that celebrates Thai culture and excellent customer service.

  • Manage scheduling and performance reviews for senior staff.

4. Customer Experience

  • Monitor online reviews and guest feedback, implementing corrective actions when necessary.

  • Ensure the physical environment (decor, music, lighting) reflects our brand identity at every location.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years in a Multi-Unit Manager or Area Manager role within the F&B industry.

  • Cuisine Knowledge: Strong familiarity with Thai cuisine and service culture is highly preferred.

  • Business Acumen: Deep understanding of restaurant financial reporting and KPI tracking.

  • Logistics: Ability to travel frequently between the three outlets.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent conflict resolution skills and the ability to lead diverse teams.

title: CCP for Digital Advertising and Marketing Professionals
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Tiger Muay Thai Singapore operates combat-sports and fitness outlets serving adults, women, kids and sparring programmes. The company is planning to build a separate brand, Tiger Fitness, and a franchising model in 2027. The Digital Advertising & Marketing Manager will own the digital funnel from awareness to trial sign-up to membership conversion, and will lead digital strategy, budget and results across all outlets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Plan the annual and quarterly digital marketing strategy, channel mix and campaign calendar for all outlets and programmes

- Plan, launch and optimise paid social advertising on Meta and TikTok, including audiences, creative testing, retargeting and lead-generation campaigns

- Run Google search campaigns and drive local and on-page SEO, including Google Business Profile and review generation

- Plan content pillars and the monthly content calendar, including short-form video, copywriting, community management and influencer/ambassador collaborations

- Build and optimise landing pages and lead forms, and run A/B tests to improve conversion

- Design and run CRM and automation journeys (email, WhatsApp, SMS) for lead follow-up, trial conversion, retention and win-back

- Set up and maintain tracking and analytics (GA4, Tag Manager, UTM conventions, dashboards) and report performance to management monthly

- Manage the monthly advertising budget, reallocating spend based on cost per lead, cost per trial, customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend

- Be accountable, jointly with sales, for trial volume and lead-to-member conversion, and work with outlet teams to improve lead response time

- Brief and manage freelancers, creators, designers and agencies, and set vendor KPIs

- Plan and run marketing activations such as open houses, community events and corporate or ambassador collaborations

- Build marketing foundations for the planned separate brand and franchising model, including positioning, launch plans and replicable campaign playbooks

- Use generative AI and marketing tools to improve productivity, with a documented human review process

- Ensure all marketing complies with PDPA, platform ad policies and brand standards

- Document processes and SOPs for campaigns, tracking, reporting and content approvals

REQUIREMENTS

- Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident

- Professional, managerial or executive experience in a related field such as sales, customer experience, business consulting, operations, project or vendor management

- Strong customer insight, communication and commercial skills

- Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets and digital tools

- Experience coordinating vendors, freelancers or cross-functional teams

- Prior hands-on experience in digital advertising and marketing is not required. Full training is provided under the on-the-job training plan.

TRAINING AND SUPPORT

- 6-month structured on-the-job training with a designated mentor

- Daily check-ins in the first three months, weekly 1:1 coaching, fortnightly work reviews and monthly competency reviews

- Competency rubric (levels 1 to 4) scored monthly against the training competencies

- Formal mid-point assessment (Month 3) and final assessment (Month 6)

- Training on live campaigns with real budgets, and support to complete industry certifications (e.g. Google Ads, GA4, Meta Blueprint)

EXPECTED OUTCOMES

- By Month 6, independently plans, runs, optimises and reports on multi-channel campaigns

- Owns the advertising budget and manages external resources

- Completes at least 2 industry certifications

- Delivers measurable improvement against Month 1 baselines, with targets agreed with management (e.g. lower cost per trial lead, higher lead-to-trial and trial-to-member conversion, faster lead response)

- Delivers dashboards, SOPs and a brand and franchise-readiness marketing playbook

- Confirmed as a permanent team member after successful completion of the programme

company: KRUNG THAI BANK PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
title: Trade Finance Senior Officer
description:
The Bank is looking for a Trade Finance Senior Officer in the Trade Finance Department. This is a back-office function that handles end-to-end processing, document checking, settlement, compliance, and record-keeping for all trade products—strictly following regulatory compliance related to AML/CFT and bank policies and procedures.

Transaction Processing

  • Manage full lifecycle of LCs, SBLCs, guarantees, and documentary collections (issuance, advising, confirmation, amendment, transfer, claims, and discharge)
  • Process trade financing: negotiation, discounting, acceptance, pre/post-shipment finance, supply chain finance, trust receipts, and factoring
  • Execute cross-border and local remittances via SWIFT MT/MX formats; handle Nostro/Vostro settlements, interest/fee calculation, and booking
  • Administer accounts, process amendments/cancellations, and perform reconciliation with general ledgers

Document Examination

  • Review documents against UCP 600, ISBP, URC 522, and LC terms
  • Verify Bills of Lading, invoices, packing lists, insurance, and certificates for completeness and consistency
  • Identify discrepancies, resolve issues with customers/banks, and decide on acceptance or rejection

Compliance, Risk & Control

  • Conduct sanctions, AML, and anti-financial crime screening using tools like World-Check One
  • Review credit limits, facility validity, and collateral; flag high-risk and suspicious transactions
  • Comply with MAS regulations, OFAC/UN/EU sanctions, and internal controls; follow Maker/Checker workflows and maintain audit trails

SWIFT & System Operations

  • Prepare, verify, and authorize SWIFT messages; input transactions into core banking systems
  • Perform compliance and vessel/port checks; maintain secure digital/physical records and archives

Customer & Stakeholder Support

  • Advise corporate clients and correspondent banks on trade terms and procedures
  • Provide status updates, settlement confirmations, and coordinate with other department such as Compliance

Reporting

  • Resolve operational issues and follow up on outstanding items
  • Prepare management reports, support audits, regulatory submissions, and month-end closing
  • Assist in process updates, automation, and system UAT; perform other ad-hoc duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Diploma or higher in Banking, Finance, Business Administration, or related fields
  • Preferably 3+ years of hands-on core Trade Finance Operations experience in a bank or financial institution
  • Understand international trade rules, SWIFT MT/MX messaging, and compliance screening tools
  • High attention to detail, strong risk awareness, and ability to work efficiently to meet deadlines
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; capable of working independently and collaborating effectively within a team

title: Regulatory Affairs / Government Affairs Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Regulatory Affairs / Government Affairs Specialist to join our Singapore-based regional hub.

The successful candidate will be responsible for regulatory registration and compliance activities across assigned Southeast Asian markets, while also building and maintaining relationships with regulatory authorities and government agencies. Over time, and subject to performance and readiness, the candidate will take on increasing responsibility, including team leadership and strategic government engagement.

We are looking for someone with strong regulatory expertise, a developing network within regulatory authorities across the region, and the capability to eventually lead the RA function and serve as the company's primary interface with government agencies and policymakers.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Affairs

  • Lead end-to-end regulatory registration activities for Class C medical devices across assigned Southeast Asian markets, including regulatory strategy, technical documentation, product testing, clinical evaluations, quality system documentation, and submissions.
  • Manage regulatory registrations, renewals, amendments, and change notifications for assigned markets.
  • Prepare and submit regulatory filings in accordance with the requirements of the assigned region(s).
  • Act as the primary liaison with regulatory authorities, notified bodies, and local registration partners to facilitate timely approvals and address regulatory inquiries.
  • Monitor submission timelines and proactively manage regulatory milestones to support product launches and lifecycle management.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, technical files, product registrations, and regulatory records.
  • Monitor changes to applicable regulations within assigned markets and assess their impact on existing and future products.

Government Affairs & Authority Engagement

  • Build and maintain constructive relationships with key regulatory bodies, including HSA (Singapore), MDA (Malaysia), Thai FDA, BPOM (Indonesia), Philippines FDA, and Vietnam MOH, among others.
  • Represent the company in industry associations, trade groups, and multi-stakeholder forums to advocate for favorable regulatory policies and harmonization initiatives.
  • Monitor and analyze the political, legislative, and regulatory landscape across assigned markets, providing strategic counsel to senior management on risks and opportunities.
  • Support advocacy efforts on key policy issues, including regulatory reliance programs, ASEAN harmonization initiatives, and market access reforms.
  • Prepare and deliver position papers, consultation responses, and policy briefs to government agencies and industry bodies.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with internal teams, including Quality Assurance, Clinical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, and Legal, to ensure regulatory and quality compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Provide regulatory guidance on product development, labeling, design changes, and market entry strategies.
  • Partner with Market Access and Government Affairs colleagues to align regulatory strategy with reimbursement and policy goals.
  • Support business development activities by providing regulatory due diligence and market entry assessments for new products or markets.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on regulatory and government affairs matters for internal stakeholders.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure all regulatory activities comply with applicable local, regional, and international regulations and standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date regulatory documentation, technical files, product registrations, and government engagement records.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of regulatory filings, renewals, amendments, and change notifications for assigned markets.
  • Manage regulatory milestones and submission timelines to support product launches and lifecycle management.

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Engineering, Public Health, Health Policy, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5-7 years of Regulatory Affairs experience within the medical device industry, with at least 1-2 years in a team leadership or management role.
  • Hands-on experience with Class C medical devices is required.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end product registrations, renewals, change notifications, and regulatory lifecycle activities across multiple Southeast Asian markets.
  • Demonstrated experience or exposure to Government Affairs, public policy, or authority engagement within the healthcare or medical device sector.
  • Established working relationships with regulatory authorities and government agencies across Southeast Asia (e.g., HSA, MDA, Thai FDA, BPOM, Philippines FDA) is highly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple regulatory submissions and government engagements simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in an additional language is an advantage.
  • Prior experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated leadership potential and a desire to grow into a people management role.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and negotiate with senior government officials and external stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional, international environment.
  • Willingness to travel within the region as required.

title: Group Procurement Director
description:
Group Procurement Director
Oatside · Singapore (Group HQ) · Full-time

About Oatside
Oatside is Asia's #1 oat milk brand, headquartered in Singapore and sold across 19 markets. We own and operate our manufacturing in Chonburi, Thailand and in Indonesia, with further capacity expansion underway. We are a fast-scaling, founder-led business moving toward institutional-grade governance, and procurement is one of the biggest levers we have on margin, supply security and quality.

The role
The Group Procurement Director owns all third-party spend across the group — direct materials, packaging, indirect and capex — and leads our procurement teams in Indonesia and Thailand from Singapore. You will take a centre-led procurement model that has been designed and make it real: consistent category strategies, one supplier base managed to group standards, hard savings that show up in the P&L, and supply continuity for a business that cannot afford a line to stop.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally lead the largest categories and the most important supplier relationships while building the capability of the local teams.

Reports to: CEO
Direct reports: Country procurement leads procurement teams across Indonesia and Thailand covering all direct and indirect spends and procurement operations.
Location: Singapore, with regular travel to Thailand and Indonesia (~30–40%)

What you'll do

Strategy and governance

  • Own the group procurement strategy, operating model and annual plan; run the centre-led model with clear splits between group categories and local buying.
  • Own the spend taxonomy, procurement policy, delegation of authority and sourcing governance — fit for a company preparing for public-market scrutiny.
  • Report procurement performance (savings, cost avoidance, supplier OTIF, quality, working capital) to the leadership team monthly.

Category and supplier management

  • Lead sourcing for the critical direct categories: oats and oat ingredients, packaging (aseptic carton, PET, closures, secondary), other ingredients and co-packing.
  • Lead indirect and capex procurement, including major equipment purchases and construction/projects for capacity expansion.
  • Build multi-year category strategies with a clear view of cost drivers, market dynamics, dual-sourcing and supply risk.
  • Own strategic supplier relationships: contracts, performance management, quality issues, disputes and exits. Structure supply agreements with proper quality specifications, remedies and termination rights.
  • Drive commodity and FX risk management for key inputs in partnership with Finance.

Team and capability

  • Lead, develop and align the Thailand and Indonesia procurement teams; set common ways of working, KPIs and career paths.
  • Build capability in negotiation, should-cost analysis, contracting and supplier quality.
  • Partner closely with Manufacturing & Engineering, Quality, R&D, Finance and Commercial so procurement is embedded early in NPD, capex and budget decisions.

Systems and process

  • Drive procure-to-pay discipline in NetSuite: PO compliance, supplier master data, contract repository, spend visibility.
  • Introduce fit-for-purpose tools for sourcing events, supplier scorecards and savings tracking.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years in procurement, with at least 5 years leading a multi-country procurement function in food & beverage or FMCG manufacturing.
  • Deep direct-materials experience — ingredients (grains/dairy alternatives a strong plus) and packaging, ideally including aseptic/Tetra Pak and PET.
  • Track record of building or transforming a procurement function in a scale-up or post-acquisition environment, not just running a mature one.
  • Strong commercial and contracting skills; comfortable leading complex negotiations and handling supplier disputes and quality failures.
  • Capex and project procurement experience (equipment, construction, greenfield/brownfield builds).
  • Experience operating in Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Indonesia; understands local supplier markets, regulatory and import dynamics.
  • Analytically rigorous — should-cost modelling, total cost of ownership, commodity market analysis.
  • Comfortable with ERP-driven P2P processes (NetSuite a plus).
  • Senior leadership presence: able to work directly with the CEO and leadership team, and to lead remotely across cultures.
  • Fluent English; Thai or Bahasa Indonesia an advantage.
  • Willing to travel regularly to our plants.

What success looks like in 18 months

  • Group procurement operating model fully live, with every major category under a group strategy and a named owner.
  • Measurable, Finance-validated savings against a baseline; improved payment terms and inventory position.
  • No unplanned supply interruptions on critical materials; dual sources qualified for the top-risk inputs.
  • Supplier contracts, specifications and performance management in place for all strategic suppliers.
  • A cohesive, capable regional team that operates as one function.

Why join

  • Own a full-scope procurement function at Asia's category leader during its highest-growth period.
  • Direct line of sight to the CEO and to the decisions that shape the company's next phase.
  • Competitive package including equity participation.

Adjust the reporting line, travel % and remuneration details as needed. If you'd like, I can put this in a doc you can share with recruiters or the leadership team.

➢ Monitoring Quality of Work:

• Quality Metric: Achieve a minimum satisfaction rating of 85% from internal stakeholders regarding the quality of work performed.

➢ Reporting Back to Customer’s Stakeholders:

➢ General Support as Requested by Customer:

➢ Support During Project Work:

• SLA Target: All tickets must be submitted through the designated ticketing system, with an acknowledgment of receipt sent to the requester within 1 hour.

• Quality Metric: 100% of tickets are acknowledged, recorded, and categorized correctly upon submission.

➢ Ticket Categorization and Prioritization:

• SLA Target: Categorize and prioritize tickets within 30 minutes of submission based on severity and impact.

• Quality Metric: Maintain an accuracy rate of 95% in categorizing and prioritizing tickets, ensuring that critical issues receive immediate attention.

➢ Response Time:

• SLA Target:

• Critical Issues: Initial response within 1 hour.

• High Priority Issues: Initial response within 4 hours.

• Medium Priority Issues: Initial response within 8 hours.

• Low Priority Issues: Initial response within 24 hours.

➢ Resolution Time:

• SLA Target: • Critical Issues: Resolution within 4 hours.

• High Priority Issues: Resolution within 8 hours.

➢ Ticket Escalation Process:

• Critical Issues: 1 hour after initial response

• High Priority Issues: 2 hours after initial response

• Quality Metric: Maintain a 100% compliance rate for escalation processes to ensure timely attention to unresolved issues.

➢ Communication and Updates:

• SLA Target: Provide status updates to ticket submitters at least every 1 hour for critical and high priority issues and daily for all other issues until resolution.

➢ Escalation Process:

• SLA Target: Establish an escalation process for unresolved issues or performance deficiencies, with defined timelines for escalation: o Initial escalation to the provider within 48 hours. o Further escalation to senior management within 5 business days if not addressed.

• Quality Metric: Ensure that 100% of escalations are tracked and resolved within specified timelines.

PROJECT DELIVERY SERVICES (RATE CARD SERVICES) Overview:

To achieve the service level expectations for delivering customer project services, focusing on the assessment of project delivery scope for new equipment installation and decommissioning, quotation preparation, resource onboarding and allocation, project documentation support, coordination with customer operational teams, and reporting project updates to stakeholders. This framework aims to ensure timely, efficient, and high-quality service delivery.

• Quality Metric: Ensure that 100% of assessments include comprehensive project requirements, timelines, resource needs, and risk analysis, with a clarity rating of 85% or higher based on customer feedback.

• Quality Metric: Maintain a 90% resource availability rate to meet project timelines, ensuring that all resources are trained and briefed on project requirements.

➢ Project Documentation Support:

• SLA Target: Provide and support all necessary project documentation (project schedule of delivery, installation & decommissioning checklists) within 10 business days of purchase order issuance.

• Quality Metric: Ensure that 100% of documentation is reviewed for accuracy, completeness, and usability, achieving a feedback score of 85% or higher from project stakeholders.

➢ Coordination with Customer Operational Team:

• SLA Target: Initiate coordination with the customer’s operational team within 5 business days of project scope approval to ensure alignment and smooth delivery.

• Quality Metric: Ensure that 100% of project-related communications are documented, and maintain a satisfaction score of 80% or higher from the operational team regarding collaboration and support.

➢ Reporting Project Updates to Stakeholders:

• SLA Target: Provide regular project updates to stakeholders at least once a week during project execution and upon significant project milestones.

• Quality Metric: Achieve a 90% compliance rate in timely reporting, with all updates containing clear and actionable information, as confirmed by stakeholder feedback.

➢ Issue Resolution:

• SLA Target: Address any project-related issues raised by customers within 24 hours of notification.

• Quality Metric: Ensure that 90% of escalated issues are resolved within 48 hours, with documented resolutions communicated to the customer.

➢ Project Completion Review:

• SLA Target: Conduct a project completion review within 5 business days of project finalization to evaluate performance against initial scope and identify areas for improvement.

• Quality Metric: Document lessons learned and ensure that 100% of feedback is incorporated into future project planning.

title: Business Development Manager,International Clients
description:

title: Assistant Finance Manager
description:
Assistant Finance Manager

Reporting to Regional Financial Controller

About the Role 

We are seeking a proactive Assistant Finance Manager to support the Regional Finance Controller in managing all aspects of financial operations in Singapore, with a focus on supporting Australia, Thailand and Indonesia, as well as broader regional finance operations. This role is pivotal in ensuring accurate reporting, compliance, and process optimization while providing strategic insights to drive business performance. The Assistant Finance Manager will act as a key support member to the Regional Finance Controller, assisting in financial planning, analysis, and execution of initiatives that align with organizational goals. 

Key Responsibilities 

Accounting Operations: 

  • Manage day-to-day accounting functions, including billing, accounts receivable/payable, general ledger, cost accounting, inventory accounting, and revenue recognition. 
  • Support the Regional Finance Controller in overseeing cash flow management, optimizing returns, and minimizing financial risk. 
  • Support month-end and year-end financial close processes, including preparation and review of relevant financial information.

Reporting & Analysis: 

  • Prepare and deliver timely and accurate financial reports, including cash flow statements, budgets, and forecasts, under the guidance of the Regional Finance Controller. 
  • Assist in variance analysis and provide actionable insights to support strategic decisions. 
  • Review financial data for discrepancies and implement systems to prevent errors in data collection and calculations. 

Compliance & Internal Controls: 

  • Support the Regional Finance Controller in maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. 
  • Collaborate with auditors to ensure proper compliance and facilitate audits. 
  • Help enforce robust internal controls to safeguard company assets. 
  • Support finance requirements across Australia, Thailand and Indonesia where applicable, including financial reporting, statutory reporting, tax compliance and audit support.

Strategic Collaboration & Business Partnering: 

  • Work closely with the Regional Finance Controller to provide financial insights and recommendations for business initiatives. 
  • Partner with operational and commercial stakeholders to support business performance, decision-making and financial objectives across Australia, Thailand, Indonesia and broader APAC operations.
  • Build strong relationships across business units to align financial goals with organizational objectives. 

Process Optimization: 

  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy in financial operations. 
  • Assist in leveraging technology and strategic planning tools to streamline workflows. 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are a qualified accounting professional with at least 5 years ofexperience in a similar role. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly. You thrive in a collaborative environment, maintain high integrity, and demonstrate reliability and discretion in handling sensitive information. 

Ideal Profile 

  • A degree in Accountancy, Finance or a related discipline, with a professional accountingqualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA, or an equivalent qualification.
  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role. 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
  • Critical thinker with high attention to detail and reliability. 
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration. 

·      Proficient in MS Office and ERP systems, preferably NetSuite.

  • Ability to distil analytical results into clear and concise presentations. 
  • Skilled at building trust-based relationships across business groups. 
  • Dependable, exercising discretion and confidentiality. 
  • Australian, Thai and Indonesian finance exposure, including financial reporting, tax compliance, statutory reporting or audit support, would be an advantage.
  • Experience supporting finance operations across Australia, Thailand, Indonesia and/or broader APAC markets would be an advantage.

Work Arrangements

  • Fully onsite at our office in Ubi

company: BMC HELIX ASIA PACIFIC PTE. LTD.
title: Indirect Sales Manager
description:
As an Indirect Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving net-new customer acquisition across a large Growth territory spanning Singapore,Thailand, Philippines and Vietnam (accounts and geographies not allocated to Focused Account Managers), based out of Singapore. You will also lead a set of existing customers and therefore drive adoption, as well as generate new revenue through upsell and cross-sell motions.

You will work both directly with prospective customers and through channel partners to identify and qualify new logos, map key stakeholders and buying groups, uncover business and IT pains, position the right BMC Helix solutions, and convert opportunities into long-term Helix customers.

Given the scale of the territory, this role requires strong business acumen and disciplined territory planning to identify the right verticals, prioritize the right accounts, and run a repeatable pipeline-generation engine—while partnering closely with internal specialists and the partner ecosystem through long, consultative enterprise sales cycles.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Ownership& Growth Strategy

  • Own end-to-end responsibility for the Growth territory across Singapore,Thailand, Philippines and Vietnam (accounts not allocated to Focused Account Managers), including territory strategy, pipeline creation,forecasting, and revenue delivery for both net-new logo acquisition as well as net-new business from existing customers.
  • Develop annual territory plans and a prioritized target account list—selecting the right verticals and accounts to focus on, mapping key stakeholders,understanding strategic initiatives, and defining pursuit plans to land new enterprise customers.
  • Build account intelligence and pipeline through proactive prospecting,partner-sourced leads, and market mapping to identify new logo opportunities for ITSM, ITOM, AIOps, Automation, Observability, and Security Operations.

Prospect & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Own relationships with existing / prospective enterprise customers, working closely with Solution Engineering, Value Engineering, Partner Teams, Legal,and Product to progress opportunities from discovery to close.
  • Build strong multi-level relationships across CXO, CIO/CTO/CISO organisations, IT Operations, Service Management, Security, and procurement—creating a clear map of the buying group and decision process.
  • Lead discovery and executive conversations focused on pain points, business outcomes, ROI, resilience, and operational efficiency—connecting customer priorities to the right Helix capabilities.
  • Drive a structured pursuit motion that converts qualified prospects into Helix customers and establishes BMC Helix as a trusted transformation partner.

Solution Positioning & Value Selling

  • Deliver high-impact product presentations, executive briefings, and whiteboarding sessions tailored to enterprise use cases.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value propositions aligned to enterprise priorities.
  • Support customers through evaluation, proof-of-value, and decision-making processes.
  • Partner with Value Engineering to build compelling business cases and ROI models.

Deal Strategy & Execution

  • Build and maintain a robust enterprise pipeline using structured qualification frameworks such as MEDDIC / MEDDPICC.
  • Own deal strategy from discovery through closure, including pricing, commercial structuring, negotiations, and approvals.
  • Navigate complex enterprise procurement processes, legal reviews, and multi-stakeholder approvals.
  • Ensure accurate forecasting, CRM hygiene, and disciplined pipeline management.

Channel &Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Work closely with system integrators, consulting partners, and regional channel partners to create and progress partner-sourced and co-sell new opportunities across Singapore, Thailand, Philippines and Vietnam.
  • Enable partner-led pursuits by ensuring strong qualification, clear positioning and differentiation, mutual action plans, and tight execution governance through the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate with marketing on territory programs (events, CXO roundtables, partner campaigns, ABM) to generate demand and accelerate pipeline creation.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, providing insights to Product Management, Leadership, and Global Teams.
  • Collaborate with global BMC Helix teams to leverage best practices, customer success stories, and product roadmaps.

What You Need to Bring

Experience & Background

  • 10–12+ years of experience in enterprise software sales with a strong track record in net-new logo acquisition across ASEAN (enterprise/upper-mid market).
  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets in large enterprise environments.
  • Experience selling enterprise platforms such as ITSM, ITOM, AIOps, Automation, Cloud, Observability, or Infrastructure Management.

Enterprise Sales Expertise

  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder decision-making.
  • Experience engaging with CIO, CTO, CISO, Head of IT Operations, and Digital Transformation leaders.
  • Ability to manage large deal values, multi-year contracts, and strategic renewals.

Sales Execution & Discipline

  • Expertise in account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and QBRs.
  • Proficiency with SFDC or equivalent CRM tools.
  • Strong negotiation, pricing, and commercial structuring skills.

Relationship & Influence

  • Established relationships and credibility within large enterprises and the partner ecosystem across ASEAN, with the ability to open doors and build executive sponsorship in target accounts.
  • Ability to influence technical, operational, commercial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration skills with partners, internal teams, and leadership.

Personal Attributes

  • High ownership mindset with strong customer focus.
  • Excellent communication skills and executive presence.
  • Strategic, consultative, and value-led selling approach.
  • Self-driven, coachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.

title: AI Assisted Sales Manager
description:
The Sales Manager is responsible for driving revenue across TechStudio's products and professional services. The role combines new business development with account management, engaging both channel partners and enterprise end-clients directly. The primary market is Singapore, with sales support extended into Malaysia and Thailand as opportunities arise.

This is a mid-level, performance-driven sales role suited to a commercially hungry professional who is equally comfortable opening new accounts, nurturing existing relationships, and working alongside channel partners to close enterprise deals. The role carries a fixed base salary complemented by an attractive, uncapped commission structure, allowing strong performers to scale their earnings in direct line with the deals they close.

AI tools form part of the day-to-day workflow. The executive is expected to use them actively for prospecting, account research, and pipeline management, and to contribute ideas that strengthen how the sales team applies AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities for TechStudio's products and services across Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand
  • Own and consistently deliver against assigned sales quotas and revenue targets
  • Manage and grow existing accounts, ensuring strong client relationships, renewals, and upsell opportunities
  • Work closely with channel partners to co-sell into their enterprise customer base
  • Engage enterprise end-clients directly through discovery meetings, solution presentations, and commercial negotiations
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, accurately forecast revenue, and report progress to the Sales Director
  • Collaborate with technical, and service delivery teams to scope proposals and ensure smooth handover to delivery
  • Stay current on the product roadmap, competitor offerings, and the broader market for AI, WiFi application, IoT, location services, and video AI
  • Represent TechStudio at industry events, partner briefings, and client engagements
  • Use AI tools for prospecting, account research, proposal drafting, and CRM hygiene, and contribute prompts and workflows that improve sales productivity

Requirements

  • Diploma in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Minimum 2 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in enterprise technology, telecommunications, SaaS, or system integration
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a quota-carrying role
  • Comfortable operating within a performance-driven, commission-centric compensation model with uncapped earning potential, and motivated to grow income through sales achievement
  • Experience selling through channel partners and directly to enterprise clients
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to position business outcomes ahead of technical features
  • Proficient in spoken and written English and Mandarin, to engage with Chinese-speaking clients and partners
  • Confidence using AI tools in day-to-day sales activities, with a willingness to learn prompt engineering and contribute to sales workflow improvements
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Self-motivated, well-organised, and able to manage multiple opportunities concurrently
  • Willing to travel occasionally within the region to support business in Malaysia and Thailand
  • Open to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents only

What You Gain

  • A compensation package built around a fixed base salary plus an uncapped commission structure, with no ceiling on earnings for strong performers
  • A diverse product and services portfolio that addresses real enterprise business outcomes, supported by deployments across major organisations
  • A working environment that integrates AI into daily sales operations, with room to influence how AI tools are adopted by the team
  • Direct collaboration with senior leadership and a clear commercial growth path within TechStudio

1 Year Contract

Customer Credit & Risk Management

title: Senior Product Specialist - Regional Payments and Cash Management
description:
Reports To (If any)
Service Delivery Manager

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Specialist – Regional Payments & Cash Management to support a strategic Transaction Banking initiative covering multiple Asian markets.

The role will focus on researching market and customer needs, identifying product gaps and opportunities, and developing new or enhanced Payments and Cash Management propositions for corporate banking customers. The regional scope includes Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar and Malaysia.

The successful candidate will work closely with Transaction Banking, Product, Relationship Management, Sales, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Technology and regional stakeholders to understand business needs, assess market practices, develop product concepts and drive product initiatives toward implementation.

The candidate should have strong Transaction Banking, Payments or Cash Management domain knowledge, together with the ability to independently research, structure and progress new product initiatives in an environment where requirements and solutions may still be evolving.

Responsibilities and Duties

Product Research & Development

  • Research market trends, customer needs, competitor offerings and emerging developments within Payments and Cash Management.
  • Analyse existing product capabilities and identify gaps, enhancement opportunities and potential new product propositions.
  • Develop product concepts based on business needs, customer feedback, market practices and commercial opportunities.
  • Assess whether identified requirements can be addressed through existing capabilities, product enhancements or development of new products.
  • Define product propositions including:
    o Target customer segments
    o Customer needs and use cases
    o Product capabilities
    o Customer benefits
    o Market differentiation
    o Business and operational considerations
  • Support the preparation of product proposals, business cases and internal approval materials.
  • Support development of product roadmaps and prioritisation of enhancement opportunities.
  • Monitor market developments and continuously identify opportunities to improve the bank's transaction-banking offering.

Regional Payments & Cash Management

  • Analyse regional and country-specific requirements relating to:
    o Domestic and cross-border payments
    o Real-time / instant payments
    o ACH and domestic clearing
    o RTGS / high-value payments
    o Payroll and bulk payments
    o Collections
    o Tax and statutory payments
    o Bill and utility payments
    o Cheque payments
    o Corporate connectivity
    o Reporting and reconciliation
  • Understand how regional product propositions can support both common requirements and local-market needs.
  • Research country-specific payment capabilities, market practices and payment infrastructures.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance regional payment and collection services through local-market capabilities.
  • Consider customer needs relating to Host-to-Host, file-based connectivity, APIs and other corporate-banking channels.
  • Analyse customer requirements for transaction visibility, consolidated reporting and reconciliation.
  • Identify opportunities to create a more consistent and integrated regional payment proposition across multiple markets.

Regional Market Knowledge

Relevant domestic payment and clearing infrastructures may include:

  • Singapore: MEPS+, FAST, PayNow, Interbank GIRO
  • Hong Kong: CHATS, FPS
  • Indonesia: BI-FAST, SKNBI, BI-RTGS
  • Philippines: PESONet, PhilPaSS / PhilPaSSplus, Real-Time / InstaPay
  • Thailand: Domestic Payment, SMART, BAHTNET, Cheque Payment, PromptPay
  • Vietnam: Domestic / CITAD, IBPS, NAPAS 247
  • Myanmar: CBM-NET / CBM-NET2, MPU, MyanmarPay / MMQR
  • Malaysia: RENTAS, RPP / DuitNow, Interbank GIRO

Candidates are not expected to have experience across every market or payment scheme but should have sufficient regional transaction-banking experience to research and understand new market requirements.

Business & Customer Needs Analysis

  • Work with Relationship Managers, Transaction Bankers and other internal stakeholders to understand customer feedback, pain points and emerging requirements.
  • Translate customer and market needs into potential product opportunities.
  • Analyse corporate customer use cases and assess the applicability of existing or new banking products.
  • Conduct competitor and benchmark analysis to understand comparable market offerings.
  • Identify potential opportunities for product differentiation, cross-sell and upsell.
  • Ensure new and enhanced products can be effectively positioned by Relationship

Managers and Transaction Banking teams.

  • Consider regulatory, operational and market-specific requirements when developing product propositions.

Stakeholder & Initiative Management

  • Coordinate with stakeholders across Product, Transaction Banking, Relationship Management, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Legal, Technology and regional teams.
  • Facilitate discussions to refine product concepts and resolve open questions.
  • Proactively follow up on decisions, actions, dependencies and productdevelopment activities.
  • Drive product initiatives in situations where the business requirement or target solution may not yet be fully defined.
  • Challenge assumptions and recommend practical improvements to existing products and processes.
  • Support internal stakeholder alignment and product approval processes.
  • Coordinate activities required to progress approved product concepts toward implementation and launch.

Qualifications

Must Have

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Banking, Finance, Economics, Information Systems or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience within Transaction Banking, Payments, Cash Management, Corporate Banking Product or a related banking function.
  • Strong working knowledge of Payments and/or Cash Management products.
  • Experience in product development, product management, product strategy, product enhancement or banking solution design.
  • Ability to understand corporate customer needs and translate them into practical banking product propositions.
  • Strong knowledge of domestic and/or cross-border payment processes.
  • Experience conducting market research, competitor analysis or product benchmarking.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and presentation skills.
  • Able to work independently and proactively in an environment where product requirements and direction may continue to evolve.
  • Able to identify opportunities, propose improvements and drive initiatives toward decisions and implementation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred / Advantageous

  • Experience with regional or multi-country Transaction Banking products in Asia.
  • Exposure to one or more of the following markets: Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar or Malaysia.
  • Experience with corporate payment connectivity such as H2H, APIs or file-based channels.
  • Experience with collections, transaction reporting and reconciliation solutions.
  • Knowledge of local regulatory, statutory, tax or market-specific payment requirements.
  • Experience working with Relationship Managers or Transaction Banking sales team to develop products for corporate customers.
  • Experience acting as a Product Manager, Product Specialist, Product Owner or Product Development Lead.

title: Finance Intern
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Evolution Data Centres is a developer and operator of hyperscale data centres across Asia Pacific. Our Singapore-based finance team supports entities across the region as the business scales.

We are looking for a Finance Intern to join the team for three months. This is a hands-on role supporting three areas of work: our Oracle ERP implementation, day-to-day accounts payable and expense processing, and the statutory audits of our Philippines and Thailand entities. You will work alongside the regional team and get exposure to a live system migration, a multi-entity payables cycle and an external audit process —all within one internship.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Oracle ERP implementation support (project)

•    Support the migration of finance data into Oracle — extracting, cleansing and formatting master and transactional data from the current system into the required upload templates.

•    Perform data validation and reconciliation checks between source data and migrated data (e.g. vendor master, chart of accounts, open payables, historical balances), and document any differences found.

•    Log, track and follow up on data issues and exceptions with the finance team and the implementation partner until they are cleared.

•    Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) —running test scenarios, recording results and flagging errors.

•    Help maintain project trackers, checklists and simple process documentation for the new system.

2. Business-as-usual payments and accounts payable

•    Process employee expense claims — checking receipts and supporting documents against policy, journal entry into accounting system.

•    Enter and update supplier invoices in the accounting system, ensuring correct entity, cost centre, GL coding and payment terms.

•    Respond to routine vendor queries on invoice and payment status, and escalate anything non-standard to the finance team.

•    Support the preparation of payment runs,including matching invoices to purchase orders and approvals, and assembling payment documentation.

•    Maintain and update vendor records and supporting files; assist with accounts payable ageing and reconciliation of supplier statements.

•    General finance data entry and filing, keeping both physical and digital records complete and audit-ready.

3. Audit support — Philippines and Thailand entities

•    Compile and send documents requested by the external auditors (invoices, contracts, bank statements, schedules and other supporting records), working from the audit request list.

•    Maintain the audit request tracker — recording what has been requested, provided and remains outstanding, and chasing internal owners for missing items.

•    Liaise directly with auditors on straightforward queries and clarifications, escalating technical or judgemental matters to the Finance Controller.

•    Assist in preparing simple audit schedules and supporting reconciliations.

•    Help keep the audit documentation folders organised and version-controlled.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential

•    Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a diploma or degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business or a related discipline.

•    Available for a continuous three-month period starting ASAP.

•    Strong Excel skills — comfortable with lookups, pivot tables, filtering and working with large data sets.

•    Careful and accurate, with a genuine eye for detail — much of this role is checking that one set of numbers agrees to another.

•    Organised and able to keep track of many open items at once, and to follow up without being reminded.

•    Clear written English, and comfortable corresponding professionally with vendors and auditors.

•    Able to handle confidential financial information with discretion.

Nice to have

•    Previous internship or part-time exposure to accounts payable, bookkeeping or audit.

•    Familiarity with an ERP or accounting system(Oracle, SAP, NetSuite, Xero or similar).

•    Interest in data, systems and process improvement.

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN

•    Practical experience of a live ERP implementation — rarely available at internship level.

•    End-to-end exposure to a regional accounts payable cycle across multiple entities and currencies.

•    First-hand experience of the statutory audit process and direct interaction with external auditors.

•    Mentoring from qualified finance professionals in a fast-growing data centre platform.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your CV and a short note on your availability to careers@evolutiondatacentres.com. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
