title: Senior Project Manager
description:
SimplifyNext is a Singapore-headquartered digital engineering firm, with offices in Thailand and Malaysia, working across three converged areas: agentic AI, AI-enabled application modernisation, and intelligent automation.
 
We bring strong business process consulting together with deep technology skills and modern delivery practices – product-centric, agile and AI-assisted. We build bespoke applications and AI systems, and we go deep on the platforms our clients run on, including Microsoft, AWS, ServiceNow, Databricks and UiPath. That combination of engineering depth and platform depth is what our clients come to us for.
 
We build and modernise the systems people depend on daily. Our 300+ practitioners are multi-disciplinary by design – business consultants, software engineers, architects, AI engineers and designers working on the same delivery, not handing off between silos. We focus on delivering outcomes for clients, building strong careers for our people, and staying ahead of the technology curve. We hire because we are growing.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for delivering customer digital products from discovery through launch, using agile delivery practices. This role sits at the intersection of project management discipline and digital product thinking – partnering closely with customers, product owners, designers, and engineers to ensure scope, timeline, quality, and commercial outcomes are consistently met.

What You'll Own

End-to-End Delivery Ownership

- Lead planning and delivery of customer-facing digital products and enhancements, from discovery through launch.

- Manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones.

- Track progress, report status, and ensure delivery stays within agreed budget and quality standards.

Agile Execution & Ceremonies

- Facilitate agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

- Champion agile best practices, driving iterative development and adaptive planning across teams.

- Customer & Stakeholder Partnership

- Act as the main point of contact for delivery updates, issue resolution, and stakeholder communication.

- Build trusted relationships with customers, translating business priorities into clear delivery plans.

Cross-Functional Team Coordination

- Coordinate product owners, designers, engineers, and business analysts to keep work aligned with customer priorities and acceptance criteria.

- Provide leadership and guidance to project teams, fostering continuous improvement.

Product Awareness & Release Management

- Apply working knowledge of the digital product lifecycle, user needs, and release management to inform delivery decisions.

- Support product thinking by helping teams translate business needs into workable digital outcomes.

What You'll Bring

Must-Have

  • 10 - 15 years of experience managing digital projects or product delivery in an agile environment.
  • Proven experience leading full software or digital product delivery lifecycles.
  • Strong stakeholder management and customer communication skills, with the ability to influence decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of digital product development, including release cycles and prioritisation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks, and dependencies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with delivery tools and collaboration platforms used in agile teams (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).
  • Experienced in delivering complex projects in the Singapore Public Sector or large enterprises.

Good-to-Have

  • Background in product management, digital transformation, or software delivery.
  • Experience working with internal teams and external customers in a service or agency setting.
  • Certification or hands-on experience with Agile, Scrum, or similar frameworks (e.g. CSM, PMI-ACP).
  • Project Management certification (e.g. PMP, CITPM, COMIT, PMI) is an advantage.

Not for You If

This role is not a fit if:

  • You prefer working on internal, back-office projects rather than live customer-facing products.
  • You see agile ceremonies as a formality rather than a working discipline.
  • You're looking for a pure product management role without delivery accountability.
  • You're uncomfortable being the primary point of contact for customer escalations.

Why SimplifyNext

One Team, Not Siloed Offerings

Apps, automation, and AI aren't separate teams here - you'll work across all three as one connected practice, not get boxed into a single lane.

AI in Our DNA, Not Bolted On

Regardless of platform, every specialist here is AI-enabled by design, powered by our own in-house AI workbench that pairs humans and AI from discovery to testing.

Future-Proof Your Career

Tech trends come and go - today's hot platform is tomorrow's afterthought. We multi-skill our people across platforms and AI so your career keeps growing no matter where the market moves.

APAC's Biggest AI-Integrated Practice

Across every platform we work in, our AI-integrated practice is the largest in the region, with work good enough to be cited at Google's own AI event.

Grow With Us Across ASEAN

We're one of Singapore's 100 Fastest Growing Companies, expanding fast across Thailand and Malaysia - plenty of room to grow with us.

At SimplifyNext, we’re committed to building a team of curious, driven, and forward-thinking individuals who care deeply about creating meaningful impact through technology. If you’re excited by the opportunity to grow, collaborate, and shape the future of digital transformation across the region, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Manager of Investment, Utility Power Projects
description:
Job Description

About Peak Energy

Peak Energy is a clean energy platform that develops, finances, builds, and operates utility-scale solar, rooftop generation, onshore wind, and battery storage solutions across Asia-Pacific. As a fast-growing scale-up, we build on the experience of a team drawn from TotalEnergies, Vestas, Cleantech Energy, and other leading players, combining world-class technical expertise with entrepreneurial agility.

With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development across Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia, we are greenfield developers at heart, but we also partner flexibly with industrials, developers, and investors to accelerate delivery and scale impact.

We combine the customer focus of a developer, the technical expertise of an EPC and the financial strength of a heavyweight institution, enabling clients to meet decarbonization targets on time, on budget, and without risk of delivery failure. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, one of the world's leading alternative investment firms specializing in infrastructure and real assets. Our financial and technical strength coupled with our relationships in local markets allows us to optimize our capital deployment in high-quality assets.

Our clients can expect clean energy solutions delivered on time, on budget, and at scale, with no surprises. Let's partner together to support your sustainability journey.

Role Overview

The Associate / Senior Associate, Investments will support the identification, evaluation, development, and execution of utility-scale renewable energy investments across Asia Pacific with a closer line of sight to markets in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines. The role is expected to report directly to the CIO in supporting decision-making for the entire group.

Working closely with colleagues across development, engineering, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, this individual will contribute to greenfield development opportunities, mergers and acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and project financing initiatives. The role offers broad exposure across the investment lifecycle and the opportunity to help grow one of the region's leading renewable energy platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Investment Analysis & Evaluation

·        Develop and maintain financial models for renewable energy and infrastructure investments.

·        Perform valuation, scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses to support investment decisions including offtake negotiations, FID decisions and devex initiation / monitoring..

·        Assess project economics, commercial assumptions, and potential returns across development and acquisition opportunities.

·        Support the preparation of investment recommendations and internal approval materials.

·        Preparation of regular reporting material with local team to discuss next quarterly spend profiles and project priorities

Greenfield Development & Opportunity Assessment

·        Support the evaluation of greenfield renewable energy opportunities across Southeast Asia.

·        Conduct market, commercial, and regulatory research to identify attractive investment opportunities.

·        Work closely with development teams to assess project viability and investment attractiveness.

·        Monitor industry trends, power markets, and competitive activity across the region.

Transaction Execution & Due Diligence

·        Support acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities across the region.

·        Participate in due diligence activities and coordinate with internal teams and external advisors.

·        Review project and company information to identify key risks and opportunities.

·        Support financing, transaction execution, and other strategic initiatives as required.

Stakeholder Collaboration

·        Work collaboratively with development, legal, engineering, finance, and operations teams.

·        Support engagement with developers, investors, lenders, advisors, and strategic partners.

·        Prepare analyses and presentations for management and investment discussions.

·        Contribute to initiatives that support the continued growth of Peak Energy's utility-scale platform.

Qualifications & Experience

·        Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

·        Relevant experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, project finance, investment banking, corporate development, consulting, or a related field.

·        Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities.

·        Financial modelling experience relating to infrastructure, power, or renewable energy projects is required.

·        Financial due diligence experience relating to renewable energy or infrastructure investments is preferred,

·        Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.

title: External Communications Specialist
description:
PropertyGuru is Southeast Asia’s leading PropTech company, and the preferred destination for over 32 million property seekers monthly to connect with over 50,000 agents monthly to find their dream home. PropertyGuru empowers property seekers with more than 2.1 million real estate listings, in-depth insights, and solutions that enable them to make confident property decisions across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam.

PropertyGuru.com.sg was launched in Singapore in 2007 and since then, PropertyGuru Group has made the property journey a transparent one for property seekers in Southeast Asia. In the last 18 years, PropertyGuru has grown into a high-growth PropTech company with a robust portfolio including leading property marketplaces and award-winning mobile apps across its markets in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand as well as the region’s biggest and most respected industry recognition platform – PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards, events and publications across Asia.

Recognised as a Top Employers Certified* organisation, we’re proud to be among the best workplaces in the region—celebrating an inclusive culture of excellence, growth, and well-being. 

About the role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, External Communications, you will manage the delivery of PropertyGuru’s consumer communications in Singapore and corporate communications across the Group. You will work to agreed priorities, with delivery support from a PR agency that you will manage day to day. The role combines media relations and campaign delivery with initiatives to build PropertyGuru’s corporate reputation and leadership presence.

As a Guru you will be accountable for:

  • Deliver communications for Singapore consumer campaigns, product launches and insights, working with the marketing team and PR agency to develop stories and secure media coverage.
  • Identify and secure relevant thought leadership and engagement opportunities for PropertyGuru and its leaders, aligned with business priorities.
  • Manage day-to-day media enquiries and relationships, draft and review communications materials, and coordinate spokesperson preparation and stakeholder approvals.
  • Manage the PR agency’s delivery across both remits, setting priorities and briefs, reviewing content and outreach, and tracking agreed deliverables, budgets and results.
  • Coordinate content updates and publishing for the corporate website, newsroom and Group LinkedIn, working with internal teams and website partners.
  • Oversee media monitoring and reporting with agency and monitoring partners, identifying relevant developments, opportunities and emerging issues.
  • Support issues and crisis responses under the direction of the Head of External Communications, coordinating facts, draft responses and stakeholder input.

What we are looking for:

  • Proven years of relevant communications experience, gained in-house, in an agency or both, with a demonstrated track record in consumer communications and experience in corporate communications and supporting senior spokespeople.
  • Excellent writing and editorial judgement, with the ability to make complex information clear and recognise a strong media angle.
  • Credibility and confidence when working with senior executives, including the ability to offer considered advice and constructive challenges when needed.
  • Sound judgement, discretion and composure under pressure, with the ability to handle sensitive matters and recognise when to escalate.
  • Strong ownership and organisational skills, with the ability to manage agency partners and multiple workstreams independently.
  • Good understanding of Singapore’s media landscape, with familiarity with regional business media an advantage.

Our commitment to you:

  • Hybrid flexible working that focuses on outcomes over hours.

  • Holistic rewards package covering your financial, physical & mental health.

  • Multi-directional career development across all levels.

  • Inclusive benefits like equal paternity leave, supporting all employees in work-life balance.

At PropertyGuru, you’ll be part of a Top Employers Certified* company that puts people at the heart of everything we do.

title: Government Relations and Public Policy Manager
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Government Relations Manager to advance our policy and regulatory objectives in South East Asia and help us get closer to to help us get closer to achieving our mission of low cost and high speed international payments. You will be expected to represent the company with gravitas and be influential in doing so.

This job requires active external advocacy, public campaigning and engagement with policymakers and policy influencers to prosecute our interests for direct access to payment systems and transparent pricing of foreign exchange.

You will have responsibility for our engagement with the respective government but with potential for further responsibilities in other markets as we grow and expand into different locales.

We lead the way in calling for the full implementation of the G20 Cross Border Payments Roadmap through our annual G20 Scorecard Reports, with a heavy focus on driving direct access and price transparency.

What you’ll experience

You will be based in our Singapore office and work closely with our Product, Banking, Compliance, Public Relations and Legal teams across South East Asian markets - particularly Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines and Thailand but with potential for responsibility for other markets as we grow and expand into different locales. You will be expected to travel frequently to other markets, particularly Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines in order to advance our mission. 

Wise is an ‘in person’ company, so you will be based in our full stack office in Singapore and report to the APAC Government Relations Lead (also based in Singapore); you will have a high degree of autonomy in how you work to achieve our mission goals.

You will also be expected to play an integral part supporting our APAC and global leadership team in their external facing meetings with governments, regulators and trade associations as well as assist in Environmental, Social and Governance compliance processes.

You will be part of the global Government Relations team. It is a small but effective group of professionals who prioritise active advocacy to achieve our mission.

Qualifications

  • Be a natural self-starter who can work productively and efficiently without regular direct supervision. You must be capable of identifying problems, developing a plan to solve those issues and then delivering your plan to fulfill our mission.

  • Be willing to advocate proactively and robustly for Wise’s interests with government stakeholders to the exclusion of all other interests.

  • Have an ability to constructively challenge, with evidence, those in positions of authority who do not want to see change. 

  • Be capable of identifying potential issues, developing a plan to solve those problems and then delivering on your plan to fulfill our mission.

  • Have a minimum of 7 years’ of relevant experience in government, politics or public policy roles.

  • Understand our mission in respect to international payments.

  • Have an ability to constructively challenge those in positions of authority who do not want to see change. 

  • Be fluent in written and spoken English and preferably in another language.

  • Have experience operating in at least one South East Asian Market with an established network and an understanding of government structures, regulatory systems and political institutions.

  • Proficiency in financial services, payments and consumer protection policy is considered a plus.

  • Be a persuasive advocate and skilled communicator both in speaking and writing - your written work will be both for internal and public consumption and your advocacy may be used in the media. 

  • Be tenacious, inquisitive and have an appetite to learn about new areas of policy and their application to our business. 

  • Have an ability to work across teams and cultures in a dynamic and diverse workplace with respect for and curiosity about other cultures and systems.

title: Senior Expeditor
description:

  • Proven experience managing and growing a Shopify or Shopify Plus eCommerce business.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful experiences through play, exploration and movement.

Our portfolio includes Kiztopia, a recognised family edutainment brand, and Xventure, our next-generation indoor active sports park designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we continue to grow across Singapore and the region, we are looking for energetic, creative and driven individuals who are excited to contribute to our brands and help bring engaging customer experiences to life.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proactive, creative and hands-on Marketing Executive to support the planning, coordination and execution of integrated marketing initiatives for Kiztopia and Xventure.

This role offers broad exposure across digital marketing, social media, content development, CRM, partnerships, campaigns and events.

You will be responsible for translating marketing plans into effective execution, coordinating with various stakeholders and ensuring campaigns are delivered accurately, efficiently and on schedule.

We are looking for someone who is organised, digitally savvy, resourceful and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day marketing activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Campaign Execution

  • Execute integrated marketing campaigns and promotions across online and offline channels.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines, deliverables, promotional mechanics and marketing assets.
  • Assist in developing campaign execution plans, including channel schedules, creative requirements and target audiences.
  • Ensure campaign launches, promotional updates and marketing communications are completed on schedule.
  • Work closely with Operations, Commercial and relevant internal teams to ensure campaign readiness and alignment.
  • Monitor campaign progress and proactively flag delays, issues or opportunities for improvement.

2. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising

  • Set up, execute and monitor paid digital campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and TikTok based on approved marketing plans and budgets.
  • Assist with audience targeting, creative testing, campaign scheduling and performance optimisation.
  • Track advertising metrics such as reach, engagement, click-through rates, traffic, conversion and cost efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of campaign spending and results.
  • Prepare performance reports with key observations and recommendations.
  • Coordinate campaign landing pages, booking links and tracking requirements where applicable.

3. Social Media & Content Management

  • Develop and maintain social media content calendars aligned with marketing campaigns and brand direction.
  • Create, schedule and publish engaging content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Develop captions, marketing copy, promotional messages and creative briefs.
  • Coordinate content production with designers, content creators, agencies and internal teams.
  • Support the creation of short-form videos, reels, photography and other digital content.
  • Monitor social media comments, enquiries and engagement, coordinating customer responses or escalations where required.
  • Keep up with relevant social media trends and propose creative content ideas suitable for each brand.

4. CRM, Customer Engagement & Website Updates

  • Execute email marketing, eDMs, segmented WhatsApp campaigns and other CRM communications.
  • Coordinate customer segmentation, promotional content, scheduling and communication accuracy.
  • Maintain and update website content, promotional details, campaign information and event listings.
  • Ensure marketing information is accurate and consistent across owned channels and relevant ticketing platforms.
  • Assist in customer engagement, retention and remarketing initiatives.
  • Track campaign responses and identify opportunities for improvements.

5. Partnerships, Events & Activations

  • Coordinate marketing activities with mall partners, influencers, ticketing platforms, schools and community partners.
  • Support new outlet launches, marketing events, pop-up activations and promotional campaigns.
  • Assist with influencer coordination, content deliverables, scheduling and campaign follow-up.
  • Prepare event-related marketing materials, communication schedules and campaign checklists.
  • Provide on-ground marketing support during key events and activations where required.

6. Reporting, Coordination & Administration

  • Maintain campaign trackers, content calendars, marketing schedules and deliverable checklists.
  • Consolidate campaign performance data across digital advertising, social media, CRM and other channels.
  • Prepare weekly marketing updates covering completed activities, campaign performance, outstanding actions and upcoming priorities.
  • Coordinate quotations, purchase requests, vendor deliverables and relevant budget records.
  • Ensure marketing materials, campaigns and promotional information are accurate and approved before release.
  • Suggest practical improvements to execution efficiency, content performance and campaign effectiveness.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in a consumer-facing business or agency environment.
  • Good understanding of social media platforms, content marketing, digital advertising and campaign execution.
  • Hands-on familiarity with platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok or relevant marketing tools.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines independently.
  • Good copywriting, communication and organisational skills.
  • Comfortable working with campaign data, basic performance metrics and reporting tools.
  • Proactive, resourceful and detail-oriented, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of tasks.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative and hands-on environment.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

  • Experience in entertainment, attractions, sports, lifestyle, retail, hospitality or leisure industries.
  • Content creation skills, including photography, social media reels and short-form video production.
  • Video editing capabilities, using tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar applications.
  • Experience with CRM systems, email marketing, website CMS or e-commerce platforms.
  • Experience working with influencers, partners or supporting marketing events and activations.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics, campaign tracking or basic marketing reporting.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Timely and accurate execution of marketing campaigns.
  • Consistent delivery of engaging social media and digital marketing content.
  • Effective management of campaign schedules, assets and stakeholder coordination.
  • Reliable campaign monitoring, performance reporting and follow-up.
  • Improved execution efficiency and proactive identification of campaign opportunities.
  • Meaningful contribution to brand awareness, customer engagement and commercial performance.

WHY JOIN US?

  • Gain exposure to two exciting brands in the entertainment and leisure industry.
  • Build practical experience across integrated campaigns, digital marketing, content, CRM and events.
  • Be part of new brand launches, marketing activations and ongoing business expansion.
  • Work in a collaborative environment that encourages initiative, learning and ownership.

If you enjoy bringing creative marketing ideas to life and are excited to build your career in a dynamic, growing business, we would love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Executive / Senior Marketing Executive
description:
ERC Institute, a Private Education Institute (PEI) that was awarded the EduTrust Certification as a mark of providing quality education services to students in Singapore, is looking to recruit dynamic and self-driven individuals who are interested in an exciting career with our fast-growing company. 

Position: Marketing Executive / Senior Marketing Executive

Job Summary:

The Marketing Executive / Senior Marketing Executive will be responsible for planning, developing, and executing integrated marketing initiatives to strengthen ERCI’s brand presence, student recruitment efforts, and student engagement activities. This role combines digital marketing, content creation, campaign coordination, event support, branding, and stakeholder coordination to support the ERCI’s strategic objectives and partnerships with universities, agents, and industry stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Digital Marketing & Campaign Management

  • Manage and optimize digital marketing channels, including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Google Ads, email marketing, and website content.

  • Work closely with appointed marketing agencies and vendors to execute paid advertising campaigns and monitor campaign performance against established KPIs.

  • Track and manage marketing expenditure within approved budgets and provide regular performance reports and recommendations.

title: Marketing Executive - Immediate
description:
NLCS (Singapore) believes that each employee makes a significant contribution to our success and that contributions should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities.

Therefore, this position description is designed to outline primary duties, qualifications, and job scope, but not limit the employee, nor NLCS (Singapore), to only the work identified. It is the expectation of the school that each employee will offer his/her services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our organisation.

Our School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The School expects all teaching staff, non‐teaching staff and volunteers to share and uphold this commitment.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Marketing Executive will take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of the School’s marketing activities across campaigns, content, digital, events, partnerships and communications.

Working within the School’s agreed marketing strategy, the role is expected to be proactive, bring forward ideas and opportunities, lead projects through to completion and ensure marketing activity is delivered accurately, consistently and on time.

The role requires someone who can think beyond execution, understand the purpose behind each initiative and recommend practical ways to strengthen the School’s visibility, engagement and admissions objectives.

Main Responsibilities:

1. Campaigns & Marketing Delivery

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of agreed marketing campaigns and initiatives.
  • Proactively propose campaign ideas, themes, content opportunities and improvements.
  • Develop first drafts of campaign messaging, concepts and supporting content for review.
  • Own campaign timelines, actions, approvals and follow-ups through to completion.

2. Content, PR & Communications

  • Develop content for social media, emailers, website, PR, third-party deliverables and marketing materials.
  • Develop and maintain a regular pipeline of blogs, thought leadership articles, school stories and long-form website content aligned with marketing and admissions priorities.
  • Proactively identify student, staff, academic, enrichment and community stories.
  • Develop story angles and content ideas that strengthen the School’s positioning and reputation.
  • Gather information from academic and non-academic teams and turn it into engaging marketing content.
  • Support PR opportunities by preparing content, background information, imagery and other required materials.
  • Identify content opportunities that strengthen the School’s authority and discoverability across SEO, GEO and AEO.
  • Maintain a forward content pipeline aligned with School marketing and admissions priorities.

3. Digital Presence, Social Media & Website

  • Own and manage the monthly social media and digital content calendar.
  • Lead day-to-day social media publishing and content scheduling.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve reach, engagement and content performance.
  • Monitor comments, messages and online engagement, escalating sensitive matters where appropriate.
  • Keep website content, imagery, event information and downloadable materials accurate and current.
  • Identify areas of the website requiring updates or improvements and take them forward with the relevant teams.
  • Support the continuous development of the School’s digital presence through SEO, GEO and AEO, including website content, blogs, FAQs, landing pages and other relevant content.
  • Identify and recommend content and website improvements based on search behaviour, emerging queries and marketing priorities.
  • Work with relevant internal and external teams to ensure content is structured and optimised for traditional search engines and AI-led discovery platforms.
  • Monitor organic visibility, website engagement and content performance and recommend areas for improvement.

4. Events & Community Marketing

  • Own the marketing requirements for admissions events, Open Houses, education fairs, community activities and outreach initiatives.
  • Develop event promotion plans and ensure digital, creative, signage, collateral and content requirements are delivered on time.
  • Review and maintain the Marketing Events Calendar and plan marketing activity sufficiently in advance.
  • Support live content and social media coverage at key events.
  • Identify content opportunities from events for future marketing use.

5. Brand, Collateral & Multimedia

  • Ensure approved brand guidelines are consistently followed across marketing materials and touchpoints.
  • Lead the development and production of routine marketing and event collateral.
  • Review materials for accuracy, consistency and quality before production or publication.
  • Identify photography and videography requirements for campaigns and key School events.
  • Brief and manage routine requirements with photographers, videographers, designers and production suppliers as required.
  • Maintain an organised and current library of photography, video and marketing assets.
  • Ensure appropriate student photography, filming permissions and safeguarding requirements are followed.

6. Partnerships, Listings & Marketing Opportunities

  • Research and recommend relevant third-party platforms, editorial listings, directories, partnerships and marketing opportunities for annual engagement.
  • Identify opportunities that support SEO, GEO and AEO visibility, brand awareness and lead generation.
  • Maintain and regularly review School profiles across education portals, directories and external listings.
  • Support delivery of agreed marketing requirements for partnerships and external collaborations.
  • Ensure partner branding and marketing assets remain consistent with School guidelines.
  • Monitor agreed third-party deliverables and ensure required content and assets are supplied within deadlines.

7. Reporting, Suppliers & Marketing Operations

  • Prepare quarterly marketing reports covering campaigns, social media, website activity, digital visibility and other agreed performance metrics, working with relevant team members to consolidate inputs.
  • Maintain and develop trackers and reports for management review, internal planning and marketing strategy alignment.
  • Maintain accurate marketing trackers, calendars and project records.
  • Obtain supplier quotations and manage routine production requirements within approved parameters.
  • Track supplier deliverables, timelines and quality, escalating issues where required.
  • Maintain records of marketing expenditure, purchase requests, invoices and associated documentation.
  • Maintain appropriate stock levels of marketing collateral, branded materials and event assets.

8. Cross-Departmental Working & Ownership

  • Build strong working relationships with Admissions, Academic Teams, Events, Partnerships and Business Development, Parent Engagement, Finance and other School departments.
  • Take ownership of agreed marketing requests and ensure they are followed through to completion.
  • Manage competing deadlines and escalate priorities where appropriate.
  • Proactively identify opportunities across School activities that could support marketing, reputation or admissions objectives.
  • Bring forward ideas and recommendations rather than relying solely on assigned tasks.
  • Contribute actively to marketing planning discussions and team initiatives.

Safeguarding:

  • Abide by the school safeguarding policy and keep abreast of any changes.
  • Ensure appropriate safeguarding, consent and privacy requirements are followed in relation to student photography, filming and marketing content.

Ad Hoc:

  • Undertake other reasonable responsibilities and provide additional support as required in line with the evolving business needs of the AMC Department.

title: Senior Marketing Executive / Assistant Manager, Marketing & Communications
description:
About the Role

OaksPlus Limited is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven marketing professional to join our Marketing & Communications team as a Senior Marketing Executive or Assistant Manager. 

This role will focus primarily on growing the visibility, brand presence and enrolment opportunities of 7oaks Preschool through integrated digital and offline marketing initiatives. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing digital marketing campaigns and agency relationships, driving social media and content strategies, overseeing website content, developing marketing communications materials and building corporate partnerships. 

We are looking for someone who combines creative thinking with strong execution capabilities, is comfortable working with data and can independently drive marketing initiatives from planning through to implementation and performance evaluation. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is both a strategic thinker and a hands-on executor — someone who can translate marketing plans into well-executed campaigns and measurable outcomes. 

You should be comfortable managing agencies and external partners, working with internal stakeholders, analysing campaign results and taking the initiative to improve performance. 

Above all, you should have a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail and a genuine interest in building brands that connect meaningfully with families. 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Digital Marketing & Agency Management 

  • Plan, coordinate and execute integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms including Google, Meta and other relevant channels to drive brand awareness, enquiries and enrolments. 

  • Manage external digital marketing agencies, including campaign briefs, creative development, budgets, timelines, performance reviews and optimisation. 

  • Monitor campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including website traffic, leads, cost per lead (CPL), lead quality and enrolment conversions. 

  • Work closely with agencies to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, return on investment and marketing efficiency. 

  • Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations. 

2. Social Media & Content Management 

  • Develop and manage social media content plans and calendars across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms. 

  • Plan and execute engaging content that showcases the preschool's curriculum, learning experiences, educators, community engagement and brand proposition. 

  • Oversee content creation, including copywriting, graphic design, photography and short-form video production. 

  • Coordinate content gathering with preschool centres and internal stakeholders to ensure a consistent flow of relevant and engaging content. 

  • Monitor social media performance, audience engagement and emerging trends to continuously improve content effectiveness. 

  • Maintain consistent brand messaging, visual identity and quality across all social media platforms. 

3. Website Management & Digital Presence 

  • Manage and maintain the 7oaks Preschool website using WordPress, ensuring content is accurate, relevant and regularly updated. 

  • Oversee updates to website pages, campaign landing pages, blog articles, promotional content and calls to action. 

  • Coordinate with web developers and external vendors on website enhancements, maintenance and technical issues. 

  • Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console and other relevant analytics platforms. 

  • Work with agencies and vendors to improve search engine visibility, website user experience and lead generation effectiveness. 

  • Support ongoing website enhancement and revamp initiatives where required. 

4. Marketing Communications & Brand Management 

  • Plan and execute marketing communications initiatives across digital and offline channels, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and business objectives. 

  • Develop and coordinate marketing collaterals, including brochures, flyers, posters, banners, digital advertisements, out-of-home (OOH) advertising and promotional materials. 

  • Support corporate communications and internal branding requirements, including staff event collaterals, Dinner & Dance materials, annual reports, presentations and internal announcements. 

  • Liaise with creative agencies, printers, media owners and other vendors to ensure timely and cost-effective production of marketing materials. 

  • Maintain brand consistency across all communications touchpoints. 

  • Support public relations, community outreach and other brand-building opportunities as required. 

5. Corporate Partnerships & Community Outreach 

  • Identify and develop corporate partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads and support preschool enrolment. 

  • Establish and maintain relationships with companies, community organisations and other relevant partners. 

  • Develop partnership proposals, promotional arrangements and joint marketing initiatives. 

  • Coordinate corporate outreach activities, roadshows and partnership activations. 

  • Track partnership activities, leads generated and outcomes to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement. 

6. Campaigns, Events & Performance Reporting 

  • Plan and coordinate marketing support for preschool open houses, Discovery Days, roadshows, enrolment drives and other events. 

  • Work closely with centre leaders and internal stakeholders to ensure marketing initiatives support centre-specific enrolment priorities. 

  • Track marketing performance across channels, including leads, centre visit registrations, visit attendance and enrolment conversions. 

  • Maintain campaign budgets, timelines, marketing calendars and performance reports. 

  • Identify gaps in performance and recommend corrective actions to improve results. 

  • Support other marketing and communications initiatives as assigned. 

Requirements 

  • Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business, Digital Marketing or a related discipline. 

  • Senior Executive: Preferably 3–5 years of relevant marketing experience. 

  • Assistant Manager: Preferably 5–7 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of marketing campaigns and agency relationships. 

  • Strong hands-on experience in digital marketing, including paid advertising, campaign coordination, agency management and performance tracking. 

  • Proven experience managing social media channels, content calendars and creative production. 

  • Practical experience managing websites using WordPress or a similar CMS; familiarity with basic SEO and website analytics. 

  • Good understanding of digital marketing metrics, including CPL, conversion rates, website traffic and campaign ROI. 

  • Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling marketing content and coordinate with diverse stakeholders. 

  • Good eye for design and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar tools. 

  • Experience in offline marketing, collateral production, vendor coordination and event management. 

  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing deadlines. 

  • Resourceful, proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables. 

  • Experience in the education, preschool or family-oriented services sector will be an advantage. 

The appointment level will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and capabilities.

title: Marketing Executive, Performance Marketing
description:
Company Background

GWS Living Art is a Singapore-based urban greentech company specialising in innovative green solutions, including green walls, green roofs and urban greening projects. We work with businesses, organisations and communities to create greener and more sustainable spaces through a combination of design, technology and nature.

Vidacity is a sustainability innovation hub and living lab that brings together startups, businesses and the community to accelerate innovation and tackle sustainability challenges. Through its ecosystem, programmes and engagements, Vidacity supports businesses and organisations in exploring sustainable solutions and creating meaningful impact.

As sister companies within the sustainability ecosystem, GWS Living Art and Vidacity collaborate with businesses, industry partners, startups and other stakeholders to advance sustainability and create positive environmental and social impact.

Brief Description

At GWS Living Art and Vidacity, we believe great marketing goes beyond visibility — it is about creating meaningful experiences that connect people, businesses and communities with sustainability.

As a Marketing Executive within the Performance Marketing division of the Marketing team, you will be responsible for executing and optimising digital campaigns, analysing performance data and driving measurable growth through data-driven strategies. You will work across both GWS Living Art and Vidacity, supporting campaigns, events, services and initiatives that reach both B2B and community audiences.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and strategic thinker with hands-on experience in digital marketing, campaign management and lead generation, together with an interest in sustainability and innovation.

Scope of Work

As a Marketing Executive, you will be part of the Performance Marketing division of the Marketing team and be expected to:

Campaign Management

  • Plan, execute and optimise performance marketing campaigns for assigned events, services and initiatives across various digital channels, including social media, search engines, email and digital advertising platforms.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop compelling ad creatives, landing pages and supporting offline marketing assets.
  • Manage and allocate marketing budgets effectively to achieve campaign objectives and optimise return on investment (ROI).
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns are delivered effectively and on schedule.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Monitor and analyse key performance metrics across digital and offline channels, including website traffic, social media, advertising campaigns, CTR, CPC, CPA, conversion rates and ROI.

  • Use data and customer insights to support marketing and campaign decisions.

Lead Generation

  • Develop and implement strategies to generate and nurture leads through various digital channels.

  • Work with relevant teams to ensure marketing leads are effectively followed up and nurtured.

Engagement & Conversion

  • Create and manage campaigns and content that drive engagement across digital platforms.
  • Monitor engagement and conversion metrics and identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness.

Strategy Development & Market Research

  • Develop and implement data-driven strategies to increase brand awareness, traffic, conversions and customer acquisition.

  • Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, competitor activities and customer preferences.
  • Use market and performance insights to inform and refine marketing strategies.

SEO & SEM

  • Work with SEO consultants and relevant partners to optimise websites and content for search engines and improve organic search visibility.
  • Manage and optimise web content and paid search campaigns to increase visibility and drive relevant traffic.
  • Monitor SEO and SEM performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Other Responsibilities

Requirements

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.

title: Sales & Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and creative Sales & Marketing Executive to manage the company’s sales and marketing activities.

The successful candidate must be comfortable speaking to customers, conducting presentations, developing marketing materials, managing social media platforms, creating EDM campaigns and following up on sales opportunities.

This is a hands-on role suitable for someone who can combine sales ability with digital marketing, content development and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities from existing and prospective customers.
  • Promote Hypercom’s solutions, including Unified Communications, PBX systems, cloud communication services, CCTV, video conferencing, networking, AI-powered solutions and maintenance services.
  • Contact prospective customers through telephone calls, emails, social media, referrals, events and other lead-generation activities.
  • Understand customers’ business and technical requirements before recommending suitable solutions.
  • Prepare sales presentations, proposals, quotations and supporting materials.
  • Conduct face-to-face and online presentations to customers, business partners and management teams.
  • Follow up on quotations, proposals, enquiries and sales leads until closure.
  • Maintain good relationships with customers, technology partners, distributors and vendors.
  • Work with technical and project teams to ensure that proposed solutions meet customer requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, quotations and sales activities.
  • Achieve agreed individual and company sales targets.
  • Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates and activity reports to management.
  • Support customer contract renewals, technology refresh opportunities and cross-selling of additional solutions.
  • Attend customer meetings, exhibitions, seminars, partner events and networking activities when required.

Marketing and Digital Content

  • Plan and manage Hypercom’s overall marketing calendar.
  • Manage and regularly update the company’s social media platforms, including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and other relevant channels.
  • Develop suitable content for social media posts, product announcements, customer success stories, promotions and company updates.
  • Create and distribute EDM campaigns for products, services, events, promotions and customer engagement.
  • Maintain and organise customer and prospect mailing lists.
  • Monitor EDM campaign results, including delivery, open, click and response rates.
  • Prepare marketing presentations, brochures, flyers, product comparisons, event materials and digital advertisements.
  • Coordinate with vendors, principals and business partners on joint marketing campaigns.
  • Update the company website with relevant products, services, events and promotional content.
  • Support search engine, online advertising and lead-generation activities where applicable.
  • Assist in organising customer seminars, product demonstrations, webinars and corporate events.
  • Take suitable photographs and short videos during company activities and events for marketing use.
  • Ensure that all published content is accurate, professional and consistent with Hypercom’s brand identity.
  • Monitor competitors, industry developments and emerging technology trends.
  • Submit regular reports on marketing activities, campaign performance and generated leads.

Presentation Requirements

The candidate must be able to:

  • Prepare clear and professional PowerPoint presentations.
  • Present technology solutions confidently to customers and business partners.
  • Explain technical products in simple business language.
  • Conduct product introductions, demonstrations and proposal presentations.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Represent Hypercom professionally during meetings, exhibitions and events.

Requirements

  • At least two years of relevant experience in sales, business development, digital marketing or a similar customer-facing role is preferred.
  • Experience in the information technology, telecommunications, Unified Communications, CCTV, networking or system integration industry will be an advantage.
  • Strong spoken and written English.
  • Confident in conducting presentations and communicating with customers.
  • Able to prepare sales proposals, quotations, presentation materials and marketing content.
  • Familiar with social media management and EDM campaign tools.
  • Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel and common digital marketing applications.
  • Basic graphic design and video-editing ability using tools such as Canva or similar applications will be an advantage.
  • Self-motivated, organised and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage multiple sales opportunities and marketing campaigns concurrently.
  • Results-oriented and comfortable working towards sales targets.
  • Willing to learn about new technology products and solutions.
  • Able to work closely with sales, technical, project and administrative teams.
  • Possession of a valid Singapore driving licence will be an advantage but is not compulsory.

Remuneration and Benefits

  • Competitive monthly basic salary based on experience and ability.
  • Performance-based sales commission or incentive.
  • Incentives based on individual sales performance, qualified leads, successful campaigns or achievement of agreed targets.
  • Annual performance review.
  • Product, sales and technical training.
  • Opportunities to attend vendor training, seminars and industry events.
  • Career development opportunities within sales, marketing, account management and business development.
  • Mobile phone or transport reimbursement may be provided for approved business expenses in accordance with company policy.
  • Staff welfare activities and company events.

Key Performance Indicators

The employee’s performance may be assessed based on:

  • Sales revenue and gross profit achieved.
  • Number and quality of new sales opportunities generated.
  • Conversion of leads and quotations into confirmed orders.
  • Growth and management of the sales pipeline.
  • Customer follow-up and response time.
  • EDM campaign delivery, engagement and lead generation.
  • Contribution to customer retention, renewals and cross-selling opportunities.

Suitable Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is commercially driven, confident in front of customers and capable of independently carrying out both sales and marketing work. The person should be able to convert technical information into clear customer benefits, create professional marketing content and consistently follow up on opportunities to achieve results.

Application

Interested candidates should submit the following:

  • Updated resume.
  • Current and expected salary.
  • Earliest available commencement date.
  • Examples of presentations, social media content, EDMs or marketing materials previously created, where available.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

-Plan and execute impactful offline initiatives such as open houses, community events, roadshows, and promotional activities.

-Continuously monitor campaign performance, analyse enrolment data, and implement rapid improvements to achieve KPIs.

*Business Development*

-Expand offline marketing channels by establishing strategic partnerships with merchants, community organisations, schools, and other businesses.

-Identify new collaboration opportunities that increase brand awareness and generate quality enrolment leads.

-Represent the organisation at networking events, exhibitions, roadshows, and community outreach programmes.

*Collaboration & Performance*

-Work closely with Principals and Cluster Managers to ensure marketing and sales efforts are aligned with each centre's enrolment goals.

-Take full ownership of enrolment outcomes and proactively recommend new initiatives to outperform competitors.

-Prepare regular reports on lead generation, conversion performance, campaign effectiveness, and partnership outcomes.

*Requirements*

-Proven track record in Sales & Marketing, preferably within the early childhood or education sector.

-Fluent in English for day-to-day operations and team communication.

-Experience in customer service, sales conversion, or enrolment management is highly preferred.

-Strong hands-on experience in both online and offline marketing with demonstrable success in driving sales or enrolment targets.

-Experience in business development, partnerships, or merchant collaborations is an advantage.

-Proficient in digital marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Canva, SEO, and social media marketing.

-Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills with a customer-centric mindset.

-Highly creative, results-oriented, self-motivated, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is an advantage.

*What We Offer*

-Basic Salary: $3,200 – $4,000 (depending on experience), plus performance-based incentives.

-Attractive incentives tied directly to enrolment KPIs, sales performance, and campaign results.

-Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on children's education.

-Supportive and dynamic work environment.

-Professional development and career growth opportunities.

-EP/SP sponsorship may be considered for suitable overseas candidates (subject to eligibility)

title: Business Development & Adviser Marketing Executive
description:
About Us

Global Financial Consultants Pte Ltd (GFC) is one of Singapore’s longest established wealth management and financial advisory firms, located in the heart of the financial district at Raffles Place. The firm delivers tailored, client-centric solutions designed to safeguard clients’ financial futures and help them achieve personal financial goals. GFC’s MAS-regulated Financial Consultants provide honest, unbiased advice across savings and investments, insurance, education planning, estate planning, retirement planning, and wealth management. The team supports both local and expatriate professionals with bespoke strategies for income and family protection, pensions, and CPF-related planning. GFC offers a professional environment focused on long-term relationships, high ethical standards, and continuous career development.

About The Role

We are looking for a commercially driven, creative and proactive Business Development & Adviser Marketing Executive to work closely with an allocated Senior Financial Consultant (SFC). This is a hands-on, dual-function role combining prospecting, appointment setting, digital marketing, creative content production and campaign management to support the SFC's business growth.

The successful candidate will enjoy a performance-based remuneration structure comprising a monthly basic salary and commission, with opportunities to grow alongside the business.

Key Responsibilities

A. Business Development & Lead Generation

  • Identify, research and develop new business opportunities through online channels, professional networks, referrals, events and other suitable prospecting methods.
  • Generate and qualify leads and prospects that fit the SFC's target client profile.
  • Conduct proactive outreach to cold and warm prospects through appropriate communication channels.
  • Contact prospects and existing clients to arrange appointments, follow up on enquiries and coordinate meetings for the SFC.
  • Maintain an organised prospect pipeline, appointment calendar and lead-tracking database.
  • Build and nurture relationships with prospective clients, referral partners and relevant professional networks.
  • Attend networking sessions, industry events and business development activities to identify potential opportunities.
  • Monitor lead conversion, appointment attendance and follow-up outcomes, and recommend improvements to the prospecting process.

B. Adviser Marketing & Digital Content

  • Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns tailored to the SFC's target audience, business objectives and personal brand.
  • Ideate, plan, film and edit engaging short-form videos, reels, interviews and other digital content.
  • Create compelling marketing materials, social media posts, captions, visuals and campaign assets across relevant digital platforms.
  • Manage and maintain the SFC's approved social media presence and content calendar.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to support content ideation, copywriting, editing, repurposing, research and workflow efficiency.
  • Develop creative campaign concepts to increase brand awareness, audience engagement, inbound enquiries and qualified leads.
  • Track and analyse campaign performance, including reach, engagement, enquiries, lead quality, appointment conversion and return on marketing spend where measurable.
  • Prepare regular marketing performance reports and recommend data-driven improvements.
  • Keep abreast of relevant digital marketing trends, content formats, platform developments and emerging AI tools.

C. Business Growth & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with the allocated SFC to understand business priorities, target markets, client profiles and growth objectives.
  • Translate business objectives into actionable prospecting plans and marketing campaigns.
  • Coordinate with internal marketing, compliance and other relevant stakeholders to ensure marketing materials and activities follow GFC's policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, communications, appointments, campaigns and performance metrics.
  • Undertake other relevant business development and adviser marketing responsibilities as required.

Requirements

  • Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in business development, lead generation, digital marketing, content creation or a related field.
  • Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Media, Digital Media or a related discipline.
  • Proven ability to generate leads, engage prospects, arrange appointments and manage business development activities.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing content creation, video editing, or campaign work (personal, academic, or professional).
  • Demonstrated proficiency in video editing software (CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, and/or Adobe After Effects preferred)
  • Experience with AI-powered content creation tools such as Higgsfield, Runway or similar platforms.
  • Basic knowledge of marketing analytics platforms (Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Sprout Social, etc).
  • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects) is preferred.
  • Excellent attention to detail, creativity, and a strong aesthetic sense.
  • Strong communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple campaigns, prospect follow-ups and deadlines independently.
  • Willingness to attend networking events and participate in business development activities outside the office when required.
  • Excellent English proficiency; additional languages relevant to GFC's target markets are an advantage.
  • Experience in financial services, wealth management, insurance, professional services or serving expatriate clients is an advantage.

Remuneration & Benefits

  • Competitive monthly basic salary + commission.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise across business development, digital marketing, creative content and wealth management client acquisition.
  • Collaborative working environment with direct exposure to business growth initiatives.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume together with a portfolio of relevant marketing campaigns, social media content, videos or other examples of their work. Candidates with demonstrable business development results may also include relevant examples of lead generation and appointment-setting achievements.

title: Content Marketing & Social Media Executive
description:
Content Marketing & Social Media Executive

This is a hands-on, highly independent role for someone who can research, strategise, create and execute content across multiple platforms.

You will develop content for two key audiences:

  1. Employers & families — to build trust, brand awareness, organic traffic and enquiries.

  2. Caregivers — to attract qualified job applicants and position Anglo Caregivers as the agency of choice for caregivers seeking employment in Singapore.

What You'll Do

Employer & Brand Content

  • Create educational 3–7 minute videos/podcasts answering common questions about elderly care and live-in caregiving.

  • Develop blog articles, FAQs, infographics, carousels and social media content.

  • Research topics relevant to Singapore families, such as elderly care options, costs, ageing and caregiving.

  • Develop SEO and GEO-optimised content to increase organic visibility.

  • Publish and repurpose content across Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

Caregiver Recruitment Content

  • Work closely with our recruitment team to create TikTok/Reels content.

  • Develop engaging videos that attract qualified caregiver applicants.

  • Create content around caregiver experiences, interviews, job expectations, training and life as a caregiver in Singapore.

  • Build recurring content series that strengthen caregiver trust and loyalty towards Anglo Caregivers.

Research & Strategy

  • Conduct competitor and market research.

  • Identify emerging trends, search topics, FAQs and content opportunities.

  • Monitor content performance and recommend improvements.

  • Develop and manage a monthly content calendar.

  • Proactively propose new content ideas and campaigns.

Content Production

You will be involved in the full process:

Research → Idea → Script → Filming → Editing → Publishing → Analytics → Optimisation

You should be comfortable creating content yourself rather than relying heavily on external agencies.

About Anglo Caregivers

Anglo Caregivers is a Singapore-based specialist live-in caregiver agency helping families care for elderly loved ones at home.

We believe in professional care and personal connections. Our work sits at the intersection of caregiving, ageing, healthcare and the realities families face when caring for their loved ones.

We are looking for our dedicated marketing hire — someone who can take ownership of our content strategy and build Anglo Caregivers into a trusted source of information for both families and caregivers.

This is not a role for someone who simply wants to "manage social media".

We are looking for someone who can think, research, create and execute independently.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–4 years' experience in content marketing, digital marketing, social media, communications, journalism or a related field.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills.

  • Experience creating TikTok/Reels/short-form video content.

  • Basic video filming and editing skills.

  • Understanding of SEO and content marketing.

  • Strong research and analytical skills.

  • Able to work independently and take ownership.

  • Creative, curious and commercially minded.

  • Comfortable using Canva, CapCut or similar tools.

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics/Search Console or SEO tools is an advantage.

  • Experience with healthcare, eldercare, recruitment, HR or other trust-based industries is an advantage.

A strong portfolio is more important to us than qualifications alone.

The Person We're Looking For

You are someone who doesn't wait to be told what to post.

You see a trend, question or opportunity and think:

"This is relevant to our audience. Here's what we should create and why."

You enjoy both creative content production and data-driven decision making, and you want to see your work directly contribute to business growth.

This is an opportunity to build Anglo Caregivers' marketing and content function from the ground up, working closely with the founders, recruitment and care operations teams.

Why Join Anglo Caregivers?

This is an opportunity to build the marketing function of a growing specialist business from the ground up.

You will have significant ownership over:

  • Content strategy

  • Brand voice

  • Social media

  • Video

  • SEO

  • Employer education

  • Caregiver recruitment marketing

You will work directly with the founders and operational/recruitment teams, giving you the opportunity to see the full journey from content → audience → enquiry/application → conversion.

If you enjoy building things rather than simply maintaining an existing marketing machine, this role may be a good fit.


Apply

Please submit your CV and portfolio/examples of content you have personally created, particularly short-form videos, social media campaigns, articles or other content marketing work.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
ABOUT US

The Hey Co Group is a homegrown Singapore F&B group founded in 2016. Over nine years we have built and scaled a portfolio of brands across quick-service, casual dining, cafe, restaurant and bar. We are not a chain. Each brand has its own identity, its own audience, and its own reason to exist — and we obsess over quality and consistency across every touchpoint, including the ones on people's screens.

Social media is where most people meet our brands for the first time. A single Reel can fill a restaurant on a quiet Tuesday. That is why this role sits at the heart of how we grow.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a creative Social Media Executive to support our Branding & Marketing Manager in bringing six distinct brands to life.

You will be the hands-on engine of our social channels — creating content and caring for our communities. You bring the ideas and the execution. The Branding & Marketing Manager brings the strategy and brand direction. Together you will make sure each brand shows up consistently, on time, and looking its best, every single week.

We are a team that embraces AI, and we want someone who uses it to create faster and think bigger — from ideation through to editing.

This is a great role for a creative, platform-native person who wants to do the work, learn fast, and see their content reach thousands of guests.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

No two days look the same. A typical week might involve shooting a new menu launch at one of our cafes in the morning, editing a batch of Reels and Stories over lunch, scheduling the week's posts, replying to a wave of comments and DMs, checking how last week's content performed, and syncing with the Branding & Marketing Manager on an upcoming campaign.

Some days are quiet and edit-heavy. Others are fast, on-location and full of energy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Create content — shoot, edit, schedule and publish posts, Reels and Stories across our brands, following the direction and calendar set with the Branding & Marketing Manager
  • Shoot and edit — capture short-form video and photography in-store and on-location, quickly, with a phone and light kit
  • Community — reply to comments and DMs across assigned brand accounts, engage followers, and keep each brand's tone right. Escalate service issues and complaints to the relevant outlet manager promptly
  • Support campaigns — support the launches, seasonal menus, promotions and collaborations that the Branding & Marketing Manager plans
  • Paid social support — set up and boost posts across Meta and TikTok under the Branding & Marketing Manager's direction. Monitor spend and basic performance, and flag what is and is not working
  • Local SEO support — keep our Google Business Profiles current across outlets (hours, photos, menus, review responses) and apply keyword and caption basics so our content is easier to find
  • KOL coordination — coordinate influencer and food creator visits: scheduling, logistics and hosting on the day
  • Use AI — use AI tools to work faster and smarter: drafting captions and ideas, generating and editing images and video, researching trends, and streamlining your day to day
  • Report — track reach, engagement, saves and follower growth by brand, and share a simple monthly update on what is working and what is not
  • Consistency and ideas — keep each brand's tone, look and quality distinct and consistent, and bring fresh, on-trend ideas to the table

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Essential:

  • One to three years in social media and content — F&B, hospitality, lifestyle or agency
  • A portfolio, showreel, or links to two or three accounts you have personally run. Applications without work samples will not be reviewed
  • A creative, ideas-driven eye for aesthetics, storytelling, and food that looks irresistible
  • Strong hands-on skills across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, plus shooting and editing short-form video and photography
  • Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager at boosting and basic campaign level
  • Basic understanding of local SEO — keywords, captions, hashtags, and Google Business Profile management
  • Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut, image and video generators) to create, ideate and work efficiently
  • Able to juggle several brands and deadlines without dropping quality, and to hold distinct brand voices apart rather than blending them into one
  • Comfortable working in live restaurant environments, including occasional evenings and weekends for shoots
  • A genuine love for food, hospitality, culture and people
  • Based in Singapore and able to travel between our outlets

Advantageous:

  • Basic design ability (Canva, Figma or Adobe)
  • Familiarity with Xiaohongshu
  • Written Mandarin
  • Experience with a multi-outlet or multi-brand group
  • Familiarity with the Singapore F&B and dining scene

HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to HR@theheyco.com:

  1. Your CV
  2. A short note on why this excites you
  3. Links to content you have created — a portfolio, a showreel, or two to three accounts you have run, with a line on what you were responsible for

description:
Company / 公司： ShengWang Tech
Location / 工作地点： The Great World, Singapore

About the Role / 岗位介绍

ShengWang Tech is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Social Media & Marketing Executive / Intern to build and manage our social media presence from 0 to 1 in the Singapore market.

You will independently take ownership of our social media channels, from account setup and content planning to content creation, publishing, community engagement and performance analysis.

ShengWang Tech 正在招聘一名 社交媒体与市场运营专员 / 实习生，面向新加坡市场，从 0 到 1 搭建并运营公司的社交媒体矩阵。

Key Responsibilities / 工作职责

1. Social Media 0–1 Setup & Operations

社媒账号 0–1 搭建与运营

· Build and manage ShengWang Tech’s social media presence from the ground up.

· Develop appropriate positioning, content pillars, tone of voice and operating approaches for different platforms.

· Manage day-to-day publishing, account maintenance and community engagement.

主要平台包括：

International Platforms / 国际平台

· Facebook

· Instagram

· TikTok

· X

· Other relevant platforms

Chinese Platforms / 中文平台

针对不同平台的用户群体、内容生态和传播机制，制定相应的运营方式，而非简单进行同一内容的跨平台复制。

2. Content Planning & Creation

内容策划与制作

· Develop monthly and weekly content calendars.

· Identify relevant topics, trends and content opportunities.

· Create social-first content including posts, graphics, short-form videos and other formats.

· Write and adapt content in both English and Chinese.

· Localise content for Singapore audiences while considering different cultural and platform contexts.

负责日常选题、文案、图片、短视频等内容的策划和制作，并根据国际平台和中文平台特点进行针对性调整。

· Engage with users and help build the company’s online community.

· Experiment with different content formats and growth approaches.

· Explore collaborations, trending topics, creators/KOL/KOC opportunities and relevant communities where appropriate.

持续寻找能够提升品牌曝光、粉丝增长和用户互动的有效方式，而不是机械执行固定内容计划。

4. Performance Analysis & Optimisation

数据分析与持续优化

· Review content performance regularly and identify what works and what does not.

· Turn insights into concrete improvements to future content and campaigns.

· Prepare simple periodic performance reports.

我们希望你不仅关注“发布了多少内容”，也关注 哪些内容有效、为什么有效，以及下一步如何做得更好。

5. Marketing Support & Future Development

市场营销及岗位发展

As the role develops, responsibilities will gradually expand beyond social media into broader marketing activities, including:

· Marketing campaign planning and execution

· Business/product promotion

· Online and offline campaign support

· Promotional materials and marketing content

· Partnership and collaboration initiatives

· Brand communication

· Supporting day-to-day marketing operations for relevant business lines

随着业务和岗位的发展，该职位未来将逐步从 Social Media 扩展至更完整的 Marketing 职能，包括业务线的日常市场运营、品牌宣传、活动策划、营销项目执行以及其他相关工作。

具备很强的 Ownership。相比“等任务、等指导”，我们更希望你能够主动发现问题、研究问题并推动解决。

对社交媒体有较强敏感度，理解短视频、图文内容及不同平台的基本内容逻辑和用户习惯。

· Short-form video shooting and editing skills

· Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads or other paid social platforms

· Good understanding of Singapore’s local consumer and social media environment

相比单纯的学历或工作年限，我们更看重 实际能力、学习速度、审美、执行力以及解决问题的能力。

AI-Friendly Workplace / 欢迎使用 AI

We actively encourage the appropriate use of AI tools to improve productivity and creativity.

You are welcome to use AI for:

· Research and brainstorming

· Content ideation

· Copywriting

· Translation and localisation

· Image and video creation

· Data analysis

· Workflow automation

· Learning new skills

We care about the quality of the final output and your judgement, rather than whether every task is completed manually.

可以使用 ChatGPT 等 AI 工具辅助信息研究、创意、文案、翻译、图片与视频制作、数据分析、自动化以及学习。
