Who We Think Will Fit / 我们期待的你

You may be a good fit if you:

· Are proactive rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

· Enjoy figuring things out from scratch.

· Have good judgement and attention to detail.

· Are creative but also execution-oriented.

· Are comfortable working independently.

· Are curious about new tools, technologies and AI.

· Want to grow beyond social media into broader marketing responsibilities.

如果你喜欢从 0 到 1 做事情，遇到问题愿意自己研究，希望自己的工作能够真正影响业务，而不是只执行固定流程，这个岗位会比较适合你。

Fresh graduates and students are welcome to apply. Strong portfolios, personal projects or demonstrated capabilities may be more valuable than years of experience.

欢迎优秀应届毕业生及实习生申请。我们不会单纯以工作年限判断候选人，优秀的作品、个人项目和实际能力同样重要。

title: E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive (US Market)
description:
JOB DEFINITION

The E-commerce & Social Media Growth Executive is responsible for building ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media presence and measurable off-Amazon traffic for the US market.

This is not a traditional customer-service role and does not depend on influencer partnerships. Even if no external creator works with us, employees will continue building ChoiceRefill’s own social media channels, content library and customer-acquisition assets.

ODORSEAL is hiring two employees for this position. Each employee will be assigned individual content projects, social media activities, Amazon Attribution links and measurable results. Both employees will be cross-trained to provide backup coverage when required, while individual project ownership and attributable results remain separately recorded.

ABOUT ODORSEAL AND CHOICEREFILL

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based consumer-products and product-development company.

Our ChoiceRefill brand has been selling round diaper-pail refills to US customers through Amazon since 2017. ChoiceRefill is a practical, repeat-purchase household product that helps families find compatible, easy-to-use and cost-effective refill options.

ChoiceRefill is not a simple trading or standard private-label product. The company has independently developed its production lines, product structure and manufacturing processes.

We continue to improve film performance, production efficiency, product compatibility, packaging structure and the overall user experience. These product-development and manufacturing capabilities create a meaningful technical and operational barrier to entry that many ordinary e-commerce products do not have.

Employees will have the opportunity to understand how a consumer product moves from product development and manufacturing to Amazon sales, customer feedback, product improvement and repeat purchases.

ESTABLISHED AMAZON FOUNDATION

The company founder has many years of practical Amazon e-commerce experience and a clear understanding of product positioning, pricing, traffic, conversion, profitability and repeat purchases.

The founder is responsible for:

• Amazon Listing creation and optimisation
• Product images, selling points and page structure
• Amazon on-platform advertising
• Pricing and promotion strategy
• Product positioning and pack-size strategy
• Purchasing, inventory and core business decisions
• Product compliance and overall brand direction

Employees are not required to build Amazon Listings from the beginning or independently operate Amazon advertising.

Instead, employees will work from an established product, supply-chain, Listing and advertising foundation to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content, social media channels and measurable off-Amazon traffic.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. BUILD BRAND-OWNED CONTENT ASSETS — APPROXIMATELY 35%

Create practical English-language content that answers real customer questions and supports Amazon purchase decisions.

Content may include:

• Compatibility demonstrations for tested round diaper-pail models
• How to identify compatible and incompatible pail structures
• Installation, film-pulling, cutting, tying and refill-replacement instructions
• Troubleshooting for common installation problems
• Guidance on choosing between 3-pack, 4-pack, 6-pack and 8-pack options
• Guidance for existing ChoiceRefill customers moving from older products to the latest version
• Explanations of product length, capacity, value and intended use
• Frequently asked questions based on real customer concerns

Employees do not always need to appear on camera. Clear product demonstrations, hand movements, close-up shots, captions and simple voiceovers are acceptable.

Strong master content should be repurposed into suitable formats for the company website and different social media platforms.

The objective is not to publish content simply to appear busy. The objective is to build an accurate, reusable content library that helps customers understand the product and make the correct purchase decision.

  1. OPERATE BRAND SOCIAL MEDIA AND GENERATE ORGANIC TRAFFIC — APPROXIMATELY 25%

Support and operate ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned social media channels, which may include TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Pinterest and Facebook.

Responsibilities include:

• Maintaining a practical content calendar
• Publishing approved content consistently
• Adapting content for each platform and audience
• Writing clear English captions, titles and calls to action
• Responding appropriately to relevant public questions and comments
• Participating helpfully in relevant online discussions while respecting community rules
• Directing interested customers to the correct Amazon product page
• Checking that every published Amazon link is accurate and traceable
• Reusing effective content across suitable channels

ChoiceRefill’s social media and off-Amazon growth activities must be able to operate normally without relying on external influencers.

  1. RESEARCH CUSTOMER DEMAND AND IMPROVE CONVERSION — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Actively identify what US customers need to know before making a purchase.

Research sources may include:

• Amazon customer reviews and product questions
• Competitor reviews and recurring complaints
• Customer enquiries received through the ChoiceRefill website
• Social media comments and discussions
• Search suggestions and frequently asked questions
• Feedback from existing ChoiceRefill customers
• Performance data from previously published content

Turn useful findings into:

• New content topics
• FAQ improvements
• Troubleshooting guides
• Website updates
• Product-information recommendations
• Clear suggestions for Amazon Listing improvement for the founder’s consideration

Employees should report “problem + evidence + recommendation,” rather than forwarding screenshots without analysis.

  1. TRACK RESULTS AND RUN GROWTH EXPERIMENTS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Use Amazon Attribution and internal tracking sheets to measure employee-owned content and traffic sources.

Responsibilities include:

• Using an approved tracking link for each content item
• Recording the platform, content ID, product, publication date and responsible employee
• Monitoring clicks, product-page activity, purchases and attributable sales
• Comparing different topics, formats, openings, captions and calls to action
• Identifying content that attracts clicks but does not result in purchases
• Recommending which content should be repeated, improved or discontinued
• Preparing a short weekly performance summary
• Maintaining accurate content and campaign records

Each employee will receive a separately assigned Amazon Attribution link structure so that individual contributions can be measured.

  1. SUPPORT DAILY E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS — APPROXIMATELY 15%

Support the founder by completing and following up on routine work surrounding the Amazon business.

Responsibilities may include:

• Checking whether key products are available for sale
• Monitoring obvious price, stock, variation, image or link abnormalities
• Tracking approved inventory, inbound-shipment and replenishment matters
• Maintaining product information, packaging files, images and version records
• Organising sales or advertising reports and highlighting meaningful exceptions
• Preparing supporting information for platform cases
• Following up on approved changes and confirming completion
• Escalating urgent issues with evidence and a recommended next step

Employees do not independently change Amazon advertising, Listings, prices, purchasing plans or budgets.

  1. HANDLE LIMITED CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES — UP TO 10%

Customer service is a small, on-demand part of this position.

Most ChoiceRefill customers understand and purchase the product directly through Amazon. The role is not expected to spend most of the working day handling enquiries.

Responsibilities include:

• Checking the company website for customer enquiries
• Answering questions about compatibility, installation and product use
• Following up on unresolved matters
• Classifying recurring customer problems
• Updating approved response templates and FAQ drafts
• Turning repeated questions into useful content or improvement recommendations

When customer-service volume is low, the available time will be redirected to content creation, social media operation, research and growth experiments.

  1. OPTIONAL CREATOR AND INFLUENCER COLLABORATION — 0% TO 10%

Creator partnerships are an additional growth opportunity, not the foundation of this role.

When a genuinely suitable US parenting, household or value-focused creator is identified, employees may:

• Evaluate the creator’s audience and content quality
• Make initial contact
• Explain the product clearly
• Coordinate approved product samples
• Prepare a content brief
• Follow up on agreed timelines
• Record published content and measurable outcomes

Employees are not required to contact creators simply to fill working hours. Creator activity should expand only when it produces useful content, qualified traffic, measurable sales or a valuable long-term relationship.

Time used for creator partnerships will be allocated from the social media and organic-growth portion of the role.

INDIVIDUAL ATTRIBUTION AND SALES INCENTIVES

The fixed basic salary is S$3,400 per month and covers the normal responsibilities of the position.

In addition to the basic salary:

• Employees may receive a monthly performance bonus based on execution quality, accuracy, follow-up discipline, teamwork and backup capability
• Each employee will be assigned a separate Amazon Attribution link structure for employee-owned content
• Eligible individual sales incentives will be calculated using valid, finalised Amazon data
• Refunds, cancellations, self-purchases, abnormal traffic and ineligible activity will not be counted
• Individual attributable-sales incentives do not have a fixed upper limit
• The calculation method will be provided in writing so that employees can understand and verify their results

External Amazon Associates or Amazon Influencers may use their own affiliate links. Such partnerships will be assessed separately and will not replace the employee’s responsibility to build ChoiceRefill’s brand-owned content and traffic.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A successful employee will not wait for the founder to assign every daily task.

You should be able to:

• Identify useful customer questions independently
• Convert customer questions into content ideas
• Produce or help produce clear product content
• Publish content using the correct tracking link
• Review the resulting performance data
• Decide what should be improved next
• Maintain accurate and complete records
• Follow up until work is completed
• Provide reliable backup coverage when required
• Explain problems using evidence and practical recommendations

Success is not measured only by the number of posts published, messages sent or hours spent.

We value work that is accurate, reusable, commercially useful and capable of producing measurable improvement.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN

Using real operating data and active commercial projects, the company founder will help employees understand:

• How to identify real customer demand
• How to distinguish views, clicks and purchases
• How to evaluate the commercial value of content
• How to use Amazon Attribution to measure off-Amazon activities
• How pricing, conversion rates, sales, costs and profit are connected
• How customer feedback can lead to content and product improvements
• How to turn one-time tasks into repeatable SOPs
• How product development, manufacturing and supply chains affect a consumer-products business
• How to participate in business decisions using a “problem + evidence + recommendation” approach

This role is suitable for candidates at an early stage of their careers who want to develop long-term commercial judgement, product thinking and independent problem-solving ability.

REQUIREMENTS

• Strong written English, with the ability to communicate clearly with US customers and write natural social media content
• Chinese reading and writing ability, as internal SOPs, training materials, product-development information and reporting templates are currently maintained in Chinese
• Proactive and organised, with the ability to continue work without constant reminders
• Comfortable maintaining accurate records in Excel or Google Sheets
• Able to learn from customer feedback and performance data
• Willing to perform practical content work, including simple filming, editing and publishing
• Comfortable working with a practical household consumable rather than relying only on fashionable or entertainment-focused content
• Able to work with a colleague, review each other’s work and provide backup coverage
• Careful with product facts, compatibility information and customer-facing claims

Fresh graduates and candidates with internship, freelance or personal-project experience are welcome. Prior Amazon experience is not required.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in any of the following areas will be helpful:

• E-commerce operations
• Social media management
• Content creation
• Short-form video production
• Digital marketing
• Customer service
• Community management
• Creator or influencer coordination
• US consumer markets
• Household, parenting or baby-care products

Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Excel, Google Sheets and commonly used generative-AI tools is an advantage.

Candidates do not need to have a large personal following or maintain a public influencer account. Examples of content, school projects, freelance work, previously managed brand accounts or a simple portfolio are welcome.

WHAT WE PROVIDE

• Fixed basic salary of S$3,400 per month
• Monthly performance bonus
• Uncapped individual attributable-sales incentive
• Established US Amazon sales infrastructure
• Amazon Listings and on-platform advertising managed by the company founder
• Products supported by independent product-development and manufacturing capabilities
• Access to real product, sales, traffic and customer-feedback data
• Structured product training, SOPs, templates and tracking systems
• Direct participation in building a US consumer brand
• Exposure to the complete commercial process from product and manufacturing to content, traffic and sales
• Business guidance from a founder with many years of practical e-commerce experience
• Individual results that can be recorded and measured clearly
• Opportunities to earn additional income based on verified sales contributions

APPLICATION

Please submit your resume through MyCareersFuture.

You may include links to two or three examples of content, writing, videos, social media accounts or projects you have worked on. A portfolio is welcome but not compulsory.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief practical exercise involving:

• A customer compatibility response
• A short product-content idea
• A simple Amazon traffic or content-tracking task

The exercise is intended only to assess practical thinking and communication ability. It will not be used as unpaid commercial work.

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD. recruits and selects candidates based on their ability, relevant skills and suitability for the position.
岗位定义

电商与社媒增长专员负责为ChoiceRefill美国市场建立品牌自有内容、社媒影响力和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。

这不是一个传统客服岗位，也不是一个依赖红人合作才能开展工作的岗位。即使没有任何外部创作者与我们合作，员工仍然需要持续建设ChoiceRefill自己的社媒账号、内容资料库和客户获取资产。

ODORSEAL将为这个岗位招聘两名员工。每名员工分别负责各自的内容项目、社媒活动、Amazon Attribution归因链接和可衡量结果。

两名员工都会接受交叉培训，并在需要时为对方提供备岗支持。但是，每个人原有的项目、内容和可归因销售结果都会分别记录。

关于ODORSEAL和ChoiceRefill

ODORSEAL PTE. LTD.是一家位于新加坡的消费品和产品开发公司。

旗下ChoiceRefill品牌自2017年起，通过美国Amazon销售圆形尿布桶替换装。ChoiceRefill是一款实用的家庭重复购买型消耗品，帮助美国家庭找到兼容、易用且更具性价比的替换装。

ChoiceRefill不是简单的贸易产品或标准贴牌产品。公司自主开发了生产线、产品结构和制造工艺。

我们持续改进薄膜性能、生产效率、产品兼容性、包装结构和整体用户体验。这些产品开发和制造能力形成了有实际意义的技术及运营门槛，是许多普通电商产品不具备的。

公司的业务能力覆盖：

  • 产品研发；

  • 自主开发的生产工艺；

  • 制造和质量控制；

  • 包装和供应链执行；

  • Amazon销售；

  • 客户反馈；

  • 持续产品改进。

加入ODORSEAL后，员工将有机会了解一款消费品如何从产品研发和制造，走向市场验证、客户反馈和持续复购。

已经建立的Amazon经营基础

公司负责人拥有多年Amazon电商实战经验，对产品定位、价格、流量、转化、利润和复购之间的关系具有清楚的理解。

公司负责人负责：

  • Amazon Listing的建立和优化；

  • 产品图片、核心卖点和页面结构；

  • Amazon站内广告；

  • 定价及促销策略；

  • 产品定位及包装规格策略；

  • 采购、库存和核心经营决策；

  • 产品合规及整体品牌方向。

员工不需要从零建立Amazon Listing，也不需要独立操作Amazon站内广告。

员工将在公司已经具备产品、供应链、Listing和广告基础的情况下，继续建立ChoiceRefill的品牌自有内容、社媒渠道和可衡量的Amazon站外流量。

主要工作职责

一、建立品牌自有内容资产——约占35%

制作能够回答真实客户问题、帮助客户完成Amazon购买决策的实用英文内容。

内容可能包括：

  • 已完成实测的圆形尿布桶型号兼容演示；

  • 如何辨认兼容和不兼容的尿布桶结构；

  • 安装、抽膜、切袋、打结和更换替换盒的操作说明；

  • 常见安装问题的排查方法；

  • 3盒、4盒、6盒和8盒包装的选择建议；

  • ChoiceRefill老客户从旧版产品转换到新版产品的说明；

  • 产品长度、容量、价值和适用场景说明；

  • 根据真实客户问题整理的常见问答。

员工不一定需要本人出镜。清楚的产品演示、手部操作、产品特写、字幕和简单配音都可以使用。

优质的母内容应当根据公司官网和不同社媒平台的需要，拆分和改编为相应格式。

我们的目标不是为了显得忙碌而发布内容，而是建立一个准确、可以重复使用，并能帮助客户理解产品和作出正确购买决定的内容资料库。

二、运营品牌社媒并获取自然流量——约占25%

协助运营ChoiceRefill自主拥有的社媒账号，包括但不限于TikTok、Instagram、YouTube Shorts、Pinterest和Facebook。

主要工作包括：

  • 维护清楚实用的内容日历；

  • 按计划持续发布经过批准的内容；

  • 根据不同平台和受众调整内容；

  • 编写清楚自然的英文标题、文案和行动指引；

  • 适当回复相关的公开问题和评论；

  • 在遵守社区规则的前提下，参与相关网络讨论并提供有帮助的答案；

  • 将有购买兴趣的客户引导到正确的Amazon商品页面；

  • 检查每个已发布的Amazon链接是否准确、有效和可追踪；

  • 将已经验证有效的内容合理复用到其他渠道。

ChoiceRefill的社媒和站外增长工作必须能够在不依赖外部红人的情况下正常运行。

三、研究客户需求并改善转化——约占15%

主动寻找美国客户在购买前真正需要了解的信息。

可以参考的信息来源包括：

  • Amazon客户评价和商品问答；

  • 竞品评价及反复出现的投诉；

  • ChoiceRefill独立站收到的客户咨询；

  • 社媒评论和相关讨论；

  • 搜索建议和常见问题；

  • ChoiceRefill现有客户的反馈；

  • 已发布内容的表现数据。

员工需要把有价值的发现转化为：

  • 新的内容选题；

  • FAQ改进；

  • 故障排查指南；

  • 官网内容更新；

  • 产品信息改善建议；

  • 提供给公司负责人参考的Amazon Listing优化建议。

提交问题时，应采用“问题＋证据＋建议”的方式，而不是只转发截图而不进行分析。

四、跟踪结果并开展增长测试——约占15%

使用Amazon Attribution和公司内部追踪表，衡量员工负责的内容和流量来源。

主要工作包括：

  • 为每项内容使用经过批准的追踪链接；

  • 记录平台、内容编号、对应产品、发布日期和负责人；

  • 跟踪点击、商品页面活动、购买和可归因销售；

  • 对比不同内容主题、形式、开头、文案和行动指引的表现；

  • 找出有点击但没有产生购买的内容；

  • 建议哪些内容应该继续、修改或停止；

  • 每周提交一份简短的表现总结；

  • 准确维护内容和推广活动记录。

公司将为每名员工分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系，以便准确衡量个人贡献。

五、支持日常电商运营——约占15%

通过完成和跟进Amazon业务周边的日常工作，减少公司负责人处理例行事务的时间。

工作可能包括：

  • 检查重点产品是否正常在售；

  • 监控明显的价格、库存、变体、图片或链接异常；

  • 跟进已经批准的库存、入仓和补货事项；

  • 维护产品资料、包装文件、图片及版本记录；

  • 整理销售或广告报表，并标出有实际意义的异常；

  • 准备平台问题处理需要的支持资料；

  • 跟进已经批准的修改，并确认是否完成；

  • 发现紧急问题时，连同证据和建议处理方式一起上报。

员工不得自行调整Amazon广告、Listing、价格、采购计划或预算。

六、处理少量客户咨询——最多占10%

客户服务是本岗位中工作量较小、按照实际需求发生的工作。

大部分ChoiceRefill客户会直接通过Amazon了解并购买产品，因此本岗位不会把大部分工作时间用于处理客户咨询。

主要工作包括：

  • 检查公司独立站收到的客户咨询；

  • 回复兼容、安装和产品使用问题；

  • 跟进尚未解决的问题；

  • 对反复出现的客户问题进行分类；

  • 更新经过批准的回复模板和FAQ草稿；

  • 把重复问题转化为有用的内容或改进建议。

当客户咨询量较少时，相应时间将自动转移到内容制作、社媒运营、需求研究和增长测试。

七、选择性开展创作者和红人合作——占0%至10%

创作者合作是额外的增长机会，不是本岗位存在的基础。

当员工发现真正适合的美国育儿、家庭生活或性价比消费类创作者时，可以：

  • 评估创作者的受众和内容质量；

  • 进行初步联系；

  • 清楚介绍产品；

  • 协调已经批准的产品样品；

  • 准备内容要求；

  • 跟进双方约定的时间；

  • 记录已经发布的内容和可衡量结果。

公司不要求员工为了填满工作时间而联系创作者。只有当红人合作能够产生有价值的内容、合格流量、可衡量销售或有价值的长期合作关系时，才会逐步扩大投入。

红人合作所需时间将从社媒和自然流量工作时间中调配，不会额外增加整体工作比例。

个人归因与销售奖励

S$3,400的固定月薪对应本岗位的正常工作职责。

除固定月薪外：

  • 员工可以根据执行质量、数据准确性、跟进纪律、团队协作和备岗能力获得月度绩效奖金；

  • 公司会为每名员工负责的品牌自有内容分配独立的Amazon Attribution链接体系；

  • 个人销售奖励以Amazon最终确认的有效数据为依据；

  • 退款、取消订单、自购、异常流量和不符合规定的活动不计入奖励；

  • 个人可归因销售奖励不设固定上限；

  • 公司会以书面形式提供计算方法，确保员工能够理解并核对自己的结果。

外部Amazon Associates或Amazon Influencers可能使用其自己的联盟链接。这类合作将单独评估，不能代替员工建设ChoiceRefill品牌自有内容和流量的基本责任。

怎样才算在这个岗位上取得成功

一名表现优秀的员工，不会等待公司负责人每天逐项分配任务。

你应该能够：

  • 主动发现有价值的客户问题；

  • 将客户问题转化为内容选题；

  • 制作或协助制作清楚的产品内容；

  • 使用正确的追踪链接发布内容；

  • 查看内容产生的表现数据；

  • 判断下一步应该改进什么；

  • 保持准确、完整的工作记录；

  • 持续跟进，直到工作真正完成；

  • 在需要时提供可靠的备岗支持；

  • 使用证据和可执行建议说明问题。

公司不会只按照发布数量、发送消息数量或投入的时间判断员工表现。

我们更看重准确、可以重复使用、具有实际商业价值并能够产生可衡量改善的工作成果。

你能够学习什么

公司负责人会结合真实经营数据和实际商业项目，帮助员工理解：

  • 如何判断真实客户需求；

  • 如何区分浏览量、点击量和实际购买；

  • 如何判断一项内容是否具有商业价值；

  • 如何通过Amazon Attribution衡量站外活动；

  • 如何理解价格、转化率、销售额、成本和利润之间的关系；

  • 如何把客户反馈转化为内容改进和产品改进；

  • 如何把一次性任务建立成可重复执行的SOP；

  • 产品开发、制造和供应链如何影响消费品业务；

  • 如何用“问题＋证据＋建议”的方式参与经营决策。

员工将逐步学习为什么要完成一项工作、如何判断结果，以及下一步应该如何改进。

这份工作适合处于职业发展早期，并希望建立长期商业判断、产品思维和独立解决问题能力的候选人。

任职要求

  • 具备良好的英文书面表达能力，能够清楚地与美国客户沟通，并编写自然的英文社媒内容；

  • 具备中文阅读和书写能力，因为公司的内部SOP、培训资料、产品开发信息和报告模板目前均使用中文；

  • 做事主动、有条理，无须持续提醒也能继续推进工作；

  • 能够使用Excel或Google Sheets维护准确的工作记录；

  • 能够根据客户反馈和表现数据持续学习；

  • 愿意完成实际内容工作，包括简单拍摄、剪辑和发布；

  • 能够接受实用型家庭消耗品，不只对时尚、娱乐或容易制造话题的产品感兴趣；

  • 能够与同事协作、互相检查并提供备岗支持；

  • 对产品事实、兼容信息和面向客户的宣传内容保持谨慎。

欢迎应届毕业生，以及拥有实习、自由职业或个人项目经验的候选人申请。不要求具备Amazon运营经验。

优先考虑的经验

拥有以下任何一项经验者优先：

  • 电商运营；

  • 社媒账号管理；

  • 内容创作；

熟悉Canva、CapCut、Excel、Google Sheets和常用生成式AI工具者优先。

候选人不需要拥有大量个人粉丝，也不需要经营公开的网红账号。欢迎提供内容案例、学校项目、自由职业项目、曾经管理的品牌账号或简单作品集。

公司提供

  • S$3,400固定月薪；

  • 月度绩效奖金；

  • 不设固定上限的个人可归因销售奖励；

  • 已经建立的美国Amazon销售基础；

  • 由公司负责人管理的Amazon Listing和站内广告；

  • 具有自主产品开发和制造能力支持的产品；

  • 真实的产品、销售、流量和客户反馈数据；

  • 系统化的产品培训、SOP、模板和数据追踪系统；

  • 直接参与美国消费品牌建设的机会；

  • 从产品和制造到内容、流量和销售结果的完整商业流程经验；

  • 由拥有多年电商实战经验的公司负责人提供业务指导；

  • 能够被清楚记录和衡量的个人工作成果；

  • 根据可核实销售贡献获得额外收入的机会。

申请方式

请通过MyCareersFuture提交简历。

候选人可以附上两至三个自己参与过的内容、文章、视频、社媒账号或项目案例。作品集不是强制要求。

入围候选人可能会被邀请完成一项简短的实际能力测试，包括：

  • 回复一个客户兼容性问题；

  • 提出一个简短的产品内容创意；

  • 完成一个简单的Amazon站外流量或内容追踪任务。

该测试只用于评估候选人的实际思考和沟通能力，不会被公司作为免费的商业内容使用。

title: Social Media Operations Executive
description:
Established in 1973 with headquarters in Seoul, South Korea, Cheil Worldwide is one of the world’s leading integrated marketing communications networks, with more than 7,200 employees globally in more than 54 offices in 46 countries.

IRIS Singapore, a creative, strategic and innovative company that uses the power of participation to excite progress for businesses has recently become part of the Cheil family. As part of their diverse team, we would like to invite you to participate in their progress – moving yourself and the world forward with every decision you make. Iris’s bustling office is situated in the district of Singapore, proudly embodies the best within the APAC region, home to an eclectic team of 60 with deep specialism, they are proud to be the creative agency for Trust, Samsung, Alcon and other leading brands in the region.

We are inviting candidates for the position of:

Social Media Operations Executive

We are looking for a meticulous Social Media Executive to join Iris Singapore Team in supporting Samsung’s global social media operations. The role will focus on content validation coordination and management, while supporting content management and community management with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) across all key social media channels.

The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable navigating fast-paced, cross-functional workflows. As the primary liaison with other stakeholders, you will be responsible for coordinating workflows and ensuring operational requirements are accurately communicated. This will provide many learning opportunities for anyone who loves all things social content and wants to build out their expertise in this field into a fledgling social media management career.

Job Description:

  • Manage end-to-end content requests from local markets and content creators, ensuring all deliverables meet social media best practices, brand and platform requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with HQ and internal teams to ensure seamless execution of content workflows and minimise operational gaps or errors.
  • Track and maintain workflow statuses across multiple touchpoints and platforms to ensure timely delivery and accurate reporting.
  • Review and validate content for brand alignment, platform suitability, compliance, and quality standards before publication.
  • Identify key KOL content opportunities and proactively engage KOL and their communities through effective community management.
  • Systematically catalogue and organise approved assets systematically for efficient retrieval, reporting, and future reuse.
  • Maintain meticulous attention to detail to safeguard against content inaccuracies, permission issues, or asset mismanagement.
  • Write, edit, and adapt social media copy in line with brand tone of voice and platform best practices.
  • Publish and schedule content ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and consistency.
  • Monitor conversations and support crisis management by identifying sensitive issues early and escalating risks appropriately.

Qualifications:

  • Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, or related fields.
  • Min. of 2-year experience in social media, community management, or account management roles.
  • Strong written communication skills and a good sense of tone.
  • Familiarity with Instagram features and best practices.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing manual, detail-heavy processes.
  • Interest in mobile photography or tech brands is a plus.
  • Meticulous, process-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Hands-on experience with social media management and analytics platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Brandwatch, or equivalent enterprise tools.
  • While not a mandatory requirement, professional proficiency in Korean (spoken and written) would be beneficial, as this role may involve supporting Korean-speaking clients and collaborating with Korean-speaking client teams to facilitate effective communication and project delivery.

title: Senior Executive, Public Relations
description:
The Senior Executive, Public Relations supports NTUC Club’s external communications, corporate reputation and earned-media efforts across its B2B and B2C portfolio of brands. The role develops accurate, newsworthy and audience-relevant publicity materials; supports key messaging for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives; builds relationships with media, influencers and PR partners; coordinates media engagement; and monitors coverage, public sentiment and emerging issues. The Senior Executive is expected to work closely with internal stakeholders to understand business priorities, secure factual and management clearances, protect NTUC Club’s reputation and strengthen sustained brand visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • PR planning and story development

Support the development and delivery of integrated PR plans that strengthen NTUC Club’s corporate reputation across its B2B and B2C portfolios. Identify newsworthy angles, shape story narratives and key messages for corporate announcements, campaigns and strategic initiatives, and maintain a forward publicity pipeline aligned with organisational and business priorities.

  • Media materials and editorial

Draft, edit and proofread media releases, advisories, interview pitches, media invitations, fact sheets, FAQs, holding statements, speeches, talking points and briefing notes. Ensure materials are clear, accurate, aligned with NTUC Club’s house style and tone of voice, and ready for the intended audience and channel.

  • Media pitching, relations and engagement

Develop and proactively pitch tailored story angles to relevant journalists, editors and producers to secure earned-media opportunities. Build and maintain strong working relationships with media contacts, PR partners and relevant stakeholders; disseminate approved materials; manage follow-ups; and respond promptly and professionally to media enquiries and requests to drive coverage, publicity and brand visibility.

  • Interviews and spokesperson support

Coordinate interview opportunities, media briefings and on-site coverage. Prepare spokesperson briefs, anticipated questions and approved messages; manage logistics and ensure relevant internal stakeholders are aligned before engagement.

  • Media events, drops and influencer engagement

Plan and execute media previews, invitations, media drops and relevant influencer engagements. Manage guest lists, RSVPs, materials, gifting and on-site requirements while ensuring appropriate approvals, records and follow-up.

  • Media monitoring and reporting

Monitor media coverage, public sentiment and relevant conversations; maintain accurate clipping records; and prepare PR reports post-campaign. Assess results against agreed indicators, highlight sentiment and emerging issues, recommend actions where necessary, and capture learnings and recommendations for future outreach.

  • Issues and crisis communications support

Monitor for potential reputational issues, escalate concerns promptly and support crisis communications planning and response across external channels in accordance with the approved Incident and Media Management SOP. Assist with fact gathering, holding lines, stakeholder coordination, media monitoring and post-incident documentation.

  • Stakeholder and clearance management

Work with business units, corporate stakeholders, Customer Experience, PR partners and other relevant teams to obtain complete information, visuals and factual confirmation, and to address reputational issues and opportunities. Maintain clear review and approval trails, and ensure materials are not disseminated before the required departmental, management and business unit clearances are secured.

  • PR platforms, databases and records

Maintain the media database, campaign media lists, PR WIP, coverage folders, templates, approved materials and decision history in SharePoint. Support the effective use and administration of media-monitoring and PR tools.

  • Budget, vendor and governance support

Track approved PR spend, quotations and commitments; brief and coordinate vendors; and maintain supporting procurement, reconciliation, evaluation and audit documentation in accordance with internal requirements.

Requirements:

  • Degree or diploma in Mass Communications, Public Relations, Media Studies, Journalism or a related field.
  • At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in public relations, media relations, corporate communications or a related communications role.
  • Proven experience in media pitching, developing newsworthy story angles and securing earned media opportunities.
  • Exceptional writing, copywriting, editing and proofreading skills, with strong news judgement and critical-thinking ability.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate internal teams, media contacts, agencies and vendors.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment while supporting both B2B and B2C portfolios.
  • Ability to multitask, manage competing priorities and deadlines, and respond calmly and promptly to emerging media or reputational issues.

Note: This scope of work is not limited to the above and may include additional responsibilities under the Group Marketing, Communications and Brand department, as required by business needs.

  • Conceptualise, script, coordinate, produce and edit short-form video and social media content for NIE’s platforms, including reels, event highlights, explainer clips, campaign posts and other digital formats.
  • Plan and adapt content for different social media platforms, taking into account audience needs, platform formats, post timing, captions, visual assets, accessibility considerations and performance insights.
  • Create, schedule and refine social media content in collaboration with the social media team, ensuring that posts are accurate, timely, engaging and aligned with NIE’s tone and positioning.
  • Support NIE departments with content and campaign needs, including coordinating copy, visuals, short-form video, digital assets or other production requirements for institutional communications.

Stakeholder and Event Support

  • Provide general coordination support for official visits, institutional events and guest-facing activities, including logistics, liaison, on-site support and follow-up where required.
  • Assist with visitor experience touchpoints and other stakeholder engagement activities as required.
  • Support institutional events such as graduation ceremonies by assisting with coordination, capturing content opportunities, and supporting related video or social media production needs.

Media Content and Communications Support

  • Support the identification of mainstream media coverage, stories or institutional announcements that can be repurposed into social media posts, short-form videos or other digital content.
  • Provide general support for media-related activities when required, including coordinating inputs, preparing basic materials, and adapting approved messages for use across NIE’s digital and social channels.
  • Monitor media coverage and digital content performance to identify useful story angles, content opportunities and audience insights for NIE’s communications channels.
  • Provide communications support for selected alumni programmes and activities, including adapting approved messages or event highlights into suitable digital content where required.

Requirements

  • A polytechnic diploma  in Communications, Marketing, Digital Media, Film, Media Production, Journalism or a related field.
  • Prior experience in content creation, social media management, video production, digital communications, journalism, marketing communications or agency work  is advantageous.
  • At least two years of work experience.
  • Strong writing, editing and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to produce clear captions, short-form scripts, social media posts, video storyboards and simple multimedia content for different audiences.
  • Good organisational and project coordination skills, with attention to details.
  • Ability to multi-task and work under tight timelines.
  • Interest in digital communications, social media trends, video storytelling, institutional branding and public sector or education-related content.
  • Proficiency with social media platforms and basic content production tools is essential, including familiarity with short-form video editing, visual design, caption writing and content scheduling tools.

Closing Date: 21 October 2026

We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

NIE staff can take chartered buses at their own expense from or near their home to the NIE campus. This is subject to the availability of bus routes and seats.

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Role

RDIVC PTE LTD is looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist who understands creators, social media culture and how meaningful influencer partnerships can help grow a brand.

You’ll manage influencer campaigns from creator discovery and outreach through negotiation, content execution, campaign management and performance reporting.

You’ll work closely with RDIVC PTE LTD’s production, marketing and regional teams to develop influencer partnerships that support our brand and marketing objectives.

What You’ll Do

  • Research and identify suitable influencers and creators.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, creators and talent agencies.
  • Conduct influencer outreach and manage collaborations from beginning to completion.
  • Evaluate influencers based on audience, engagement, content quality and brand suitability.
  • Negotiate rates, deliverables, usage rights and campaign requirements.
  • Prepare clear influencer campaign briefs.
  • Coordinate content approvals and publishing schedules.
  • Ensure influencer content meets RDIVC PTE LTD’s campaign and brand requirements.
  • Monitor campaign deliverables and deadlines.
  • Track campaign performance including views, reach, engagement, clicks and conversions.
  • Prepare campaign reports and recommendations.
  • Identify emerging influencers, creators and social-media trends.
  • Maintain an organised database of influencers, previous collaborations, rates and campaign performance.
  • Work closely with RDIVC PTE LTD’s marketing, production and regional teams on influencer campaigns.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media, PR, digital marketing or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and creator culture.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Good relationship-management abilities.
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Comfortable analysing campaign data and performance metrics.
  • Good understanding of social-media trends and online culture.
  • Proactive and able to work independently while collaborating with different teams.
  • Experience managing regional campaigns, finance, fintech, forex, lifestyle, sports or entertainment.

title: Senior Brand Manager, Creator & Influencer Marketing (Gaming)
description:
What You'll Do

End-to-End Creator Partnership Strategy

  • Own the full-funnel creator marketing strategy, forging strategic partnerships with mega (top-tier) and macro (mid-tier) creators across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram to maximize brand reach and performance.
  • Negotiate and close complex partnership agreements, building a scalable talent network that aligns with regional cultural nuances and platform-specific content trends.
  • Produce high-converting creative briefs and content scripts tailored for paid acquisition channels, ensuring seamless handoff of creative assets to the User Acquisition (UA) team for media buying.

Budget Ownership & Performance Optimization

  • Manage regional influencer marketing P&L, optimizing budget allocation to hit dual KPIs: brand reach (impressions) and creative asset spend efficiency (ad spend consumption/ROAS).
  • Implement full-cycle performance tracking across creator campaigns, analyzing impression share, engagement rates, and downstream UA metrics to dynamically adjust content strategy and talent selection.
  • Develop scalable content playbooks and creative testing frameworks based on performance data, establishing reusable methodologies for high-ROI creator collaborations.

Localization & Cultural Innovation

  • Drive deep localization by aligning creator content with regional player personas, local social media vernacular, and culturally significant moments (seasonal events, regional holidays, gaming community trends).
  • Identify and capitalize on viral content opportunities, orchestrating high-shareability activations that generate organic breakthrough moments for the brand.
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive creator CRM/tiering system, continuously optimizing talent classification and partnership models to improve resource efficiency and long-term relationship value.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Marketing, UA, and Regional Ops teams, ensuring creator content seamlessly supports paid media strategies and regional growth objectives.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or brand management within gaming, mobile apps, or entertainment industries.
  • Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROAS through creator-driven campaigns.
  • Deep expertise in social platform ecosystems (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) and their respective creator economies; fluency in platform-native content formats and algorithmic trends.
  • Analytical rigor: proficiency in marketing analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, social listening tools, attribution platforms) and the ability to translate data into actionable creative strategies.
  • Exceptional negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with experience contracting high-profile creators and managing complex, multi-stakeholder campaigns.
  • Native or professional-level fluency in [Region's language] with deep cultural literacy; English proficiency required for global collaboration.
  • Strategic mindset balanced with executional excellence—you think in frameworks but obsess over creative details and localization nuances.

title: Regional Product Lead, YouTube Influencer Marketing (English, Japanese/Vietnamese) - Singapore
description:
Product area

Google Customer Solutions (GCS) sales teams are trusted advisors and competitive sellers who maintain a relentless focus on customer success by bringing the best Google has to offer to small- and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), which are the backbone of our communities. As a member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to work with company owners and make a real difference in their businesses by helping them grow.  Together, we help shape the future of innovation for customers, partners, and sellers...and we have fun doing it.

Job description

The "On Platform" rPSA is a specialized product expert responsible for unlocking the next horizon of YouTube growth by making YouTube the destination platform for brands to build Content, Community, and Commerce while responsible for wider YouTube overall business for APAC and your responsible market.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between Google Customer Solutions (GCS) Sales, the YouTube Partnerships (YTP) team, Global Product team and the Creator ecosystem. You will move beyond traditional media buying to operationalize "Brand Deals"—helping advertisers partner with YouTube Creators to produce authentic organic content, which is then amplified via Partnership Ads and YouTube Engagement campaigns along with evolving Shoppable YouTube products. You will be responsible for activating a Named Account List (NAL) of high-opportunity advertisers, co-pitching with sellers, managing complex implementation workflows, and driving incremental business through Full Funnel adoption.

Qualifications

Job responsibilities

  • Drive business by co-pitching high-potential accounts, accelerating Partnership and YouTube Engagement Ad adoption, and managing "Creator x Brand" agreements flows to ensure seamless brand-creator collaboration across the region.
  • Bridge cross-functional teams, including Sales, YTP, and CPM, to simplify advertiser experiences while proactively managing implementation timelines and unblocking operational hurdles in creator discovery and asset production processes.
  • Lead regional Go-To-Market strategies for brand and creator revenue, influencing product roadmaps and future developments by providing critical feedback on friction points and market supply gaps.
  • Upskill GCS sellers through targeted training, coaching, and pitch narrative development, focusing on Partnership Ads and creator culture to establish new regional standards for effective audience engagement.
  • Collaborate with gTech and global product teams to implement measurement playbooks proving the ROI of organic-plus-paid strategies.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in digital advertising sales or product activation, specifically managing YouTube/Video campaigns to drive both Branding (Reach) and Performance (ROAS/CPA) KPIs.
  • Experience with the Social Video and Influencer Marketing landscapes, including the interplay between paid media and creator ecosystems.
  • Experience with presenting technical concepts into "executive-ready" stories that influence executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
  • Ability to communicate in English, Japanese or Vietnamese fluently to manage the SEA markets and collaborate across the APAC region.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy using data (VTR, ROAS, Brand Lift) to identify market bottlenecks and build compelling business cases.
  • Familiarity with YouTube’s commerce-focused suite (Demand Gen, Merchant Center, Partnership Ads) and the CPG/eCommerce/Omnisales verticals.
  • Ability to manage complex workflows and agreement trackers in a changing environment with a "bias toward action" and a "win-as-APAC" mindset.
  • Proven success pitching to C-level executives and winning "Social Share of Wallet" from performers by articulating Brand versus Performance value.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We are seeking a strategic, hands-on, and results-oriented Marketing Manager to lead and drive our brand’s growth in the Singapore market. You will be responsible for developing integrated marketing strategies across digital, influencer, and experiential channels, while managing campaigns end-to-end and mentoring junior team members. This role plays a critical part in shaping brand positioning, accelerating customer engagement, and delivering measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with overall business and brand objectives.

  • Plan and manage annual and quarterly marketing roadmaps, budgets, and KPIs.

  • Translate business goals into actionable campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and offline touchpoints.

  • Ensure brand consistency and storytelling across all channels.

2. Social Media & Content Leadership

  • Oversee social media strategy, content pillars, and monthly content calendars.

  • Guide the creation of high-quality, engaging content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging channels.

  • Review and optimize content performance using analytics and insights.

  • Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm changes, and evolving consumer behaviours.

3. Influencer & Partnership Marketing

  • Lead influencer (KOL) strategy, from identification and negotiation to execution and evaluation.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, creators, agencies, and partners.

  • Ensure influencer content aligns with brand values, campaign objectives, and storytelling direction.

  • Track and analyse campaign performance including reach, engagement, conversions, and ROI.

4. Events, Activations & Brand Experiences

  • Lead the planning and execution of on-ground events, pop-ups, and brand activations.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and external partners to ensure smooth execution.

  • Oversee pre-event promotions and post-event content amplification across digital platforms.

  • Evaluate event effectiveness and translate learnings into future activations.

5. Market Research, Insights & Performance Analysis

  • Conduct competitive analysis, market research, and consumer insights to identify growth opportunities.

  • Monitor campaign performance and prepare regular reports with actionable recommendations.

  • Use data-driven insights to optimise marketing strategies and improve customer engagement.

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitors, and best practices within the Singapore market.

6. Team & Stakeholder Management

  • Guide, mentor, and support junior marketing team members or external collaborators.

  • Work closely with sales, operations, and management teams to align marketing efforts with business priorities.

  • Manage agencies, freelancers, and vendors where applicable.

7. Others

  • Support any other ad-hoc marketing initiatives or business requirements as needed.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • 3–6 years of relevant marketing experience, with at least 1–2 years in a managerial or lead role.

  • Strong experience in social media, influencer marketing, and integrated campaigns.

  • Familiar with tools such as Canva, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics, or similar platforms.

  • Strong strategic thinking, leadership, and communication skills.

  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing lifestyle, consumer, or startup brands in Singapore.

  • Proven track record in influencer-led or experiential marketing campaigns.

  • Experience managing budgets and agencies.

  • Passion for branding, storytelling, and emerging digital trends.

title: Content & Communications Specialist
description:
Are you ready to ignite your career and be part of something truly extraordinary? At ASUS, we’re In Search of Incredible—and we want you on our team! We’re looking for dynamic, passionate individuals who are eager to innovate, create, and make waves in the tech world. If you’re fueled by ambition and thrive in a fast-paced environment where your ideas can shape the future, this is your opportunity to shine.

Join us, and let’s chase the incredible together!

About the Role:

ASUS Singapore is looking for a Content & Communications Specialist to join our marketing team and play a key role in shaping how we communicate our products and brand across digital, social, website, EDM and media channels. 

In this role, you will develop and execute content strategies that support product launches, marketing campaigns, promotions and always-on communications. You will manage ASUS ExpertBook social media channels, create engaging content and EDMs, maintain website content and drive SEO and organic visibility. 

You will also support public relations, media relations and influencer initiatives, including press releases, product reviews, KOL/influencer collaborations, product seeding, media briefings and interviews. 

Working closely with Product Marketing, Design, Performance Marketing and E-Commerce teams, you will turn product stories and campaign objectives into compelling content, while using content and digital performance insights to continuously improve reach, engagement and brand visibility. 

If you are a creative storyteller who enjoys working across content, social media, digital communications, public relations and influencer marketing, we’d love to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities:

Content Strategy & Planning 

  • Maintain Asus website contents 

  • Develop and maintain an integrated content calendar across digital, social and owned media channels. 

  • Develop content strategies aligned with product launches, marketing campaigns and business objectives. 

  • Identify consumer, industry, technology and social trends to create relevant content opportunities. 

  • Translate product USPs and campaign objectives into compelling content themes and messaging. 

  • Optimise website and digital content for SEO and identify organic search opportunities to improve traffic and discoverability 

  • Ensure timely delivery and publishing of content according to campaign timelines. 

Social Media, EDM & Campaign Communications 

  • Manage and grow ASUS social media channels. 

  • Develop engaging content across social media and EDMs to drive reach, engagement and audience growth. 

  • Coordinate EDMs for product launches, campaigns, promotions and events. 

  • Adapt campaign messaging across different digital channels and audiences. 

  • Engage with online communities and monitor social conversations to maintain a positive brand presence. 

  • Identify relevant trends and opportunities to enhance content engagement. 

  • Ensure all content is accurate, engaging and aligned with ASUS brand guidelines. 

Public Relations, Media & Influencer Support 

  • Support public relations and communications initiatives through content development and amplification. 

  • Assist in developing press releases, media materials, product announcements and blog articles. 

  • Build and maintain relationships with relevant media, KOLs, influencers and content creators. 

  • Coordinate product reviews, media briefings, interviews and influencer activities. 

  • Support KOL/influencer campaigns from briefing and product seeding through to content delivery. 

  • Coordinate product seeding activities and track reviews, content deliverables and media coverage. 

Analytics & Optimisation 

  • Prepare monthly content performance reports and provide actionable recommendations. 

  • Conduct competitor benchmarking and identify content trends and best practices. 

  • Continuously optimise content formats, messaging and publishing strategies to improve performance. 

Requirements:

  • Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Mass Communications or a related field. 

  • 2–5 years of experience in content marketing, communications, public relations, social media or a related role. 

  • Strong copywriting, storytelling and communication skills. 

  • Good understanding of social media platforms, digital content, public relations and influencer marketing. 

  • Experience working with media, KOLs, influencers or content creators is an advantage. 

  • Understanding of SEO, website content management and digital analytics, such as Google Analytics, Meta Insights, YouTube Analytics and social listening tools. 

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills. 

  • Proactive, organised and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

  • Passion for technology, digital trends and consumer behaviour is a plus.

title: Brand & Marketing Manager
description:
Brand & Marketing Manager

About KLARRA

KLARRA is a Singapore-based contemporary fashion and lifestyle brand, known for its modern, refined and timeless approach to style. As we continue to grow our presence across fashion, retail and lifestyle, we are looking for a creative, resourceful and driven Brand & Marketing Manager to join our team.

This role is ideal for someone who has a strong eye for aesthetics, enjoys developing fresh ideas, is confident in building relationships and takes ownership of bringing marketing initiatives to life.

You will play a key role in shaping how KLARRA communicates, engages with its community and builds brand desirability across digital and offline touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy & Creative Marketing

  • Develop and execute marketing strategies that strengthen KLARRA's brand positioning, awareness and customer engagement.

  • Conceptualise fresh and thoughtful marketing ideas aligned with the brand's identity and aesthetic.

  • Lead the creative direction and storytelling for new collection launches, seasonal campaigns and brand initiatives.

  • Identify opportunities to create excitement and meaningful conversations around the brand.

  • Translate ideas into actionable marketing plans with clear timelines, deliverables and objectives.

  • Maintain consistency in brand messaging, visual identity and tone of voice across all marketing channels.

2. Social Media & Content Strategy

  • Own and manage the overall social media content calendar, ensuring a consistent and engaging presence.

  • Independently conceptualise content ideas for Instagram posts, stories, reels and other relevant platforms.

  • Develop creative briefs, storytelling angles and content direction for the in-house creative marketing team member.

  • Write compelling and refined copy for social media captions, campaigns, newsletters and other brand communications.

  • Work closely with the creative marketing team member to plan and coordinate content shoots, including visual references, shot lists and production schedules.

  • Oversee content scheduling and publishing, ensuring timely delivery and maintaining the brand's visual standards.

  • Review social media performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement, reach and content effectiveness.

3. Public Relations, KOL & Influencer Marketing

  • Develop and execute public relations and influencer marketing strategies to strengthen brand awareness and desirability.

  • Build and maintain relationships with relevant media, editors, stylists, influencers, KOLs and industry partners.

  • Independently identify, approach and engage suitable KOLs and content creators who align with KLARRA's brand identity.

  • Conceptualise and manage creative influencer seeding campaigns, gifting initiatives and collaborative content opportunities.

  • Negotiate partnership terms, deliverables and budgets to ensure meaningful brand exposure and value.

  • Develop press materials, media pitches and brand announcements for collection launches and key milestones.

  • Track and evaluate the effectiveness of public relations placements, influencer partnerships and seeding initiatives.

  • Coordinate with external public relations agencies and partners for selected larger campaigns when required.

4. Brand Partnerships & Collaborations

  • Proactively identify and develop strategic partnerships with complementary fashion, beauty, lifestyle and hospitality brands.

  • Conceptualise fresh collaboration opportunities, brand activations and community-building initiatives.

  • Lead outreach, proposals, discussions and negotiations with potential partners.

  • Manage partnership execution from initial ideation through to launch, ensuring alignment with the brand's positioning and objectives.

  • Explore new opportunities to expand KLARRA's reach and introduce the brand to relevant audiences.

5. Campaigns, Events & Brand Activations

  • Plan and coordinate marketing campaigns for new collections, retail initiatives, KLARRA Cafe and key brand moments.

  • Conceptualise launch experiences, intimate events, media previews and customer engagement initiatives.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets, vendor coordination and execution.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth campaign delivery.

  • Identify thoughtful and innovative ways to create excitement and publicity around product launches and special initiatives.

6. CRM, Customer Engagement & Brand Growth

  • Develop initiatives to strengthen customer loyalty, repeat purchases and long-term brand engagement.

  • Support the development, launch and ongoing marketing of KLARRA's customer loyalty programme.

  • Plan customer engagement campaigns, email newsletters and targeted communications.

  • Identify opportunities to grow the brand's community across existing and potential markets.

  • Monitor key marketing performance indicators and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.

7. Marketing Planning & Coordination

  • Develop and maintain a structured monthly and quarterly marketing calendar.

  • Independently manage priorities, timelines and deliverables across ongoing campaigns and initiatives.

  • Work closely with the founder, creative marketing team member, design team and retail teams to ensure alignment.

  • Oversee marketing budgets and manage external vendors where necessary.

  • Provide regular updates on marketing progress, performance, upcoming initiatives and opportunities.

  • Take ownership of projects from conceptualisation through to execution, with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in brand marketing, creative marketing, public relations or related fields, preferably within fashion, beauty, lifestyle or premium retail.

  • Strong creative thinking and the ability to independently develop compelling marketing ideas.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong command of English and a flair for refined brand storytelling.

  • Proven experience in influencer marketing, public relations outreach, partnerships and negotiations.

  • Strong understanding of social media content strategy, particularly Instagram.

  • A keen eye for aesthetics, photography, visual storytelling and contemporary fashion.

  • Experience managing marketing campaigns, timelines and multiple projects independently.

  • Resourceful, organised, proactive and comfortable taking initiative.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to build and maintain external relationships.

  • Basic proficiency in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite is an advantage.

  • Experience with email marketing, CRM and customer loyalty initiatives is an advantage.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who brings ideas to the table, enjoys creating meaningful brand experiences and has the initiative to turn opportunities into results.

You should be equally comfortable conceptualising a collection launch, developing a social media content plan, approaching potential collaborators and coordinating the details that bring a campaign together.

Above all, we value creativity, good judgement, ownership, attention to detail and a genuine appreciation for KLARRA's brand identity.

How to Apply

If you enjoy building brands, developing creative ideas and creating meaningful connections, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your resume, portfolio or examples of relevant campaigns, expected salary and earliest available start date to hr@klarra.com with the subject Application – Brand & Marketing Manager.

title: Business Development Manager-F&B and/or FMCG sectors
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Development Manager / Sales Manager who is both a hunter and farmer — able to bring in new clients while growing and retaining existing accounts.

The role will primarily focus on Singapore clients, with opportunities to develop and manage regional client accounts across Asia.

This is not a role that requires extensive cold-calling. Your success will come from approximately 50% of lead generation through your own existing professional network, with the remaining opportunities supported by the company through regular networking events, a database of warm leads, and inbound website enquiries.

Candidates do not necessarily need to come from the marketing industry. More importantly, we are looking for someone with a strong existing professional network and business relationships within the F&B and/or FMCG sectors and the ability to leverage these relationships to generate new business.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive basic salary, commensurate with experience
  • Monthly transport allowance
  • Monthly performance-based commission
  • Uncapped commission structure
  • Attractive earning potential for high performers
  • Training and support provided

Key Responsibilities

Generate New Business

  • Proactively drive the full sales cycle — from lead sourcing, generation and active follow-up, qualifying leads, arranging meetings, conducting pitches, to closing deals (influencer packages), leveraging a multi-channel pipeline combining your personal industry network with company-sponsored weekly networking events, database, and inbound website leads.
  • Achieve monthly sales targets of influencer packages with uncapped commission.
  • Leverage your existing professional network, particularly within the F&B and FMCG sectors, to identify and develop new business opportunities.

Account Maintenance

  • Maintain strong relationships with the clients you brought in (campaign management not required).
  • Identify repeat business opportunities and work towards developing long-term and retainer accounts.

Sales Pipeline Management and Sales Expansion Plan

  • Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline with accurate sales records and forecasts to consistently achieve monthly sales targets.
  • Provide regular market and client insights and identify opportunities for new products, services and packages.

Proposal and Report

  • Work closely with the Campaign Management Team supporting you on client proposals and campaign report development.
  • Brief the team clearly on client requirements and brainstorm campaign ideas and budgets together.
  • Review proposals and reports before sending them to clients.

About You

  • 3–8 years of relevant sales/business development experience.
  • Candidates do not necessarily need to come from the marketing industry.
  • Strong existing professional network and client relationships within F&B and/or FMCG are highly preferred.
  • Candidates with networks in consumer brands such as consumer electronics, malls, retail, lifestyle, hospitality, e-commerce, banking/merchant partnerships, POS, media, advertising, character licensing, or similar industries may also be considered.
  • Proven sales track record with the ability to generate new business through an active professional network.
  • Experience in media, digital marketing, advertising, partnerships, influencer marketing or related sales will be an advantage, but is not mandatory.
  • Influencer marketing sales experience will be an advantage, but is not required.
  • Able to work independently while collaborating closely with the marketing operations team.
  • Willing to learn in-depth about influencer marketing, social media algorithms and new marketing strategies — training will be provided.
  • Able to speak and read Chinese to communicate with some Chinese-speaking clients.
  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation and closing skills.
  • Comfortable managing both new business acquisition and existing client relationships.
