title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
description:
Position: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Food & Beverage / Restaurant
Location: VivoCity

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptional and highly experienced Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to lead the overall marketing, branding, customer acquisition and growth strategy of our restaurant business in Singapore.

The ideal candidate will be a senior marketing executive with extensive experience in large-scale F&B businesses, established restaurant chains, hospitality groups, consumer brands or multi-outlet restaurant operations.

This is a strategic leadership role for a commercially driven marketing professional who understands that restaurant marketing goes beyond social media. You will be responsible for building the brand, driving customer acquisition and retention, developing integrated marketing campaigns, strengthening digital presence, and ultimately delivering measurable revenue and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and lead the company's overall marketing, branding and customer growth strategy.

  • Establish a clear brand positioning, brand identity and long-term brand development strategy.

  • Develop integrated marketing strategies covering digital marketing, social media, PR, KOL/influencer marketing, CRM, loyalty, partnerships, events, content and offline marketing.

  • Lead customer acquisition and retention strategies to drive sustainable revenue growth.

  • Develop annual marketing plans, campaign calendars and marketing budgets aligned with overall business objectives.

  • Take ownership of marketing performance, ROI and customer acquisition metrics.

  • Build and manage the company's marketing organization, including digital marketing, social media, content, CRM, PR and creative functions.

  • Develop strong customer segmentation and data-driven marketing strategies.

  • Establish CRM, membership and loyalty programs to increase customer frequency, retention and lifetime value.

  • Lead major brand campaigns, seasonal campaigns, new product launches and new outlet opening campaigns.

  • Work closely with the COO and operations teams to ensure marketing campaigns translate into actual outlet traffic, sales and profitability.

  • Develop strategic partnerships with corporations, lifestyle brands, platforms, media companies, influencers and other relevant partners.

  • Oversee agency relationships and manage external creative, media, PR and digital partners.

  • Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, competitors and emerging opportunities within the Singapore F&B sector.

  • Establish marketing KPIs, dashboards and reporting systems to measure campaign effectiveness and commercial results.

  • Manage marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources.

  • Strengthen the company's digital ecosystem, including website, social media, CRM, online ordering and customer engagement channels.

  • Lead the company's reputation management and public communications strategy.

  • Support the company's expansion strategy and develop scalable marketing systems for future multi-outlet growth.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10–12 years of relevant marketing experience, with significant experience in senior marketing leadership positions.

  • Proven track record in F&B, restaurant chains, hospitality groups, consumer brands or other high-volume consumer businesses.

  • Strong preference for candidates who have held senior marketing positions within large restaurant groups, established F&B chains, major hospitality groups or recognized consumer brands.

  • At least 5 years of senior management / leadership experience, including experience managing marketing teams and external agencies.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing strategies for large-scale, multi-outlet or multi-location businesses.

  • Proven experience managing substantial marketing budgets and delivering measurable commercial results.

  • Strong understanding of brand building, customer acquisition, CRM, loyalty, digital marketing, social media, performance marketing, PR and influencer/KOL marketing.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect marketing activities with revenue, traffic, customer acquisition, retention and profitability.

  • Strong experience in new brand launches, new outlet openings, major campaigns and business expansion.

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and working closely with operations, finance, commercial and senior management teams.

  • Excellent analytical, strategic planning and commercial decision-making abilities.

  • Strong understanding of consumer behavior and the Singapore market.

  • Exceptional communication, leadership, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Highly creative while maintaining strong commercial and analytical discipline.

  • Experience working with large restaurant chains, flagship restaurants, major hospitality groups or regional consumer brands will be strongly preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a senior-level marketing executive rather than a pure digital marketer or social media manager.

The ideal candidate should have experience building and scaling brands within large F&B groups, established restaurant chains, hospitality organizations or major consumer businesses, with a strong understanding of how marketing directly impacts restaurant traffic, revenue and customer lifetime value.

Candidates with a proven track record of leading large marketing teams, significant budgets, multi-outlet campaigns and major brand-building initiatives will be strongly preferred.

Experience in taking a restaurant or consumer brand from growth stage to a larger multi-outlet or regional operation will be a significant advantage.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Kiztopia Group is a leading family edutainment and active entertainment business dedicated to creating meaningful, engaging experiences through play, exploration and movement.

With multiple concepts and locations across Singapore and the region, we continue to grow our portfolio through innovation, creativity and a commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Our established Kiztopia brand brings families together through purposeful play, while Xventure, our next-generation indoor actives ports park, introduces exciting experiences designed for older children, youths, young adults and families.

As we expand, we are looking for passionate and capable individuals to help strengthen our brands, grow our customer base and shape the future of entertainment in Singapore.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a commercially driven, creative and hands-on Marketing Manager to lead the marketing strategy, planning and execution for Kiztopia Group's Singapore businesses, including Kiztopia and Xventure.

You will take ownership of integrated marketing initiatives that strengthen brand positioning, increase customer acquisition, drive visitorship and contribute to business growth.

This role requires someone who can translate business objectives into actionable marketing strategies, balance brand-building with performance marketing, and lead campaigns from concept through execution and performance evaluation.

You will manage marketing budgets, guide team members, coordinate external agencies and work closely with Commercial, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver results.

We are looking for a well-rounded marketing leader who is equally comfortable developing strategy, analysing performance and getting involved in execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

  • Develop and lead integrated marketing strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure, aligned with brand positioning, commercial objectives and business priorities.
  • Translate revenue targets, visitorship goals and customer acquisition objectives into actionable monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.
  • Develop targeted strategies for different customer segments, including families, children, youths, young adults, schools and relevant community groups.
  • Identify opportunities to drive ticket sales, increase repeat visits, build brand loyalty and strengthen customer lifetime value.
  • Plan and manage campaigns across business-as-usual operations, seasonal peaks, new outlet launches and special events.
  • Monitor consumer trends, competitor activities and market opportunities to keep our brands relevant and competitive.

2. Integrated Campaign Management

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of marketing campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels.
  • Develop clear campaign objectives, audience targeting, promotional mechanics, timelines, budgets and measurable KPIs.
  • Oversee campaign delivery across social media, digital advertising, CRM, website, partnerships, PR and on-ground activations.
  • Establish effective customer journeys from awareness and engagement through to ticket purchase and repeat visits.
  • Ensure campaigns are delivered on time, within budget and aligned with business objectives.
  • Review campaign effectiveness and refine strategies based on performance data and customer response.

3. Digital Marketing & Performance Management

  • Lead digital marketing strategies across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok and other relevant channels.
  • Manage advertising budgets and optimise resource allocation based on campaign objectives and performance.
  • Oversee audience segmentation, retargeting, conversion campaigns and relevant testing initiatives.
  • Monitor key performance indicators such as reach, engagement, website traffic, acquisition cost, conversions and attributable revenue.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency, conversion rates and return on marketing investment.
  • Work with relevant stakeholders to improve website, booking and ticketing conversion journeys.

4. Brand, Social Media & Content Strategy

  • Own the overall brand marketing direction and ensure consistent positioning across campaigns and communication channels.
  • Develop differentiated content and communication strategies for Kiztopia and Xventure based on their respective target audiences.
  • Lead social media planning across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Guide the development of engaging content, including short-form videos, attraction highlights, promotional campaigns, customer experiences and community-driven content.
  • Review creative concepts, campaign messaging and marketing assets to ensure brand consistency and audience relevance.
  • Identify emerging content formats, cultural trends and creative opportunities that can strengthen organic reach and brand visibility.
  • Work closely with the marketing team, content creators and external agencies to deliver relevant, high-quality content.

5. Customer Engagement, CRM & Retention

  • Develop CRM and customer engagement strategies to encourage repeat visits, strengthen relationships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Oversee segmented email marketing, WhatsApp campaigns and other customer communications.
  • Identify opportunities for cross-promotion between Kiztopia, Xventure and other relevant business concepts.
  • Develop targeted campaigns around school holidays, birthdays, memberships, special occasions and customer engagement opportunities.
  • Review customer engagement and campaign data to identify opportunities for improved targeting and retention.

6. Partnerships, Events & Brand Activations

  • Collaborate with mall partners, ticketing platforms, community groups, schools, influencers and external partners on marketing initiatives.
  • Work closely with Commercial and Operations teams to support new outlet launches, grand openings, events and promotional activations.
  • Develop marketing initiatives that build awareness, generate publicity and encourage customer participation.
  • Identify and evaluate potential partnerships based on audience relevance, commercial value and expected marketing exposure.
  • Manage external agencies and vendors, ensuring clear deliverables, timelines, quality standards and value for money.

7. Budget, Reporting & Performance Accountability

  • Develop, manage and monitor marketing budgets across brands, campaigns and channels.
  • Track campaign performance against marketing KPIs and business objectives.
  • Prepare weekly marketing performance updates and monthly management reports covering key results, budget utilisation, insights and recommended actions.
  • Evaluate campaign effectiveness beyond engagement metrics, with emphasis on measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify underperforming initiatives early and recommend practical corrective actions.
  • Maintain clear marketing plans, campaign trackers, budgets and reporting frameworks.

8. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead, coach and develop the Singapore marketing team, establishing clear priorities, ownership and performance expectations.
  • Delegate effectively while remaining hands-on when required by business priorities.
  • Establish efficient workflows for campaign planning, creative production, approvals, execution and reporting.
  • Work collaboratively with Operations, Commercial, Partnerships, Sales and regional stakeholders.
  • Ensure marketing campaigns and promotions are communicated clearly to frontline teams and are operationally executable.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, creativity, initiative and continuous improvement.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of integrated marketing campaigns and experience leading projects or team members.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, performance advertising, social media, CRM and integrated campaign management.
  • Proven ability to develop actionable marketing plans and manage campaigns from strategy to execution.
  • Commercially minded, with the ability to interpret campaign performance and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.
  • Experience managing marketing budgets, external agencies and multiple concurrent campaigns.
  • Strong leadership, project management, communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Proactive, resourceful and comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Creative and analytical, with the ability to balance brand development and performance-driven marketing.
  • Willingness to take a hands-on approach and support execution where necessary.

ADDED ADVANTAGES

  • Experience in attractions, entertainment, family-oriented businesses, lifestyle, leisure, retail, hospitality or other consumer-facing industries.
  • Experience managing multiple brands, business locations or new product launches.
  • Familiarity with online ticketing platforms, e-commerce conversion and customer acquisition campaigns.
  • Knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, marketing automation or relevant CRM tools.
  • Experience in influencer marketing, community engagement, experiential marketing or event activations.
  • Hands-on content creation, photography or video editing experience.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Clear, executable marketing plans aligned with commercial and brand objectives.
  • Improved brand visibility, customer engagement and qualified traffic.
  • Measurable contribution to customer acquisition, ticket sales, visitorship and repeat visits.
  • Effective utilisation of marketing budgets and continuous campaign optimisation.
  • Consistent delivery of high-quality campaigns across Kiztopia and Xventure.
  • A well-organised, accountable marketing team capable of executing independently.

WHY JOIN US?

  • Lead marketing for two exciting entertainment brands with distinct growth opportunities.
  • Play a meaningful role in new brand development, outlet launches and business expansion.
  • Take ownership of marketing initiatives with direct visibility into business performance.
  • Work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative environment.
  • Grow professionally within an expanding regional entertainment group.

If you enjoy building brands, developing creative campaigns and turning marketing ideas into measurable results, we would love to hear from you.

You will manage and create content across:

• Instagram
• TikTok
• Facebook
• LinkedIn
• YouTube

You will work closely with the BMG Hospitality, Gabriel Restaurant and Capsule Social Modern teams to build a consistent and recognisable brand presence.

CONTENT CREATION

We do not want content creation to depend on only one person.

You will be expected to teach and coach our Front Desk, Guest Experience and Restaurant Crew to create simple, engaging content themselves.

You will create simple templates, workflows and training so that the operating team can capture moments happening inside our hotels and restaurants every day.

• CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro or similar
• Canva / Adobe Creative Suite

• AI-assisted content creation
• TikTok and Instagram Reels editing
• YouTube production

• Photography and videography
• Social-media analytics
• Content calendars
• Meta Business Suite
• LinkedIn content
• TikTok trends and formats

Knowledge of tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other AI creative platforms will be highly advantageous.

We want someone who is:

✔ Creative but commercially minded
✔ Comfortable appearing behind or occasionally in front of the camera
✔ Able to work independently and as part of a hospitality team
✔ Fast at turning ideas into actual content
✔ Comfortable working with restaurant and hotel operational teams
✔ Able to teach non-marketing staff how to create content
✔ Interested in AI-assisted content production
✔ Able to understand what makes people stop scrolling
✔ Focused on generating engagement, footfall, bookings and revenue — not merely followers

YOUR SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED BY

The quality and consistency of content produced, audience growth and engagement, restaurant traffic and hotel enquiries generated through social media, video performance, development of reusable content formats, and the ability to turn our operational team into a wider network of content creators.

title: Marketing Content Executive
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a creative, energetic and hands-on Marketing& Content Executive to join the Viomi Singapore team under KWH Group.

This is not a purely desk-based marketing role.

You will be involved in bringing the Viomi brand to life in Singapore — creating social media content, developing promotions, supporting roadshows and events, working with KOCs and creators, and capturing real customer experiences.

If you enjoy TikTok and Instagram, like creating content, are comfortable meeting people and want the opportunity to see your ideas turn into real campaigns, this could be the role for you.

What You’ll Be Doing

1. Social Media &Content Creation

·      Plan and create engaging content for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and other relevant platforms

·      Conceptualise, shoot and edit short-form videos, including TikToks and Reels

·      Create product demos, lifestyle content, customer stories, event highlights and behind-the-scenes content

·      Write captions and manage content posting on Viomi Singapore’s official social media accounts

·      Keep up with social media trends and bring fresh content ideas to the team

·      Track content performance and identify what resonates with our audience

·      Build and maintain a content calendar to ensure regular and timely posting

2. Promotions, Roadshows& Events

Viomi participates in consumer fairs, IT shows, mall roadshows and other events throughout the year.

You will:

·      Support the planning of promotional calendars, themes and campaign ideas

·      Help develop promotional mechanics, giveaways and consumer engagement activities

·      Coordinate with agencies on promotional, roadshow and event materials

·      Liaise with event organisers and mall management on event locations, booth layouts and requirements

·      Support product training and briefing for promoters before events

·      Attend selected roadshows and events to capture photos, videos and customer interactions

·      Turn event footage into engaging social media content

·      Review event and campaign performance with the team and identify areas for improvement

3. KOC & Creator Program

Help us build a community of people who genuinely use, enjoy and talk about our products.

You will:

·      Identify and reach out to suitable KOCs, micro-influencers and content creators

·      Coordinate collaborations, product installations, content briefs and posting schedules

·      Work with creators to develop authentic content that showcases Viomi products and their benefits

·      Follow up on content development and posting

·      Track the performance of KOC and creator collaborations

·      Help identify successful creators and content formats for future campaigns

4. Customer & ProductContent

Some of our best content comes from real customer experiences.

You will attend selected customer installations and product activities to:

·      Capture the installation and customer experience through photos and videos

·      Film product demonstrations, FAQs and educational content

·      Capture customer feedback and testimonials where appropriate

·      Turn real customer experiences into useful and engaging social media content

Who We’re Looking For

You could be a great fit if you:

·      Love social media and understand platforms such as TikTok and Instagram

·      Have a good eye for what makes content interesting and engaging

·      Can independently conceptualise, shoot and edit short-form video content

·      Are comfortable using tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe or similar content-creation tools

·      Are willing to work both behind the camera and occasionally appear in content when needed

·      Enjoy meeting people and are comfortable interacting with customers, promoters, creators and external partners

·      Are organised and able to manage several activities at the same time

·      Have good written and spoken English

·      Are comfortable experimenting with AI and new digital tools

·      Are proactive, resourceful and willing to learn

A Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business ora related field would be useful, but your creativity, attitude and portfolio matter more to us.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with 1–3 years of relevant experience in content creation, social media, marketing, media or agency work are also encouraged to apply.

Knowledge of digital advertising, SEO or paid social media campaigns would be an advantage, but is not essential.

Show Us What You’ve Made

We care more about what you can create than having a fancy portfolio.

If you’ve created TikToks, Reels, videos, photography, school projects or content for your own social accounts, send us a few examples you’re proud of.

Personal projects count too.

Why Join Us?

Viomi is a growing consumer technology brand in Singapore. You’ll have the opportunity to join us at an exciting stage of our development and play a direct role in building the brand locally.

You’ll get hands-on exposure across social media, content creation, consumermarketing, events, roadshows and creator collaborations rather than being limited to one small area of marketing.

You’ll also have the opportunity to:

·      Take ownership of content from ideato execution

·      Experiment with new content formats and marketing ideas

·      Work directly with customers, creators and the wider Viomi team

·      See your work go live and measure its impact

·      Build a broad marketing portfolio as the brand grows

Working Arrangements

This is a full-time position based in Singapore.

The role includes attending roadshows, consumer events and selected customer installations outside the office.

Occasional weekend work may be required for events and roadshows, with time off in lieu in accordance with company policy.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV together with 3–5 examples of content you’ve created.

These can be TikToks, Reels, videos, photographs, social media posts, school projects, freelance work or content from your own social media accounts.

We’re interested in seeing your ideas, creativity and what you can do.

title: FULL-TIME CREATIVE CONTENT & EDUCATION MARKETING EXECUTIVE
description:
Company Profile

Bright Culture (https://www.instagram.com/brightculture/)  is a growing tuition centre in Singapore focused on helping students learn smarter, build confidence and achieve better academic outcomes.

We believe education should be engaging, relatable and meaningful — not simply about memorising content and preparing for exams.

As we grow our digital presence, we're looking for a creative individual who can help us tell our story, connect with students and parents, and make educational content people genuinely want to watch and share.

The role will also involve opportunities to collaborate with Radical Kindness (https://www.instagram.com/k.weee/) on creative initiatives, campaigns and content that promote positive values and meaningful impact among young people. 

Job Description

You'll be involved in the entire content journey:

IDEA → CREATE → PUBLISH → ANALYSE → IMPROVE

Your responsibilities include:

  • Develop creative content ideas for students and parents

  • Shoot and edit TikToks, Reels, short-form videos and other social content

  • Write hooks, scripts, captions and engaging educational content

  • Turn complex academic concepts into simple, relatable and shareable content

  • Create content across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram and our website

  • Identify social media trends and adapt them creatively for education

  • Work with teachers and the academic team to develop educational content

  • Monitor and analyse content performance

  • Identify what works, what doesn't and what we should try next

  • Engage with students and parents and turn their questions into content ideas

  • Explore AI and emerging digital tools to improve content creation

  • Support digital marketing campaigns and Bright Culture's overall brand development

This is a hands-on role. You'll have the opportunity to develop ideas, create the content and see how audiences respond to your work.

Competencies & Values

We're looking for a fresh graduate from a Polytechnic or University who is:

  • Creative, curious and naturally full of ideas

  • Passionate about social media and content creation

  • Genuinely interested in education and interacting with young people

  • Comfortable with video creation and basic editing

  • Able to understand trends without simply copying them

  • A strong communicator and storyteller

  • Willing to experiment and learn from failure

  • Comfortable working independently and taking initiative

  • Interested in both creative ideas and content performance

  • Open to feedback and constantly looking to improve

Relevant backgrounds include Marketing, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Media, Advertising, Design, Creative Media, Business, Education or related fields.

Your academic qualification matters, but your creativity, portfolio, attitude and values matter more.

THIS IS VERY IMPORTANT

We are not looking for someone who simply wants a social media job.

We're looking for someone who genuinely believes in what we're trying to achieve in education.

You should care about making learning:

More engaging.
More relatable.
More memorable.
More human.

We want someone who can look at a boring topic and think:

“How can we make this interesting?”

Look at a difficult concept and think:

“How can we explain this differently?”

See a viral video and think:

“Why did this work, and how could we create our own version?”

And when something doesn't perform:

“What can we learn from it?”

Proven content experience matters.

You don't need years of professional experience. However, you must have created content before.

This could be through:

  • Personal social media accounts

  • Polytechnic or university projects

  • Internships

  • Freelance work

  • Personal projects

  • Content creation

Experience creating high-performing or viral content will be highly valued.

It doesn't have to be educational.

We want to see what you've created, how you think, and what you've learned from the results.

What's in It for You

You'll get the opportunity to:

  • Build a strong portfolio of real-world content

  • Gain hands-on experience in content and digital marketing

  • Work directly with teachers and an academic team

  • Learn how to turn educational knowledge into engaging content

  • Develop skills in video production, storytelling and copywriting

  • Learn how content performance is measured and optimised

  • Explore AI tools and emerging digital technologies

  • Understand how a growing education brand is built

  • Learn from experienced education content creators

  • Develop your own creative voice and ideas

  • Work with one of the fastest growing education brands in the social media space

Most importantly, your work will have a real audience and a real purpose.

Behind every view is a student.

Behind every enquiry is a parent.

And behind every piece of content is an opportunity to make someone's learning journey a little better.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your CV

2. Your portfolio or examples of content you've created

3. One piece of content you're most proud of

For the selected piece of content, tell us:

  • What did you create?

  • How did it perform?

  • Why do you think it worked?

  • What would you do differently today?

We don't just want to see your numbers. We want to understand how you think.

Applications without examples of previous content may not be considered.

Bring your creativity. Bring your portfolio. Bring your heart for education.

Let's create something that matters.

title: Marketing Executive (Digital & Content)
description:

What We Are Looking For

  • A proactive and hands-on team player who can support both content and campaign execution.

  • A marketer who can write clearly, work independently, and maintain quality across different digital channels.
  • Someone who is adaptable, resourceful, and able to contribute across a broad range of marketing activities.

title: Content & Digital Marketing Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a meticulous and dependable Content & Digital Marketing Intern to join our team and gain hands-on experience in AI-assisted content, SEO, client servicing and online community engagement.

This is not a traditional content writing internship. With AI changing the way content is created, you will learn how we use AI as part of our content workflow and focus more on reviewing, vetting and improving AI-generated content before it is sent to clients or published.

You will also gain exposure to client communication, SEO content processes, forum engagement and the day-to-day operations of a digital marketing agency.

If you have a sharp eye for detail, enjoy polishing and fact-checking content, and are comfortable communicating professionally, this could be a great opportunity for you.

Why Join Us?

  • Gain hands-on experience in SEO, AI-assisted content workflows and digital marketing.

  • Learn how AI is being used in a real agency environment.

  • Work with a diverse portfolio of clients across different industries.

  • Build practical experience in client servicing and communication.

  • Gain exposure to online community and forum engagement.

  • Learn directly from an experienced digital marketing team.

  • Hybrid work arrangement.

What You Will Learn & Support

Content & AI Support

  • Review and vet AI-generated blog articles for accuracy, clarity, grammar, tone and adherence to client briefs.

  • Learn how to improve and optimise AI-generated content.

  • Apply changes and amendments requested by clients.

  • Carry out quality checks before content is sent to clients or published.

  • Gain exposure to SEO and AI content optimisation.

Client Communication

  • Support the team in replying to client emails and basic client queries.

  • Follow up with clients on feedback, approvals and outstanding items where required.

  • Learn how to communicate with clients professionally in an agency environment.

  • Keep internal teammates updated on client requests and progress.

Forum & Community Engagement

  • Identify relevant forum discussions and engagement opportunities for our clients.

  • Learn how brands can participate appropriately in online communities.

  • Prepare and post suitable forum replies in line with company and client guidelines.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Mass Communications or a related field.

  • Good written English with a strong command of grammar, spelling and punctuation.

  • Keen attention to detail and the ability to spot errors, inconsistencies and awkward phrasing.

  • Able to follow briefs, guidelines and instructions carefully.

  • Professional and courteous written communication.

  • Organised, dependable and willing to learn.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of your work.

  • Familiarity with Reddit, HardwareZone, Quora or similar online communities is a plus.

  • Basic understanding of SEO or digital marketing is a plus, but not required.

Is This Internship Right for You?

To make sure expectations are clear from the start:

  • This internship focuses more on AI-assisted content, editing, quality control, client communication and digital marketing operations rather than traditional content writing.

  • You will learn how to review and improve AI-generated content instead of spending most of your time writing articles from scratch.

  • You will gain exposure to real client accounts and understand how a digital marketing agency operates.

  • You should be comfortable communicating with clients and working with different team members.

This internship is ideal for:

  • Polytechnic or university students looking for hands-on digital marketing experience.

  • Recent graduates looking to gain practical agency experience.

  • Individuals interested in AI, SEO, content and digital marketing.

  • Detail-oriented people who enjoy refining and improving work.

  • Anyone who wants exposure to both client servicing and digital marketing execution.

Internship Details

  • Position: Content & Digital Marketing Intern

  • Internship duration: 6 months

  • Work arrangement: Hybrid

  • Opportunity to be considered for a permanent position based on performance and business requirements.

description:
6-12 Months Contract | Chinatown Heritage Centre

Chinatown Heritage Centre is expanding its marketing and visitor engagement initiatives, with a growing focus on reaching both local and Mandarin-speaking audiences through digital and social media platforms.

We are looking for a creative and hands-on Marketing & Social Media Executive who can help grow the Centre's online presence, particularly across Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Instagram and Tiktok, while supporting marketing campaigns, content creation, partnerships and visitor activations.

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys social media, content creation and storytelling, but is also comfortable being hands-on with campaign execution and engaging with visitors and partners.

  • Manage and maintain the Centre's social media channels, including Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Instagram and TiktTok
  • Plan and develop social media content that builds awareness, engagement and interest in Chinatown Heritage Centre
  • Create and publish platform-appropriate content, including captions, graphics, photos, short-form videos and reels
  • Support the growth of the Centre's presence among Mandarin-speaking and China-market audiences, particularly through Xiaohongshu and WeChat.
  • Monitor content and campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve reach and engagement

  • Produce simple marketing materials using tools such as Canvaa, CapCut, Adobe or similar platforms
  • Support photography and short-form video production for social media and marketing campaigns
  • Be comfortable appearing in content where require, such as reels, visitor explainers or promotional videos
  • Adapt content and messaging for difference audiences and social media platforms

3. Marketing Campaigns, Partnerships & Activations

  • Support the planning and execution of marketing campaigns, promotions, events and visitor activations
  • Coordinate campaign materials, timelines, vendors and other operational requirements
  • Support partner collaborations and promotions, including campaign mechanics, marketing materials and follow-ups
  • Work with internal teams and external partners to ensure campaigns and activations are delivered smoothly

4. Visitor Engagement

  • Support on-ground marketing and visitor engagement activities at Chinatown Heritage Centre
  • Engage visitors and encourage participation in campaigns, activities and promotions
  • Gather visitor feedback and observations that can help improve future marketing and visitor experiences

  • Track social media, campaign, visitor and redemption data for reporting and future planning
  • Maintain campaign calendars, project trackers, vendor quotations and relevant marketing records
  • Provide general coordination support for ongoing marketing projects and initiatives

Job Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Tourism, Hospitality, Events, Business, Design or a related field
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in social media, digital marketing, content creation, marketing campaigns or a related area
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English, with the ability to communicate confidently with Mandarin-speaking visitors, partners and stakeholders
  • Experience managing or creating content for social media platforms. Hands-on experience with Xiaohongshu and/or WeChat is highly preferred
  • Good understanding of social media content, trends and audience engagement
  • Able to create basic graphics, photos and videos using Canva, Capcut, Adobe or similar tools
  • Comfortable with both digital marketing work and occasional public-facing/on-ground activities
  • Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through on timelines
  • Creative, proactive and hands-on, with a willingness to experiment with new content ideas
  • Able to work occasional weekends, evenings or public holidays when required for campaigns, events or activations.

What We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Regularly use platforms such as Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Instagram or TikTok and understand what makes content engaging on each platform
  • Enjoy turning ideas, places and experiences into interesting social media content
  • Have an eye for visuals, storytelling and trends
  • Are comfortable communicating in both Mandarin and English
  • Enjoy meeting people and don't mind being in front of the camera occasionally
  • Can take an idea from planning through to execution rather than focusing only on strategy
  • Have an interest in Singapore heritage, culture, tourism and Chinatown

title: Content & Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About Us: 

Hotel101 Global, listed on Nasdaq (HBNB), is a pioneering hospitality brand fueling global growth with its compelling “condotel” investment model. We integrate tech-driven operations with our HappyRoom standard to deliver consistent, comfortable, great value guest experiences worldwide, ensuring exceptional efficiency and scalability. 

Our story began with a simple, yet revolutionary idea: a “one room” global hotel brand—a promise of consistency, comfort, and irresistible value, wherever in the world our guests may be. Our vision knows no borders: to build 1 million hotel rooms and be present in 100 countries. 

Our unique condotel approach allows investors to own income-generating units within a professionally managed hotel, blending real estate investment with the stability of a global hospitality brand. Infused with Filipino-inspired warmth, Hotel101 Global is redefining the industry, creating exceptional value for investors through sustainable growth, predictable returns, and a presence in key international markets. 

Join us to invest in a brand that’s shaping the future of global hospitality. For more information, visit www.hotel101global.com. 

Job Summary

Would you rather do a bit of everything than specialise in one channel?

We are looking for a marketer who is comfortable across content and campaigns. Someone who can put a piece of content together, get a campaign live, and then look at how it performed and work out what to do next.

You will be part of the global marketing team, where ideas are planned together and support is provided.

Hotel101 is opening in new markets and every launch needs content, campaigns and collateral. A big part of this role is helping us build something repeatable, so we are not starting from scratch each time.

What We Offer

  • Variety. Brand, content, campaigns, e-commerce and CRM, rather than one channel for the next three years.
  • Travel, and the chance to make content in the markets we are opening.
  • We are always exploring new tools and better ways of working, AI included, and we welcome anyone who enjoys doing the same.
  • Room to grow as we grow. We are continuing to expand into new countries.

Key Responsibilities

Brand & Campaigns

  • Help us plan and run campaigns across social, search, e-commerce, media and offline. You will be involved from the first idea through to the results.
  • Look after our brand. That means keeping our guidelines and asset library in good shape, and helping local teams out when they are putting something together.
  • Work on our promotions, from festive campaigns to opening offers. You will sort out the details and make sure everything is ready to go on time.
  • Help bring new hotels to market. When a property opens, you will help pull together the content, the campaign and the collateral it needs.
  • Ensure that content, campaigns, promotions and partnerships comply with applicable legal, regulatory, platform, brand and internal approval requirements, including required disclosures and disclaimers.

Content & Creative

  • Take the lead on content at our properties and in market. You will come up with the idea, brief it, and work with photographers and videographers on the day.
  • Take ownership of asset creation, producing work in-house wherever it makes sense: social posts, EDMs, campaign visuals and decks. We will talk through the direction together before you dive in.
  • Write and edit our copy, from captions and scripts to EDMs and the occasional landing page.
  • Look after our social channels and keep a content calendar that works for every market.
  • Secure and maintain the necessary licences, consents, releases, approvals and usage rights for third-party content, images, footage and other creative assets.

Digital & Performance

  • Run our paid campaigns on search and social, for both unit sales enquiries and room bookings.
  • Help us show up better in search, on our own site, and across the booking platforms and listing sites where guests find us.
  • Keep an eye on conversion, from landing pages and forms through to the booking flow and enquiry follow-up. Growing direct bookings is something we care a lot about.
  • Keep the website and app up to date, so promotions, links and pages are accurate and live when they should be.
  • Help with CRM and marketing automation, so buyers and guests hear from us at the right moment.
  • Look back at how campaigns performed and tell us what you think we should change next time.
  • Handle buyer and guest data, CRM communications and marketing preferences in accordance with applicable data-protection and direct-marketing requirements.

Events & Partnerships

  • Help us get ready for exhibitions, roadshows and networking events: collateral, booth materials, presentations and the follow-up afterwards.
  • Work with our agencies, KOLs and media partners in each market.

Working With the Team

  • Work closely with the wider marketing team. We share what we are working on, and there is always someone to talk an idea through with.
  • Team up with local sales, hotel operations and revenue colleagues so campaigns and launches land properly in each market.
  • Keep everyone in the loop as campaigns and launches progress, so nothing catches anyone by surprise.

Qualifications

  • All-rounder mindset. You would rather pick something new up than pass it to someone else.
  • 3 to 5 years in marketing, with hands-on experience in content and campaigns.
  • You can put content together yourself, including editing video and turning raw footage and assets into something we can publish.
  • Design skills. You will be making real assets, so we are after someone who can do the work, not only brief it.
  • Comfortable with numbers. You can work out what performance data is telling you and what to do about it.
  • Some commercial sense. You have worked to a target before and you understand how promotions work.
  • Experience with SEO, CMS platforms and analytics tools.
  • Organised, and happy juggling a few campaigns and deadlines at once.
  • Open to travel, including longer trips when we are opening a new market.
  • Comfortable working with stakeholders across markets and seniority levels.
  • A degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field.

Good to Have

•     Experience keeping a brand consistent across several markets.

•     PR experience, or having worked alongside PR agencies.

•     UI design experience, or having worked on website or app design.

•     Working knowledge of CRM and marketing automation.

•     A background in hospitality, travel or the real estate industry.

•     Agency experience. Having handled a few brands or accounts at once tends to translate well to a role like this.

title: Marketing Executive(Video Content Production for Social Commerce)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We are seeking a visually driven storyteller to be the creative backbone of our social commerce strategy. While the Social Commerce Executive operates the stores and live streams, you will fuel the entire ecosystem with high-impact, scroll-stopping video content. You are responsible for shooting, directing, and editing all shoppable video assets—from product demos and unboxings to live stream trailers and viral short-form clips—across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and marketplace video feeds.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

A. VIDEO PRODUCTION & SHOOTING

  • In-House Studio Shoots: Plan, set up, and execute professional product photography and videography shoots using DSLR/mirrorless cameras, smartphone cinematography, gimbals, and professional lighting grids.

  • Lifestyle & Storytelling Content: Shoot on-location lifestyle videos that showcase products in real-world usage scenarios, aligning with brand identity and campaign themes.

  • Live Stream Teaser Trailers: Produce high-energy 15–30 second promotional trailers to build anticipation for upcoming live selling sessions.

  • Product Demonstration Videos: Create clear, compelling "evergreen" demo videos that highlight product features, benefits, usage tutorials, and unboxing experiences—embedded directly into product listings to boost conversion.

  • Behind-the-Scenes (BTS): Capture raw, authentic BTS footage during live streams and studio operations for use in brand storytelling and employee advocacy content.

  • On-the-Fly Capture: During live streams, identify and capture highlight reels, customer reaction shots, and memorable moments for immediate post-stream publishing.

B. VIDEO EDITING & POST-PRODUCTION

  • Editing Software Proficiency: Edit raw footage using CapCut (Desktop/Mobile), Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Adobe After Effects.

  • Platform Optimization: Adapt videos to platform-specific requirements—9:16 vertical for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, 16:9 for YouTube, and 1:1 or 4:5 for marketplace video feeds.

  • Trend Integration: Stay on top of trending audio, effects, transitions, and text overlay styles to maximize organic reach and virality.

  • Sound Design: Clean up audio, sync external mic/voiceover tracks, and add background music/SFX that complements the visual narrative.

  • Color Grading: Apply consistent color grading and brand filters to maintain a cohesive visual identity across all content.

  • Thumbnail & Overlay Creation: Design custom thumbnails, product callouts, and price/CTA overlays using Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or After Effects.

C. CONTENT STRATEGY & PIPELINE MANAGEMENT

  • Editorial Calendar: Work closely with the Social Commerce Executive to align video output with the live stream schedule, product launches, and seasonal campaigns.

  • Content Batching: Plan and execute efficient batch-shooting sessions to ensure a consistent pipeline of at least X videos per week (e.g., 15–20 short-form videos).

  • Asset Management: Maintain a centralized, cloud-based media library of all raw footage, edited videos, product shots, and branded assets for easy access by the wider team.

  • A/B Testing Creatives: Produce multiple variations of the same product video (different hooks, CTAs, audio tracks) to test which performs best in ads and organic feeds.

D. CREATIVE COLLABORATION

  • Affiliate Toolkit Creation: Produce and distribute videography toolkits (b-roll footage, product shots, script templates, and audio packs) for affiliates and KOLs to ensure brand consistency.

  • Brief Interpretation: Translate briefs from the marketing/e-commerce team into compelling visual narratives without requiring excessive handholding.

  • Trend Spotting: Proactively pitch new video concepts, formats, and viral challenges that the brand can capitalize on to drive traffic and sales.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

Experience:

  • 1–3 years in Content Creation, Videography, Film Production, or Social Media Management.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating short-form video work for brands (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts).

  • Experience in product/commercial videography is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills:

  • Camera Operation: Proficiency with DSLR/mirrorless cameras (Sony, Canon, Fuji), smartphone cinematography (iPhone/Android), gimbals (DJI, Zhiyun), and lighting setups (softboxes, LED panels, ring lights).

  • Editing Software: Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following: CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Adobe After Effects.

  • Audio: Sound recording and mixing knowledge (lapel mics, shotgun mics, audio sync, noise reduction).

  • Graphic Design: Working knowledge of Canva or Adobe Photoshop for thumbnails and overlay creation.

  • Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of aspect ratios, resolution requirements, file formats, and trending audio/effect libraries for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and marketplaces.

Soft Skills:

  • Creative Eye: Strong visual storytelling ability—understanding composition, color theory, pacing, and hook creation.

  • Speed & Agility: Ability to shoot, edit, and publish content within tight turnaround times (same-day edits for trending topics).

  • Self-Starter: Proactive in pitching ideas; does not wait for briefs to start creating.

  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous about quality control—no pixelation, bad audio, or typos in text overlays.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Studio & On-Location: Regular work in the studio for product shoots; occasional on-location shoots for lifestyle/brand storytelling.

  • Flexible Hours: May need to work outside standard hours to capture time-sensitive trends or product launches.

  • Equipment Responsibility: Responsible for care, maintenance, and inventory of all videography and editing equipment.

Job Description

We are looking for a creative and motivated Social Media Marketing Executive to support our digital marketing initiatives. This transitional role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about digital marketing and are looking to build a long-term career with us.

The role begins on a part-time basis for the first three months, allowing both the employee and the company to assess suitability. Employees who demonstrate strong performance may be offered opportunities to continue their career with us through various progression pathways.

  • Creative mindset with an interest in digital marketing.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
The Digital Marketing Executive owns the day-to-day management and continuous improvement of the organisation's website and digital presence, and produces a high volume of digital content to raise awareness of our healthcare services and support patient engagement. The role combines hands-on website administration, SEO and analytics with strong digital creative production (graphics, video, written content), working closely with clinical and operational teams to ensure all messaging is accurate, compliant and patient-friendly.

Website Management & Optimization

· Manage the company website end-to-end through the CMS: page creation, updates, publishing, plugin and template maintenance.

· Maintain accuracy of service pages, doctor/specialist profiles, treatment information, contact details, and patient resources.

· Plan and improve site structure, navigation and user journeys (e.g., enquiry, appointment request, referral, international patient pathways).

· Conduct on-page and technical SEO: keyword research, meta titles/descriptions, internal linking, schema markup, page speed, mobile responsiveness, and broken-link checks.

· Run regular website performance reviews and recommend improvements, including A/B testing of landing pages, forms and calls-to-action.

· Create and manage campaign landing pages and enquiry forms, ensuring they are tracked and integrated with CRM or enquiry-handling processes where applicable.

· Work with IT and external vendors on hosting, security, backups, domain/SSL renewals, PDPA-compliant cookie consent, and troubleshooting.

· Ensure all web content complies with healthcare advertising guidelines, PDPA, and internal approval processes.

Digital Content Creation & Production Support

· Produce high-quality digital content for web, social media, email and online campaigns on a consistent publishing schedule.

· Design graphics, infographics, social media posts, banners, e-brochures, e-posters, digital invitations, and presentation materials (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite).

· Create and edit short-form videos, reels, explainers, event highlights and patient education clips (e.g., CapCut, Premiere Pro); coordinate photo and video shoots.

· Write and edit website copy, blog articles, patient education content, newsletters, captions, and press or announcement content.

· Translate clinical or technical information from healthcare professionals into clear, accurate, patient-friendly content, and obtain sign-off before publishing.

· Maintain a content calendar and a library of reusable templates, brand assets, and approved content.

· Repurpose content across channels (e.g., article → social posts → newsletter → short video) to maximise reach.

· Ensure all creative output adheres to brand guidelines and tone of voice.

Digital Campaigns & Social Media

· Plan, execute and monitor digital campaigns across search, social, email and other online channels, including paid ads (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads) where applicable.

· Schedule and publish content on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

· Monitor engagement, respond to comments and messages appropriately, and escalate sensitive enquiries or feedback to the relevant team.

· Manage email marketing: build mailing lists, design newsletters, and track open and click-through rates.

· Track and report on campaign and social performance (reach, engagement, leads, conversions, cost per lead) with monthly insights and recommendations.

Event & Outreach Digital Support

· Create digital promotional materials for events, talks, workshops, and outreach activities (e-invites, banners, registration pages, countdown posts).

· Manage online registration forms and event landing pages.

· Provide live social media coverage and post-event content (recaps, photo albums, highlight videos).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Work closely with clinicians, nursing, business development, patient liaison and operations teams to gather content and ensure accuracy.

· Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, photographers and videographers as needed.

· Support ad hoc marketing and communications requests.

Requirements

· Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications or a related field.

· Prior experience in digital marketing or content creation (healthcare experience is a plus).

· Proficiency in design tools such as Canva, Adobe Create Suite, or similar.

· Hands-on experience with a CMS (WordPress preferred) and basic HTML/CSS knowledge.

· Organised and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

· Strong writing, communication, and creative skills.

title: F&B Brand Executive
description:
We are looking for a creative, commercially minded, and execution-focused Food Brand Executive to support the development and growth of our food brand. The Food Brand Executive will be responsible for translating the brand strategy into effective marketing campaigns, product launches, promotional activities, content, customer engagement, and in-store execution. The role works closely with Operations, Product Development, Design, Sales, and external partners to ensure the brand remains relevant, consistent, and commercially successful. The ideal candidate combines food industry passion, marketing creativity, strong execution skills, and commercial awareness.

The Food Brand Executive is responsible for turning the food brand's strategy into compelling customer experiences and commercially effective marketing activities. The role sits at the intersection of Brand × Product ×Marketing × Customer × Operations, ensuring that every campaign, product launch, promotion, and customer touchpoint strengthens the brand while contributing to sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Management

  • Support the development and execution of the brand strategy and annual brand plans.
  • Ensure consistent brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, and customer experience across all touchpoints.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, consumer behaviour, and emerging food trends.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and market positioning.
  • Maintain brand guidelines and ensure all communications and materials are aligned with brand standards.
  • Support brand health tracking and recommend initiatives to strengthen brand equity.

2. Marketing Campaigns & Promotions

  • Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns to drive traffic, sales, and customer engagement.
  • Develop promotional calendars covering seasonal campaigns, new product launches, festive periods, and key commercial occasions.
  • Coordinate campaign execution across kiosks, social media, digital platforms, delivery channels, and other customer touchpoints.
  • Work with Operations to ensure promotions are implemented accurately and consistently at store level.
  • Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.
  • Coordinate with external agencies, designers, printers, influencers, and other marketing partners where required.

3. Product Launches & Menu Development

  • Support the development and launch of new food and beverage products.
  • Work closely with Operations and Product Development teams on product positioning, naming, packaging, pricing, and launch plans.
  • Develop go-to-market plans for new products and limited-time offerings.
  • Coordinate product photography, menu boards, promotional materials, and digital content.
  • Monitor new product performance and gather customer feedback.
  • Recommend product improvements or promotional strategies based on sales and customer insights.

4. Digital & Social Media

  • Manage and execute the brand's social media and digital content calendar.
  • Develop engaging content ideas around products, promotions, brand stories, and customer experiences.
  • Coordinate photography, videography, graphic design, and other content production.
  • Monitor social media engagement, customer comments, reviews, and online sentiment.
  • Support digital campaigns, paid media, and online promotions.
  • Track digital performance and recommend improvements to increase reach and engagement.

5. Customer & Market Insights

  • Gather customer feedback and identify changing customer preferences.
  • Conduct basic market and competitor research.
  • Monitor competitor pricing, promotions, new product launches, and marketing activities.
  • Analyse customer behaviour, sales trends, and campaign performance.
  • Translate insights into practical recommendations for products, promotions, and brand initiatives.
  • Support customer surveys, focus groups, sampling, and other market research activities where required.

6. In-Store Brand Execution

  • Ensure brand campaigns and promotional materials are effectively implemented across all kiosks.
  • Coordinate POSM, menu boards, posters, displays, packaging, and promotional materials.
  • Conduct store checks to ensure visual and promotional standards are maintained.
  • Work closely with Operations to ensure campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and brand experience within the kiosk environment.

7.Commercial & Sales Support

  • Work closely with Operations and Commercial teams to support sales growth.
  • Monitor product sales, campaign results, customer traffic, and promotional performance.
  • Analyse the commercial effectiveness of promotions and marketing activities.
  • Support pricing and promotional recommendations using market and sales data.
  • Balance brand-building activities with commercial objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, customer conversion, and average transaction value.

8. Brand Partnerships & Activations

  • Identify and coordinate suitable brand partnerships and collaboration opportunities.
  • Support sampling events, pop-ups, community activities, and promotional activations.
  • Coordinate with external partners, landlords, suppliers, and event organisers where required.
  • Ensure brand activations are aligned with brand positioning and commercial objectives.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and ROI of brand activities.

9. Marketing Budget & Administration

  • Assist in preparing and managing the annual marketing and brand activity budget.
  • Track campaign spending and ensure activities remain within approved budgets.
  • Coordinate quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and supplier payments where required.

title: Bilingual Content and Brand Executive
description:
About Us

Country City Investments Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based real estate management and investment company with an established portfolio of lifestyle and heritage projects across Singapore.

We are currently expanding our team to support the development and activation of a new large-scale lifestyle precinct — a multi-generational destination centred around F&B, wellness, family programming, sports, and community activations, with a targeted opening in early 2027.

About the Role

We are seeking a Content & Brand Executive to join our team ahead of the opening of our upcoming lifestyle precinct — building our brand presence, social channels, and content identity from the ground up.

This is a high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of brand thinking and hands-on content production. The successful candidate will be responsible not just for creating content, but for shaping the voice, tone, and visual identity of a new lifestyle destination from day one. You will be one of the first people to tell this story — and how you tell it will matter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and publish 3–5 short-form videos per week across Instagram, TikTok, and XHS, maintaining a consistent and compelling brand voice
  • Own the day-to-day management of all social media channels — content calendar, community engagement, DMs, and real-time responses
  • Write copy across all brand touchpoints — captions, stories, campaign text, and editorial content — in a natural, lifestyle-appropriate voice
  • Develop and maintain the brand's visual and tonal identity across all digital channels in the absence of a dedicated brand director
  • Research and produce heritage and community "micro-stories" that bring the history and soul of our precinct to life
  • Capture on-site content regularly — restoration progress, tenant stories, community moments, and event documentation
  • Manage and maintain an organised library of photo and video assets across all projects
  • Support content needs across our broader portfolio of lifestyle and heritage properties as required

Requirements

Essential:

  • 3–4 years of experience in content creation, social media management, or brand communications — lifestyle, F&B, hospitality, or real estate preferred
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating mobile video shooting and editing, with clear evidence of storytelling instinct and brand consistency
  • Excellent English copywriting skills with a natural, lifestyle-appropriate voice
  • Demonstrated ability to hold and apply a brand tone independently without daily direction
  • Self-starter with strong initiative — comfortable working in a pre-opening environment where structures are still being built
  • Proficient in mobile editing tools (CapCut, VN, or equivalent) and familiar with platform-native formats across Instagram, TikTok, and XHS

Preferred:

  • Experience managing social channels for a lifestyle precinct, F&B group, hospitality brand, or cultural institution
  • Native-level written Mandarin for XHS content creation
  • Basic photography skills for on-site capture in addition to video
  • Familiarity with content scheduling and analytics tools

    How to Apply
    Interested candidates are invited to submit the following:
  • Your CV
  • A portfolio or link to your content work
  • A one-sentence answer to this question: What is the most underrated place in Singapore, and why?
  • Please send applications to: Jasonsoh@dempseyhill.com
  • We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

    Country City Investments Pte Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a fair and inclusive hiring process in accordance with the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices.

title: Business Development & Brand Executive (Corporate Wellness)
description:
ABOUT AQUILA MEDICAL CENTER

Aquila Medical Center is a multi-disciplinary MOH clinic in the Singapore CBD with over 8 years of history. Our doctors offer health screening, AI-powered longevity and biological age assessments, hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT), weight management, GP care and teleconsultation, acupuncture, medical aesthetics, hair restoration, plastic surgery and minor surgery under one roof.

We are building our corporate wellness business and our brand, and we're looking for one person to drive both. That means someone who can sit across from an HR manager and close a deal, then head out and film a video for our social media.

THE ROLE

You will report directly to the Medical Director and work across three areas: corporate sales, being the clinic's face on social media, and marketing strategy. You'll get full training on our services and on the MOH rules for healthcare advertising.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Corporate sales & partnerships

  • Work with our doctors to put together corporate packages from our services, such as annual health screening, longevity assessments, wellness programmes, treatment-credit plans and staff perks
  • Find prospective corporate clients, reach HR, benefits and management decision-makers, and arrange meetings
  • Meet clients at their offices across Singapore, present proposals, negotiate and close contracts
  • Look after clients once they sign, including onboarding, scheduling employee screenings, organising health talks and wellness days, and handling renewals
  • Build referral partnerships with insurers, employee-benefits brokers, financial advisers and gyms
  • Track your pipeline and contracts in a CRM and report monthly

Brand, PR & social media

  • Be the on-camera face of Aquila: plan, script, film and post short-form videos and posts for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn
  • Grow our following and engagement with a consistent content calendar
  • Pitch stories to the media and represent the clinic at corporate events, health fairs and networking sessions
  • Make sure all content follows MOH's healthcare advertising rules

Marketing strategy

  • Plan campaigns and new-service launches with the Medical Director
  • Bring what you learn from clients and from content performance back into our offers and messaging
  • Coordinate with our Google and Meta advertising so that content, ads and sales support each other

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • At least 2 years of sales, business development or client-facing experience. Fresh graduates with a strong drive to sell are welcome to apply
  • Experience in health screening, employee benefits, insurance, wellness or healthcare is a plus
  • Motivated by commission and comfortable meeting new people every week
  • Comfortable and natural on camera, with experience creating social media content (a portfolio or account you're proud of is a plus)
  • Confident presenter and clear writer in English
  • Self-driven and organised, since you'll manage your own schedule and travel around Singapore to meet clients
  • Genuine interest in health, wellness and longevity
  • Basic video editing skills (CapCut or similar) are useful

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Base salary of S$3,000 – S$3,600 a month, depending on experience
  • Commission on the value of every corporate contract you close
  • Transport claims for client meetings
  • Direct access to the Medical Director and a real say in how the clinic grows
  • Office in the CBD at Robinson Road

HOW TO APPLY

Apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV.

description:
Role Overview

Weare looking for a creative, proactive, and hands-on communicator to support the delivery of Kingsmen’s brand and communications agenda across markets.   • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with an eye for clear, engaging and brand-appropriate content.
  • Good understanding of digital, social media and current communications trends, with a willingness to explore new platforms and formats.
  • Creative, curious and proactive, with the ability to contribute ideas and take ownership of assigned projects.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Sales & Partnerships Executive
description:
About The Meatmen Group

The Meatmen Group is one of Singapore's leading food and lifestyle media brands, creating engaging content that reaches millions of viewers across digital and social platforms. We work with brands, agencies and partners to deliver impactful content, campaigns and experiences that connect with audiences in meaningful ways. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a hungry and driven Sales & Partnerships Executive to help us build new partnerships and unlock new business opportunities.


What You'll Do

  • Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities through outreach, networking, referrals and prospecting
  • Build relationships with brands, agencies and marketing decision-makers
  • Pitch The Meatmen Group's content, sponsorship, advertising and partnership opportunities
  • Understand client objectives and recommend creative solutions that deliver measurable value
  • Support the full sales cycle from lead generation and prospecting to proposal preparation, negotiation and closing
  • Work closely with content, marketing and operations teams to ensure successful execution of client campaigns
  • Maintain an active pipeline of opportunities and consistently work towards sales targets
  • Keep up to date with trends in food, lifestyle, digital media and brand partnerships

Who We're Looking For

  • Confident communicator who enjoys meeting new people and building relationships
  • Comfortable with outreach, prospecting and initiating conversations
  • Resilient and able to handle rejection positively
  • Strong organisational and follow-up skills
  • Passionate about food, content, media and brand partnerships
  • Fresh graduates and candidates with 0 to 2 years of experience are welcome to apply
  • Experience in sales, customer service, account management, events or marketing is a bonus, but not required

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Singapore's most recognised food media brands
  • Gain hands-on exposure to media sales, branded content and commercial partnerships
  • Work with leading F&B, consumer, retail and lifestyle brands
  • Learn directly from experienced business leaders and entrepreneurs
  • Attractive commission structure with uncapped earning potential
  • Fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment with genuine opportunities for growth

Why Join Us

This is a varied role with the opportunity to work across corporate events, creative brand collaborations and wellness experiences, while building strong relationships with clients and partners.

title: Sales and Partnerships Executive
description:
About King Fire

King Fire is a Singapore fire protection specialist providing solutions from supply and system integration to installation and maintenance. Our purpose is to help protect people, property and the places our communities depend on. We are bringing a range of fire safety products to Singapore’s business and consumer markets, with a focus on solutions to combat battery fires.

The Role

Start your sales career with a mission that matters. Help a business take action on battery fire safety, connect a community with practical product information, or open a conversation with an energy storage operator. Your work will turn awareness into opportunities to improve fire preparedness.

We are looking for a resourceful Sales and Partnerships Executive to help build this launch from the ground up. You will find new B2B customers, develop community partnerships and support B2C sales. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) will be a specific market for you to explore alongside the technical team. Fresh graduates are welcome; curiosity, initiative and consistent follow-through matter.

Key Responsibilities

Open doors to B2B customers. Research prospects, identify decision-makers and start conversations through calls, emails, networking and visits. Find ways to reach potential buyers and turn first contact into qualified meetings.

Develop the BESS market. Identify energy storage developers, system integrators, operators and asset owners. Understand their needs, arrange introductions and bring in the technical team to assess appropriate fire safety solutions for batteries.

Build community partnerships. Reach out to community organisations, residents’ networks, associations and relevant partners. Propose product showcases, awareness sessions, group purchases and referral opportunities, and coordinate agreed activities.

Turn interest into sales. Understand customer needs, present approved product information, prepare quotations within agreed pricing and follow up through to purchase. Coordinate technical questions and proposals with the appropriate team.

Support the consumer launch. Engage customers at roadshows and community events, follow up on campaign enquiries and coordinate product demonstrations with the team.

Keep opportunities moving. Maintain accurate CRM records, next steps and follow-up dates. Work towards agreed sales and partnershipgoals, and share customer feedback with the sales, technical and marketingteams.

What You Will Bring

Awillingness to start. Fresh graduates are welcome. Previous full-time sales experience is not required; examples from internships, part-time work, student projects or volunteering are welcome.

Resourcefulness. You can research an unfamiliar market, find the right contact and try a different approach when the first one does not work.

Confidence with people. You enjoy starting conversations, listening carefully and explaining ideas clearly to business customers and members of the community.

Ownership and resilience. You follow through on commitments, stay organised and keep going when an enquiry does not immediately become a sale.

Interesting, purposeful work. You want to learn about fire safety, battery technologies and BESS, and understand how the right solution can address a customer’s needs.

A practical working style. You are comfortable with customer visits, outreach and events, as well as keeping records and coordinating with colleagues.

What We Offer

Purpose, you can see. Work on a product launch centred on protecting people and property and improving preparedness for battery fire risks.

Technical support when you need it. No technical background? Do not worry. Our technical team will support you with product questions, suitability assessments and demonstrations, so you can focus on building relationships and developing sales opportunities.

Experience from the start. Build practical skills in prospecting, customer conversations, quotations, sales follow-up and partnership development.

Exposure to different markets. Work with business customers, community partners and consumers, while exploring opportunities in BESS and battery fire safety.

Room to contribute. Bring ideas for reaching new customers and partners, test them with the team and see how your efforts contribute to the launch.

Requirements

Open to Singapore citizens and permanent residents who are based in Singapore. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Ready to open doors and help build a safer community? Send us your CV and a brief introduction. Tell us about a time you took the initiative, brought people together or made something happen.
