title: Executive/Assistant Manager, Partnerships
description:
Responsibilities

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Executive / Assistant Manager to lead partnerships and partnership marketing across our hotel and serviced residence portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying and growing partnerships that drive room night production, and for bringing them to life through campaigns, collateral and communications.

You will work closely with the Director, Loyalty and CRM, and with cluster, property, marketing and revenue teams, with clear accountability for monitoring, tracking and reporting partnership results.

Partnership Development & Management

  • Identify, develop and manage partnerships with banks, travel, lifestyle, F&B, retail and other relevant brands, prioritising groupwide partnerships with strong potential to drive room night production in addition to brand visibility.
  • Develop compelling partnership propositions, benefits and experiences that add value to our guests, moving beyond discount-led offers.
  • Manage partnerships end-to-end, from opportunity identification and proposal development through to negotiation, activation and performance review.
  • Develop joint campaigns and activations with partners, ensuring all agreed deliverables are executed effectively.
  • Work with cluster and property teams so that property-level partnerships complement groupwide partnerships and build brand awareness for each cluster.
  • Build strong relationships with external partners and with internal commercial, marketing, cluster and property stakeholders.

Customer Engagement & Partnership Marketing

  • Develop and execute customer-facing campaigns and marketing initiatives to build awareness, participation and engagement with partnership offers.
  • Develop campaign concepts, messaging and copy across seasonal, promotional and partner initiatives.
  • Own campaign briefs and work with designers, agencies and internal teams to develop creative assets, collateral and communications.
  • Ensure consistent brand expression and guest experience across digital, social, website, hotel and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Manage the partnership marketing calendar and coordinate campaigns from concept through to launch.

Monitoring, Tracking & Reporting

  • Manage the administration of partnership programmes with both internal and external stakeholders e.g submission of reports to partners for billing 
  • Maintain the Partnership Master List covering all contracted partners, including active partnerships, contract periods, offers, deliverables and production.
  • Track room nights and revenue achieved by each partnership against agreed targets, and report on a regular cadence.
  • Monitor campaign and partnership performance, flag underperformance early, and recommend whether to renew, renegotiate or exit.
  • Prepare performance updates and recommendations for the Director, Loyalty and CRM and senior management.
  • Maintain partnership agreements and supporting documents.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years' experience in partnerships, marketing, brand, loyalty, hospitality, lifestyle or retail.
  • Good understanding of branding, including aligning partner brands with Far East Hospitality in customer-facing communications.
  • Strong partnership and relationship management skills, with the ability to negotiate commercial terms.
  • Strong hands-on experience in campaign development and execution, including creative concepts, copy and marketing collateral.
  • Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders, including external partners, cluster and property teams.
  • Commercially minded and results-driven, with a focus on commercial elements
  • Organised and detail-oriented, able to track, analyse and report performance, and to manage multiple initiatives from idea to execution.
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, lifestyle or loyalty programmes is an advantage.

title: Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships
description:
Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships

Singapore Environment Council (SEC)

Grow Sustainability. Grow Your Career.

The Singapore Environment Council (SEC) is an independent, non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting environmental sustainability and responsible business practices. Through certification programmes, sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement, SEC works with organisations across industries to drive positive environmental impact.

We are looking for a driven, results-oriented Senior/Executive, Business Development & Partnerships to grow SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory business. If you enjoy opening doors, closing deals and building partnerships that create real environmental impact, we would like to hear from you.

If you have a passion for client engagement, business development and sustainability, we would like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Senior/Executive, Client Engagement & Business Development, you will play an important role in growing SEC's certification and sustainability services. You will engage clients and partners, develop new business opportunities, support agreement development, and provide administrative support to ensure smooth departmental operations.

This is an individual contributor position with sales targets and opportunities to develop expertise in sustainability certification programmes and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Identify, qualify and pursue new business opportunities across SEC's certification, sustainability and advisory service offerings.
  • Achieve individual sales targets and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospects.
  • Generate leads through networking, outreach, industry events and targeted campaigns.
  • Conduct presentations and pitches to organisations interested in SEC's programmes and services.
  • Build and maintain relationships with new and existing clients to secure renewals and expand business.

Partnerships & Deal Closing

  • Develop partnerships with industry associations, corporates, government agencies and other stakeholders.
  • Draft, format and negotiate business agreements, Memoranda of Understanding (MOUs) and partnership proposals.
  • Work with internal stakeholders and external parties to move agreements through review to finalisation.
  • Maintain accurate records of agreements, proposals and deal status.

Events & Market Presence

  • Represent SEC at industry events, exhibitions, networking sessions and stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Support the planning and execution of major SEC events and programmes to generate leads and partnerships.

Business Operations Support

  • Prepare sales reports, pipeline updates, presentations and management materials.
  • Coordinate meetings and follow-up actions with the Deputy Director, Client Engagement.
  • Support departmental projects and initiatives as required.

What We're Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships or account management, with a track record of meeting targets.
  • Experience selling services in sustainability, certification, compliance, environmental services, professional services or consulting will be an advantage.
  • Candidates with strong business development experience but no sustainability background are encouraged to apply; we will help you build that expertise.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proactive and target-driven, comfortable with prospecting and outreach.
  • Confident presenter and persuasive communicator, in writing and in person.
  • Able to draft and negotiate business documents with attention to detail.
  • Works independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
  • Manages multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Professional and ethical in handling confidential information.

Additional Information

Occasional regional travel may be required for business development, stakeholder engagement and certification-related activities.

Why Join SEC?

  • Grow a business that directly advances Singapore's sustainability goals.
  • Work with organisations across multiple industries to drive positive environmental impact.
  • Build expertise in sustainability certifications and environmental standards.
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organisation committed to a more sustainable future.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

Diversity & Inclusion

Singapore Environment Council is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, race, religion, marital status, caregiving responsibilities, disability status or background. Selection is based on merit, skills, experience and job-related competencies.

Interested applicants are invited to submit a detailed resume outlining their relevant experience and achievements, including sales or partnership results where possible.

title: Senior Executive/Assistant Manager, Advocacy & Partnerships (Major Gift)
description:
About the Role

This role is suited for are relationship-oriented fundraising professional who enjoys connecting with people, understanding donor motivations and translating meaningful conversations into long-term partnerships.

You will support HCA's major gifts programme by managing donor relationships, preparing tailored proposals and reports, coordinating donor engagement activities, conducting prospect research and working with colleagues across the organisation to develop funding opportunities.

While this role includes fundraising administration where required, its primary focus is building and stewarding relationships that inspire philanthropic giving.

Key Responsibilities

Major Gifts & Donor Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with individual donors, families, philanthropists, corporate partners and foundations.
  • Support the cultivation, solicitation and stewardship of major gift donors across the donor lifecycle.
  • Manage an assigned portfolio of donors and prospects appropriate to experience and organisational needs.
  • Conduct regular donor meetings, presentations and engagement sessions.
  • Prepare personalised stewardship plans and follow-up actions.
  • Coordinate donor visits, programme tours and engagement opportunities.
  • Ensure timely acknowledgement and recognition of donor support.

Prospect Research & Pipeline Development

  • Identify prospective major donors through research and networking opportunities.
  • Prepare donor profiles, briefing papers and meeting notes.
  • Maintain an accurate fundraising pipeline and relationship records.
  • Monitor donor interactions and recommend appropriate next steps.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to identify new funding opportunities.

Proposal Development & Institutional Fundraising

  • Prepare tailored funding proposals, concept papers and donor presentations.
  • Support grant applications and institutional fundraising opportunities.
  • Coordinate donor reports, impact updates and funding reports.
  • Work with programme and clinical colleagues to gather information required for proposals and donor reporting.
  • Assist in developing compelling cases for support aligned with HCA's funding priorities.

Stewardship & Donor Engagement

  • Develop meaningful stewardship experiences that strengthen donor relationships.
  • Coordinate donor appreciation events, recognition activities and engagement opportunities.
  • Ensure donors receive timely updates on the impact of their support.
  • Work with the communications team on donor stories and engagement materials where appropriate.

Partnerships & Fundraising Initiatives

  • Support corporate partnership discussions and community fundraising initiatives.
  • Represent HCA Hospice at networking events, meetings and fundraising activities where appropriate.
  • Support fundraising campaigns and special projects led by the Advocacy & Partnerships Department.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across HCA to identify opportunities for donor engagement.

Department Support

  • Prepare reports, presentations and fundraising updates.
  • Maintain accurate donor records using HCA's donor management system.
  • Support departmental planning, budgeting and fundraising administration where required.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of fundraising processes and donor experience.
  • Undertake other duties reasonably related to the role that support the department's fundraising and engagement objectives.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, is naturally curious about people and is motivated by creating meaningful partnerships that make a lasting difference.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Business, Communications, Marketing, Social Sciences, Non profit Management or a related discipline.

Experience

  • Approximately three to six years of relevant experience for Senior Executive level, or five or more years for Assistant Manager level, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies.
  • Experience in fundraising, philanthropy, donor relations, business development, account management, partnership management, relationship management or a similar c slient-facing role would be advantageous.
  • Experience in the charity, healthcare or social service sector is welcome but not essential.

Skills

  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to prepare donor proposals, reports and correspondence.
  • Strong presentation and meeting facilitation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple donor relationships and priorities.
  • Good organisational and project management skills.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office and Teams
  • Comfortable learning and working with donor management systems or CRM platforms.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion and integrity.

Attributes for Success

You may be a good fit if you are:

  • A confident and authentic relationship builder.
  • Curious and proactive in identifying opportunities.
  • Comfortable engaging senior stakeholders and donors.
  • An excellent listener with empathy and professionalism.
  • Organised and able to follow through on commitments.
  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams.
  • Adaptable and comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Motivated by meaningful work and creating social impact.

Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support donor engagement activities and fundraising events.

What You Can Expect

As part of HCA Hospice's Advocacy & Partnerships team, you will contribute to building meaningful philanthropic partnerships that enable compassionate care for patients and families.

The role offers broad exposure to:

  • Major gifts fundraising
  • Individual giving
  • Corporate and foundation partnerships
  • Institutional fundraising
  • Donor stewardship
  • Proposal development
  • Fundraising strategy and pipeline management
  • Stakeholder engagement within Singapore's charity and healthcare sector

Working alongside colleagues across fundraising, communications, finance, operations and clinical services, you will have the opportunity to develop practical experience across the full donor journey while contributing to HCA Hospice's mission.

title: Academy Executive (Partnerships)
description:
Job Description

Join us as Academy Executive (Partnerships)!

Are you looking for a fulfilling job that provides opportunities for you to make a real difference to the community and youth through meaningful work? Are you looking for a place of work that promotes a culture of growth and development, while having fun? We are looking for an Academy Executive (Partnerships) to join our growing full-time team.

Halogen aims to inspire and influence a generation of young people to lead themselves and others well, and we take that mission seriously with our staff as well. Being a youth development organisation, we work with the youthful vibrancy of our stakeholders and students, ensuring that while we do the social good of building young leaders and entrepreneurs, we also do the personal good of building a staff team that is enabled to do their best work. As an Academy Executive, you will play an important role in partnering multiple stakeholders, both local and in the ASEAN region to drive our youth programmes. You will be in charge of managing the partners who engage with us, and work closely with stakeholders to find opportunities to collaborate.

Responsibilities 

  • Lead and facilitate training workshops/ learning sessions, helping youth we work with to build character, mindsets and skill sets. Facilitate group sizes up to 45 participants confidently.
  • Programme management - lead, organise and execute Halogen programmes and events.
  • Manage our youth community within our fellowship and accelerator programmes, supporting youth in their development, while continually improving and enhancing the infrastructure of the programmes.
  • Support the organisation in our work within ASEAN, engaging different stakeholders to open opportunities for collaboration.
  • Manage partnerships directly with corporates, social impact organisations, and educational institutions to ensure successful implementation of programmes through effective communication.
  • •Support outreach efforts to widen our net of partners to expand Halogen’s scope ofwork.

A typical week at work involves

  • Working with a range partners from corporates, to social impact organisations and institutions, managing conversations, and finding avenues to align objectives of our partners to Halogen’s long term growth plan.
  • Leading on key events and programmes organised by Halogen. 
  • Working alongside youths and stakeholders to ensure the successful design of our youth accelerator programme.
  • Team meetings that cover programme planning, outreach to stakeholders, and managing progress of partnerships. 
  • Work alongside the Fundraising department to secure funds and resources for programmes.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience managing partnerships, events and programmes. Experiences working on programmes regionally in ASEAN would be considered favourably.
  • Passionate in youth development and our agency as people who can build a future for Singapore and the region, putting people above all else.
  • Energetic and dynamic, able to engage diverse stakeholders both locally and regionally.
  • Excellent interpersonal, coordination, and communication skills that can adapt across different types and levels of stakeholders.
  • Meticulous and detail-oriented, with a good understanding of managing professional relationships.
  • Enjoy a fast-paced working and learning environment.• Strategic and data-driven in decision-making.

How To Apply

  • Send your cover letter and resume to recruit@halogen.sg with the subject title:“Job Application – Academy Executive (Partnerships)”
  • Your cover letter should include the following:
  1. Why you are interested in working at Halogen,
  2. What you bring as a unique edge that sets you apart from everyone else, and
  3. Why you feel this is the right role for you at this particular time of your life.

Benefits

What You’ll Achieve 

By the end of your first month,

  • You would have a working understanding of the ins-and-outs of the charity organisation, social service sector, and how our programmes plays a key role in Halogen.
  • You would have built a healthy working relationship with your team and built an understanding of each other’s working styles.
  • You would have a clear view on what you would like to achieve for the organisation in the short- and long-term.

By the end of your sixth month

  • You would have contributed significantly and proven to be a valued member of the team.
  • You would have built strong relationships with local and overseas stakeholders, and become the bridge for the Halogen team to these stakeholders.
  • You would be the first port-of-call for all things related to your accounts and programmes.

By the end of your first year,

  • You would hold an expert understanding on our accelerator and international programmes, and how we can continue to push the envelope in expanding our outreach.
  • You would be able to lead discussions effectively, working alongside the Accelerator and Events team to conceptualise effective youth development programmes for partners you are in conversations with. 
  • You would have helped the organisation grow our accelerator offerings, and our work around ASEAN. ​

What You’ll Get 

  • A competitive package that includes healthcare, welfare, insurance, and travel allowances.
  • Annual leave of 14 days, and utility of flexi-work and telecommuting schemes.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a substantial impact on the youth development scene in the region.
  • You will gain first-hand experience in expanding an organisation’s scope to work, to further our outreach to impact youths in Singapore, and in the region.
  • You will interface regularly with the senior management team, and other managers as you work with each department on their day-to-day.
  • There will be regular 1:1 sessions that explore your work, discuss your future options, and open up new opportunities for your career and development.
  • You will have a chance to explore other competencies such as training & development, event management, and impact measurement.

title: Executive, Fundraising & Partnerships
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Founded in 1978 as Singapore's first family service centre, Allkin Singapore is a community-centric social service agency that believes everyone has the potential to create positive change, regardless of age, race, or background.

Through our service offerings, strategic partnerships, and community initiatives, we unlock opportunities for vulnerable individuals and families to overcome life's challenges, build a brighter future, and inspire others to do the same.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Allkin Singapore is a social service organisation that believes in the power of community to drive change. We work alongside partners and residents to strengthen families, build social connections, and foster a culture of care and contribution.

As Executive, Fundraising & Partnerships, you will play a key role in supporting fundraising initiatives and strategic partnerships that help sustain and grow our impact. Working closely with the Senior Executive, you will contribute to donor engagement, partnership development, fundraising campaigns, impact reporting, and stakeholder stewardship. This role is ideal for a resourceful and organised individual who is passionate about building meaningful partnerships and advancing positive social outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Fundraising & Donor Development
  • Research and identify prospective donors, corporate partners, foundations, grantmakers, and funding opportunities.
  • Support donor outreach, cultivation, and engagement activities.
  • Develop grant applications, partnership proposals, sponsorship decks, donor presentations, and fundraising collateral.
  • Work with programme teams to gather programme information, funding needs, budgets, impact data, and beneficiary stories.
  • Maintain and track the fundraising pipeline, including donor engagement status and follow-up actions.
  1. Donor & Partner Engagement
  • Support the stewardship and engagement of donors, corporate partners, foundations, and key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate donor meetings, site visits, appreciation activities, and partnership engagements.
  • Manage donor communications, acknowledgements, and recognition requirements.
  • Ensure timely fulfilment of partnership and sponsorship commitments.
  • Build and maintain positive, long-term relationships with donors and partners.
  1. Impact Reporting & Accountability
  • Compile programme outcomes, impact data, and beneficiary stories for donor reporting.
  • Prepare donor impact reports, partnership updates, and stewardship materials.
  • Track reporting timelines, funding utilisation, and donor requirements.
  • Support data collection and impact tracking to demonstrate the outcomes of donor and partner support.
  1. Fundraising Campaigns & Events
  • Support the planning and execution of fundraising campaigns, events, and community fundraising initiatives.
  • Coordinate internal teams, partners, vendors, and service providers to ensure successful event delivery.
  • Work with the communications team to develop fundraising content and campaign materials.
  • Assist with post-campaign reporting, evaluation, and donor follow-up activities.
  1. Operations & Administration
  • Maintain accurate donor, donation, and partnership records within relevant systems.
  • Support fundraising reporting, budget tracking, invoice processing, and reconciliation activities.
  • Monitor fundraising performance and prepare regular management updates.
  • Ensure proper documentation and compliance with governance, audit, and reporting requirements.
  • Manage fundraising and partnership enquiries through shared mailboxes and communication channels.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Diploma or Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in fundraising, partnerships, marketing, stakeholder engagement, or a related function.
  • Prior experience in the social service or non-profit sector is preferred but not essential.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Experience in donor management, event coordination, CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce), and digital marketing will be an advantage.
  • Personal Attributes
    • Passionate about community impact and committed to advancing Allkin Singapore's mission through meaningful partnerships and fundraising initiatives.
    • Proactive, resourceful, detail-oriented, and able to work independently.
    • Professional integrity with a collaborative, customer-centric approach and commitment to excellence.
OTHER INFORMATION

Liberte HR Services Pte Ltd is the designated recruitment partner for Allkin Singapore. As part of the hiring process, you may receive communication from them regarding this opportunity.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - Allkin Singapore Ltd

title: Senior Executive / Associate Manager, Partnerships
description:

The firm has become a leadingone-stop digital payment, digital banking, and digital asset solution provider.It is currently building Asia's fully licensed financial platform, helpinginstitutions and businesses connect between traditional and next-generationfinancial services. ●       FOMO Payment – One-stop digital payment solution for merchants, corporates and financial institutions

●       FOMO iBiz – Facilitate businesses' everyday requirements for transactional banking needs

●       FOMO Treasury – One-stop digital asset services provider bridging Web 2.0& Web 3.0

For more information, please visit www.fomopay.com.
For recruitment inquiries, contact recruitment@fomopay.com.

Join and Grow with us!

At FOMO Group, we are dedicated to redefining what is possible in digital payments, global banking, investment solutions, and tokenized assets. We seek forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for innovation and are eager to lead industry disruption. As part of our transformation journey, you will work alongside visionary leaders with a proven track record of shaping the future of finance.

We believe in unlocking the potential of every individual. We offer an inclusive, supportive, and continuous learning culture where everyone can grow to their full potential and achieve their personal and professional goals. Join our team and be part of an exciting evolution in the industry.

Visit www.fomogroup.com for more information.

About the Role!

As our Senior Executive / Associate Manager, Partnerships, you will work closely with the Head of Partnerships to develop and manage strategic alliances that fuel FOMO Pay's business growth, product innovation, and global market expansion. In this dynamic role, you will help shape the future of finance by nurturing vital existing relationships and proactively onboarding new partners who align with our visionary goals. From supporting high-stakes commercial negotiations to coordinating seamlessly with internal teams, you will champion these partnerships from initial engagement through technical integration and a successful go-live, playing a pivotal part in our industry-disrupting transformation journey.

Key Responsibilities:

●       Strategic Relationship Management: Manage and cultivate relationships with existing strategic partners - including banks, payment networks, and digital asset providers - ensuring effective collaboration and identifying avenues for commercial expansion.

●       Partner Acquisition & Onboarding: Identify, evaluate, and onboard new partners aligned with FOMO Pay’s business strategy, product roadmap, and global market expansion plans.

●       Commercial Negotiation: Lead commercial discussions and negotiations, defining pricing structures, service scope, implementation requirements, and contractual terms to optimize business outcomes.

●       End-to-End Compliance Management: Oversee the partner onboarding lifecycle, including comprehensive due diligence, KYC/KYB coordination, internal approvals, and periodic risk reviews.

●       Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the central liaison coordinating with Business, Product, Technology, Compliance, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams to ensure seamless partner integration.

●       Performance Monitoring: Track partner performance metrics, operational SLAs, and service quality. Proactively identify operational bottlenecks and manage required escalations.

●       Strategic Optimization: Conduct regular partner business reviews to uncover opportunities for commercial optimization, product alignment, or expanded strategic collaboration.

●       Pipeline &Reporting: Maintain a robust partnership pipeline, commercial terms, and documentation repository. Provide concise, regular reporting to the Head of Partnerships on ongoing negotiations, integration statuses, and market opportunities.

Requirements:

●       Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

●       3–5 years of proven experience in partnerships, business development, or key account management within fintech, financial services, Web3, digital assets, or the wider payments industry.

●       Deep understanding of the global fintech and digital payments ecosystem, including familiarity with banks, payment service providers, financial institutions, and digital asset service providers.

●       Demonstrated success in independently managing complex commercial discussions, partner onboarding, and cross-functional project delivery.

●       Highly comfortable coordinating with Product and Technology teams on API or system integrations from a strategic business perspective.

●       Exceptional relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively with both external executives and internal teams.

●       Strong analytical, problem-solving, and written/verbal communication skills, coupled with meticulous attention to detail.

●      Proactive, commercially driven, and highly adaptable, with the ability to thrive and concurrently manage multiple workstreams in FOMO Pay's fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

Our Perks and Benefits:

●       Competitive Compensation and Benefit Package

●       Group Hospitalisation and Medical Insurance

●       Fun and Dynamic Environment with plenty of learning and growth opportunities

●       Career Advancement

●       Professional Development Training Workshops

●       Team Building Sessions

title: Partnerships Marketing Senior Executive
description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Partnerships Marketing Senior Executive, APAC to join our Marketing team and help us unleash the potential of our business.

title: Programmes and Partnerships cum Admin Executive
description:
Core Function

This is a dual reporting position.

As the Programmes and Partnerships (P&P) Executive, the incumbent assists the HOD in programme planning, development and implementation tailored for persons with disabilities (PWDs), as well as managing partners/stakeholders including Allied Health Professionals (AHPs), corporate partners, community partners, volunteers and caregivers. This role focuses on managing AHP partnership/intervention and engaging caregivers. Hence, the P&P Executive works closely with caregivers and clients, AHPs and colleagues, to create a supportive environment that promotes personal growth and community integration for the clients.

Working directly with the Executive Director, the incumbent provides high-level strategic and administrative support. This role acts as a key resource in advancing organisational goals by coordinating strategic projects with the Management team, and leading SUN-DAC's compliance and governance initiatives.

Core Responsibilities

1. Management of AHP services

  • Coordinates and manages the contracts, including the deployment and performance evaluation of the outsourced AHP services
  • Executes and reviews the monthly training plans by the AHPs for the Training Officer group
  • Assists in planning and delivering structured interventions with the AHPs, and reviews the processes and effectiveness
  • Works together with the AHPs to prepare quarterly reports for Board Programme Committee and monthly report for Management meetings

2. Collaboration with Partners

  • Engages with schools, community partners, and corporate partners to share about SUN-DAC's services and conduct workshops on understanding and communicating with PWDs
  • Recruits suitable volunteers or interns to support with community-based and AHP programmes

3. Caregiver Engagement

  • Plans, organises, and executes caregivers' engagement sessions through various platforms to ensure that the caregivers are engaged, aligning to the strategic plan
  • Facilitates feedback and prepares reports and summary of the engagement session to ensure that the engagement is effective
  • Tracks budget utilisation for caregiver engagement
  • Seeks out collaborations and partners for caregiver's engagement session

4. Administrative Duties in the Programmes and Partnerships Team

  • Coverage for the other team members in their absence, in the area of volunteer management, stakeholder partnerships, and programme development
  • Prepares documents and reports to seek funding for the programme, and presentation to stakeholders
  • Any other duties assigned by HOD

5. Executive Support & Strategic Administration

  • Drafts, reviews, and prepares high quality reports and presentation decks to support the Executive Director
  • Supports the execution and tracking of strategic organisational projects, including Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives
  • Assists in the systematic review and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Policies
  • Manages and upholds Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) compliance across the organisation, ensuring data privacy standards and protocols are rigorously maintained
  • Performs other strategic, administrative, or operational duries as directed by the ED

Core Job Specific Competencies

  • Client- and family-centric
  • High levels of patience and passion for working with adults with disabilities
  • Negotiation - negotiates skillfully in tough situations
  • Innovations Management - brings creative ideas of self and others to fruition
  • Action Orientation - works hard and maintains high energy; seizes opportunity
  • Time Management - uses time effectively and efficiently; can attend to a broad range of activities
  • Resourcefulness - recruits the best people and volunteers available for positions, as well as solicits like-minded partners/organisations for programmes and fundraising
  • Motivating Others - creates a climate in which people want to do their best

Core Job Requirements

Education

  • Postgraduate, bachelor's degree, or Diploma, preferably in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling, or Project Management

Experience

  • Experience with social service and working with PWDs will be an advantage

Skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with caregivers, stakeholders, and clients
  • Strong organisational abilities to manage multiple programs and activities simultaneously
  • Ability to work collaboratively with team members, volunteers, and community and corporate partners
  • Creative thinking and adaptability to address challenges and make decisions in dynamic environments
  • Knowledge of program design, implementation, and evaluation processes, particularly in a community setting
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, and experience with data management systems

title: Programmes and Partnerships Manager/Executive
description:
Reporting to: Principals, IDH and ICS

The Programmes & Partnership Manager/Executive is responsible for planning and administering a robust Extra Curricular Programme (ECA) that is attractive to our students in Years 1 through 13 on both campuses, and also supports the academic programme offered throughout the regular school day. The Programmes & Partnerships Manager/Executive collaborates with the PE Academic Team; the Marketing and Admissions Team, school receptionists and secretaries, and school leadership. 

Key Responsibilities

The ECA Executive must respond to the interests and needs of the educational leaders, students and parents to develop a holistic, challenging and engaging programme of after-school activities encompassing sports, life skills, the arts, technology, and outdoor education. 

The post holder must:

  • Create and maintain a brochure advertising the programme to the community
  • Maintain an online registration and payment platform
  • Track data regarding student interest, demands, enrollment and areas for strategic development
  • Organise key events to showcase ECAs within the school community, including competitions, performances and exhibitions
  • Maintain professional, timely and constructive communication with key stakeholders, including parents, students, activity vendors, teachers, school leadership and school administration
  • Monitor daily attendance records
  • Review the quality of the ECA programme and providers at regular intervals 
  • Ensure that all providers have been vetted for appropriateness to work with children through completed appropriate background checks and safeguarding training before working with children, and annually thereafter

1. Planning and Coordination

  • Find, develop and manage partnerships with various programme vendors to create vibrant learning opportunities for students in Singapore Invictus schools.

  • Oversee and manage programming plans, timelines and implementation from start to finish.

  • Assess operational and logistical requirements for programming; work with finance, operations, outside vendors, and other external partners as needed.

  • Demonstrate ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate school policies, procedures, rules, and regulations to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Manage partners and other resources to ensure proper coordination of all program components and logistics.

  • Create a positive experience through designing, setting up and managing registration systems and processes.

  • Undertake appropriate risk assessments for each ECA, including compiling and maintaining medical information of participants, maintaining supervision ratios, and establishing clear emergency procedures appropriate to the venue and activity.

2. Communications

  • Cultivate business relationships with external stakeholders and potential partners for large-scale programming opportunities.

  • Negotiate financial terms and agreements with programme vendors.

  • Define marketing plans and create all programme-related content and communications including programme descriptions, written correspondence, broadcast emails, social media, and registrations, etc.

  • Handle feedback/complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.

3. Programme Development 

  • Build strong relationships and work collaboratively with all external and internal stakeholders to ensure best-in-class programming for student(s) and the school(s).

  • Collaborate with existing vendors and conduct direct outreach to solicit new and strengthen relationships with vendors/prospective partners and to build interest for programmes.

  • Handle ad-hoc duties/ projects as assigned by the Supervisor/Principal

About the Division

The Retail Distribution Division is responsible for the growth of multiple channels including Bancassurance, Intermediaries, Direct channels, and Partnerships. It is also responsible for delivering service excellence for all UOI customers and increasing market awareness of UOI to achieve consumer trust and recognition.

Job Purpose

The Bancassurance Executive is responsible for ensuring smooth operational processes for bancassurance partnerships. This role focuses on coordinating with bank partners, managing documentation, and supporting compliance and service delivery. Key responsibilities include sales and commission reporting and tracking, conducting regular cadences with bank stakeholders, executing and tracking initiatives, and identifying new opportunities. The Executive will work closely with internal teams and bank stakeholders to resolve operational issues, track performance, and maintain strong partner relationships.

Key Responsibilities


1. Partner Coordination

Serve as the main point of contact for operational affairs with banking partners and hold regular updates to assess performance and projects. Arrange meetings, draft agendas, log outcomes, and monitor agreed tasks. Guarantee a minimum of 95% of planned catch-ups take place on schedule and action points are resolved within the specified periods.

2. Sales & Commission Reporting

Compile, manage, and verify precise summaries regarding sales results, commission payments, and operational data. Carry out reconciliation and variance analysis. Achieve 100%accuracy in reports and ensure submission within 3 working days of month-end.

3. Initiative Execution

Assist in the rollout and monitoring of projects designed to boost bancassurance results and client satisfaction. Track schedules, report on milestones, and flag delays or potential risks ahead of time. Ensure 90% of initiatives are delivered within agreed timelines and KPIs.

4. Opportunity Identification

Partner with stakeholders to discover fresh business avenues and operational upgrades. Review market trends and offer suggestions for development. Present at least one actionable opportunity per quarter

5. Compliance & Audit

Ensure adherence to regulatory and internal audit requirements. Prepare audit documentation, assist in compliance reviews, and implement corrective actions where necessary. Achieve zero non-compliance findings in audits and complete corrective actions within agreed timeline.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work with underwriting, claims, and operations teams to ensure smooth policy issuance and servicing. Coordinate with multiple teams for issue resolution and process improvements. Resolve 95% of escalated issues within SLA timelines.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Business, Finance, or related field.
  • 1–2 years in bancassurance, insurance operations, or financial services support (preferably with exposure to partner coordination).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP) and reporting tools. Familiar with CRM systems and bancassurance processes.
  • Ability to interpret sales and commission data, identify variances, and provide actionable insights.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to liaise with bank stakeholders and internal teams effectively.
  • Understanding of regulatory requirements and audit processes in insurance.
  • Detail-oriented, organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and proactive in problem-solving.

title: Senior Executive/Executive, Donor Engagement (Community Engagement and Partnerships)
description:
Senior Executive/Executive, Donor Engagement

The Senior Executive/Executive of Donor Engagement ensures every supporter experiences a consistent, timely and meaningful engagement journey. Reporting to the Senior Manager, the role translates stewardship plans into consistent day-to-day execution while maintaining high standards of donor experience, operational excellence and governance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Relationship Management and Stewardship

  • Coordinate and deliver donor stewardship initiatives that recognise, thank and engage supporters throughout their giving journey.
  • Manage donor touchpoints including welcome journeys, thank-you communications, impact updates, milestone recognition, renewal reminders and re-engagement initiatives.
  • Ensure donor enquiries, commitments and requests are managed professionally, accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Participate in donor meetings, networking opportunities, programme visits and engagement activities to develop relationship management and fundraising capabilities.
  • Manage selected donor relationships and stewardship portfolios as assigned, with increasing responsibility as capability develops.

2. Stewardship Strategies and Portfolio Growth

  • Operationalise the Society's donor stewardship strategy by coordinating and managing engagement activities across the entire donor lifecycle, ensuring supporters receive a consistent and meaningful experience.
  • Monitor stewardship timelines and proactively identify overdue or missed engagements, working closely with relationship managers to maintain agreed service standards.
  • Monitor stewardship service standards and operational KPIs, identifying trends, gaps and opportunities to strengthen donor retention, engagement quality and operational effectiveness.
  • Support fundraising campaigns, donor engagement initiatives and partnership activities through research, coordination and stakeholder engagement.
  • Conduct prospect research and prepare background information, donor profiles and meeting briefs for relationship managers.

3. Engagement Delivery

  • Coordinate the delivery of donor meetings, programme visits, stewardship events and engagement activities, ensuring a positive and seamless supporter experience.
  • Prepare correspondence, proposals, reports and presentation materials that support effective donor engagement and fundraising activities.
  • Develop and maintain stewardship calendars, engagement trackers and operational schedules to ensure timely execution of stewardship activities across donor portfolios.
  • Coordinate donor segmentation, mailing lists and communication schedules to ensure supporters receive timely, relevant and personalised engagement.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate donor recognition, impact reporting, communications and engagement opportunities.

4. Governance and Administration

  • Support the upkeep of donor records, engagement histories, pledges, preferences and relationship information within the Society's donor management system.
  • Develop and maintain workflow processes, standard operating procedures and operational templates that support consistent donor engagement.
  • Continuously review stewardship workflows and recommend process improvements that enhance donor experience, strengthen operational efficiency and improve team productivity.
  • Ensure all stewardship activities comply with organisational policies, safeguarding requirements, fundraising regulations, due diligence processes and data governance standards.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Postgraduate qualifications preferred.
  • Relevant experience in fundraising or relationship management will be advantageous, particularly within the social service or non-profit sector.
  • Experience engaging diverse stakeholders and building professional relationships.
  • Familiarity with governance, compliance or fundraising regulations will be advantageous.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.


Personal Attributes

  • Compassionate, approachable and genuinely enjoys meeting and connecting with people.
  • Proactive, self-motivated and comfortable initiating conversations and building relationships.
  • Confident communicator who represents the Society professionally.
  • Well organised, adaptable and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • High integrity and strong commitment to the well-being and protection of children.

title: Events Executive (Activations Executive)
description:
Events Executive (Activations Executive)

About Association of Advertising & Marketing Singapore (AAMS)

Association of Advertising & Marketing Singapore (AAMS) is a non-profit trade association and professional body representing all aspects of Advertising, Marketing, Media, and Communications. We work closely with partners, members, and stakeholders towards excellence in the Admarcom industry. Our members comprise brand marketers across all businesses, industries, advertising & media agencies, and media owners.

We organise Singapore’s most respected industry platforms, including:

  • Effie Singapore Awards
  • Singapore Media Marketing Awards (SMMA)
  • GONG Awards
  • Crowbar Awards
  • Hall of Fame
  • NexGen Awards
  • Industry conferences
  • Membership events

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organised Activations Executive to support the planning and execution of AAMS awards, conferences and membership events.

This is a hands-on role focused on logistics, systems setup and operational coordination. You will work closely with the Head of Activations to ensure events and judging processes are executed accurately and efficiently.

Your Scope of Work

1. Event Planning & Execution

  • Coordinate venue logistics, AV setup, registration counters and on-site Activations.
  • Plan and execute AAMS industry awards, conferences and membership events i.e. networking events and roundtables.
  • Manage production materials and printed assets, such as banners, posters, trophies etc.
  • Support rehearsals and run-of-show execution.
  • Ensure events are delivered according to operational timelines.

2. Awards & Judging Activations

  • Set up and manage entry and registration portals.
  • Configure and ensure judging portals are fully operational prior to judging sessions.
  • Coordinate in-person judging logistics i.e. venue set-up, materials and score management.
  • Collate and tabulate judges’ scores accurately.
  • Ensure confidentiality and integrity of judging processes.

3. Membership & Conference Events

  • Manage speaker logistics including briefing materials, slide collection, scheduling, and on-site coordination.
  • Oversee delegate registration and attendance reporting.
  • Ensure smooth front-of-house Activations during events.

4. Partner & Vendor Coordination

  • Liaise with vendors, venues and production partners to ensure operational requirements are met.
  • Coordinate production partners, printers and venue teams.
  • Support fulfilment of sponsor deliverables from an Activations standpoint.

5. Finance & Administration

  • Track event expenses and purchase orders.
  • Monitor outstanding payments and maintain organised documentation of contracts and invoices.
  • Prepare post-event reports.

Requirements

  • Minimum 1 year experience in events management or project coordination.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (especially Excel).
  • Familiar with Canva and Adobe is an advantage.
  • Highly detail-oriented (accuracy is critical).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willing to work occasional evenings during events.

title: Events Executive
description:
Singapore Squash is the National Sports Association for the sport of squash in Singapore. We are seeking an energetic, driven and passionate individual to join our multi-cultural and vibrant team as an Events Executive.

If you are excited by the opportunity to be at the heart of national sporting events, work alongside top athletes, and contribute to the growth of squash in Singapore and beyond, we would love to hear from you.

Why Join Singapore Squash?

At Singapore Squash, you will gain valuable exposure to both local and international sporting environments while working in a collaborative and dynamic setting.

What You Can Look Forward To

Opportunity to work alongside national and regionalathletes

Exposure to international and professional sporting bodies

Hands-on experience in local and international event operations

Casual and friendly work environment with relaxed dress code

Convenient office location next to Stadium MRT

Guaranteed 13th Month Annual Wage Supplement (AWS)

Performance-based year-end bonus opportunities

Opportunities for professional growth and development within the sports industry

About the Role

The Events Executive plays a key role in supporting the successful planning, coordination, and execution of Singapore Squash’s tournaments, programmes, and events. This position is integral to ensuring operational excellence and supporting the SSRA Board in advancing the sport locally and internationally.

You will play the leading role in the design and execution of the Primary Schools tournament series which will kick off in 2027.You will have the opportunity to lead (with supervision of the Events Manager) on a new initiative, which will serve as an important pipeline toward the pathway development of our sport.

You will also be involved in both the strategic planning and ground execution of other events, making this an ideal role for someone who enjoys being both the “brains and brawn” behind successful sporting experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning & Operations

End-to-end planning and execution of Singapore Squash’s annual local tournaments and events calendar

Coordinate all operational aspects of tournaments and events to ensure smooth delivery

Manage tournament administration using platforms such as Tournament Software/Planner and SportyHQ, including:

  • Seeding
  • Draws
  • Scheduling
  • Tournament management

Marketing & Communications

Develop and execute marketing initiatives and social media campaigns for tournaments and events

Create engaging promotional content to drive participation and audience engagement

Support event publicity and communications efforts across relevant platforms

Stakeholder & Volunteer Management

Coordinate and manage event volunteers, including National Training Programme athletes

Source and liaise with referees and officials fortournaments as required

Build and maintain positive working relationshipswith Associate Clubs, International Federations, Athletes, Vendors, Eventpartners and stakeholders

Financial & Administrative Support

Manage event budgets - ensure revenue and expenditure are in line

Ensure procurement processes comply with SSRA procurement guidelines

Coordinate timely processing of payments, revenues,claims, and reconciliations with the Events Manager

Assist in preparation of post-event reports,including operational reviews and performance metrics

Additional Responsibilities

Provide support for other SSRA programmes andinitiatives as required

Undertake additional duties that commensurate withthe level of the role

What We’re Looking For

Requirements

Strong and active interest in sports is essential

Interest or experience in squash will be an advantage

Minimum ITE or Diploma qualification, preferably in:

  • Sports Management
  • Business Administration
  • Marketing
  • Communications
  • Physical Education, or related disciplines

Fresh graduates with athlete backgrounds or strong sporting interest are encouraged to apply

Candidates with at least 1 year of relevant sports or event management experience will have an advantage

Skills & Attributes

  • Tech-savvy and willing to learn event management software platforms
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word,Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  • Familiarity with Canva, Adobe, WordPress or other design tools is a plus
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills
  • Excellent organisational and project management abilities
  • Creative, resourceful, and able to think independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced event environment
  • Willing to work evenings and weekends during event periods when required

Remuneration

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and relevant experience.

Join Us

If you are passionate about sports and excited about delivering impactful sporting events, we invite you to be part of Singapore Squash’s journey in growing the sport and supporting athletes at every level.

Apply now and be part of a team that brings the squash community together through world-class events and programmes.

title: Programmes & Events Executive
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Programmes & Events Executive with a background in Mass Communication to provide maternity cover for the Assistant Manager (Prevention & Restoration) role. The incumbent will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing key programmes, outreach campaigns, and events that align with our mission to promote community awareness, empowerment, and support services. This role requires a balance of hands-on event management, stakeholder engagement, and communication strategy, ensuring programme continuity and visibility during the cover period.

Key Responsibilities

Programme & Event Coordination

- Plan, organize, and execute community programmes, workshops, and outreach events under the Prevention & Restoration pillars.
- Work closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth implementation and alignment with programme objectives.
- Oversee event logistics, vendor coordination, and budget tracking.
- Prepare post-event reports, feedback summaries, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

Communication & Public Engagement

- Develop and execute communication materials (press releases, social media posts, and event collaterals) to enhance public engagement.

Stakeholder & Volunteer Management

- Maintain relationships with programme partners, sponsors, and vendors.
- Engage and coordinate volunteers for community activities and events.
- Support the documentation of partner deliverables and engagement outcomes.

- Engage with key community leaders, policymakers, non-profit partners, and funders to promote programme goals and secure support and funding.

- Negotiate with service providers and vendors to ensure high-quality resources are obtained at cost-effective prices.

Monitoring & Reporting

- Track project timelines, deliverables, and outcomes to ensure programme milestones are achieved.
- Prepare and submit progress updates, financial summaries, and impact reports to management.

Compliance and Reporting

- Oversee the compliance of programmes with all applicable laws, regulations, and grant/funding requirements.

- Develop comprehensive reports detailing programme progress, outcomes, and metrics for internal and external audiences, including regulatory bodies and funding agencies.

- Implement robust systems for data collection and analysis to ensure accurate reporting and inform ongoing programme adjustments

Innovation & Improvement

- Contribute creative ideas for improving programme design, event engagement, and outreach impact.
- Propose new approaches for digital storytelling and awareness campaigns leveraging your Mass Communication background.

Requirements

- Degree in Mass Communication, Events Management, or its equivalent.
- At least 3 years of experience in programme coordination, events management, or public engagement.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and familiar with event management tools or social media platforms.
- Creative thinker with attention to detail and the ability to work under tight timelines.

title: Events Executive
description:
About Koocester

Koocester Group is a luxury lifestyle media company covering homes, business, food, autos and wealth. We bring audiences, brands and communities together through content and experiences.

We are looking for an Events Executive who can turn an event brief into a well-organised experience. You will work closely with our marketing, sales and content teams, taking ownership of the details from planning through event-day delivery and follow-up.

What you will do

  • Plan and coordinate networking sessions, brand activations, community gatherings, workshops and other Koocester events.
  • Build event timelines, checklists, budgets and run-of-show documents, with clear responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Source venues and suppliers, compare quotations, negotiate costs and coordinate bookings within approved budgets.
  • Coordinate speakers, hosts, guests, sponsors, vendors and event crew.
  • Work with marketing on event listings, promotional materials, registration and attendee communications.
  • Coordinate agreed sponsor deliverables with the commercial team, including branding, guest arrangements and event visibility.
  • Manage registration, setup, rehearsals, programme flow, troubleshooting and teardown.
  • Track expenditure, invoices and outstanding items, escalating changes before they affect the budget or delivery.
  • Prepare post-event reports covering attendance, expenditure, feedback, sponsor fulfilment and improvements.
  • Maintain organised event records and ensure relevant attendee follow-up reaches the responsible team.

What we are looking for

  • Practical experience planning and delivering events, with clear examples of your personal responsibilities.
  • Strong organisation and follow-through across multiple deadlines.
  • Confidence communicating with suppliers, clients, partners and attendees.
  • Comfort working with quotations, budgets, spreadsheets and project trackers.
  • Resourcefulness when plans change, with sound judgement about when to act and when to escalate.
  • Ability to work independently in a small, growing team and contribute directly on event days.
  • Availability to support scheduled evening or weekend events.

Experience with brand activations, networking events, lifestyle communities or exhibitions is useful.

What success looks like

Events run to the agreed plan and budget. Guests and partners receive a professional experience. Risks surface early, records stay accurate, and each event produces clear learning and follow-up.

To apply

Email at hiring@koocester.com or fill in our form at koocester.com/careers

company: QUANTUM LEAP CAREER CONSULTANCY PTE. LTD.
title: Regional Client Events Executive (6 months Renewable Contract)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Step into a world of timeless luxury, craftsmanship, and elevated client experiences. We are seeking a meticulous and proactive Client Events Executive to join our Regional Team on a 6-month renewable contract.

In this pivotal role, you will bring our Maison’s global vision to life across key regional markets, upholding strict HQ standards while executing unforgettable, high-end client events. Working in tandem with local market teams, event production partners, and regional leadership, you will oversee end-to-end event execution, budget management, and post-event ROI analysis.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Regional Event Execution & HQ Alignment: Oversee global HQ event guidelines across regional markets, ensuring every high-end client activation reflects the brand's luxury codes and aesthetic precision.

  • Vendor & Production Coordination: Brief local markets, negotiate with high-end vendors, and direct event production teams to ensure seamless execution.

  • Project & Budget Management: Manage day-to-day project workflows, maintain event budgets, track event inventory, and ensure spatial setups match approved planograms.

  • Performance & ROI Analysis: Prepare executive presentations, evaluate event performance metrics, and analyze return on investment (ROI) for regional leadership.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with local market teams and work side-by-side with the Senior Client Project Executive on regional event operations and approvals.

  • On-Site Execution: Travel within the region to provide hands-on management and operational support during major event rollouts.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Event Management Expertise: Proven track record in executing high-end events, client activations, or experiential marketing (luxury fashion, retail, or hospitality experience preferred).

  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills with an eye for luxury presentation, spatial layouts, and flawless operational execution.

  • Financial & Analytical Acumen: Hands-on experience managing event budgets, tracking material/merchandise inventory, and analyzing performance ROI.

  • Strong Presentation & Communication Skills: Confident in creating pitch decks, conducting market briefings, and presenting to regional stakeholders.

  • Mobility & Flexibility: Willingness to travel across regional markets to manage live event setups and execution.

WHY JOIN US?

This role offers valuable exposure to regional luxury operations, high-net-worth client engagement strategies, and senior executive decision-making within one of the world's most prestigious luxury houses. You will collaborate with dynamic, high-performing creative teams while shaping client experiences across the region.

Interested candidates may email their updated resume to gareth@quantumcareer.com
