title: Events Executive (Govt and Corporate)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a role for someone who decides what needs to happen and drives it to delivery, without needing to be reminded twice. Progression is earned through outcomes, not time served. This is an entry point, not a fast-track.

At PurpleForest, successful events are delivered by people who take ownership, solve problems and care about outcomes. As an Events Executive, you will work closely with managers and project teams while owning your outcomes end-to-end.

The role spans client management and business development, giving you a broad view of how projects are won, delivered and closed.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own Defined Project Outcomes: Take accountability for scoped outcomes, delivering them accurately, professionally and on time, not just completing assigned activities.
  • Earn Client Confidence: Understand client needs, communicate proactively and follow through on commitments to build trust and future opportunities.
  • Drive Projects Forward: Maintain momentum by aligning timelines, vendors and requirements, anticipating dependencies and resolving matters without repeated reminders.
  • Solve Problems Proactively: Anticipate risks and implement practical solutions within your scope before they affect the client, project or team.
  • Contribute to Business Growth: Spot areas to add client value, help develop proposals and quotations, and follow-up with suitable opportunities.
  • Deliver and Close Well: Own delivery outcomes from planning through execution and closure, aligning operational details and commitments to the required standard.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Relevant Experience: 2–3 years of experience in events, project management, account servicing or a client-facing role, including clear examples of independently moving work forward and delivering agreed outcomes.
  • Ownership & Initiative: A track record of taking responsibility for outcomes and following through without needing repeated direction, even under shifting priorities.
  • Communication & Commercial Awareness: A confident communicator who moves proposals and opportunities forward without being asked twice.
  • Team Accountability and Adaptability: Collaborate effectively while remaining personally accountable for your outcomes, raising issues early and maintaining quality and follow-through when priorities or requirements change.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Base Salary: SGD $3,500 – SGD $4,000
  • Meaningful Ownership:Your name is attached to real projects and real client relationships, not just tasks assigned by others.
  • Diverse Project Exposure:Work across a wide range of events, industries and client types, from government agencies to private-sector organisations.
  • Commercial Exposure:See how an agency wins and prices work, beyond just delivering it.
  • Performance-Linked Growth: Recognition, broader scope and increased responsibility follow demonstrated ownership and reliable performance over time, not tenure, effort or requests for advancement. Some team members progress quickly; others do not, based entirely on what they deliver.
  • Collaborative Team Environment: Work alongside experienced managers in a team where initiative, personal accountability, reliable follow-through and shared results are expected.

HOW TO APPLY

  • Interested applicants are invited to send a copy of their resume, together with a brief cover note, to jobs@purpleforest.com.sg.
  • Share your previous experience about an incident when you fixed something nobody asked you to fix before it turned out to be a larger issue.
  • Please include your full name, contact number, email address, nationality, education qualifications, employment history, reasons for leaving your last job, earliest available start date, and expected salary.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT STYL SOLUTIONS

Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry. 

Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific.

Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living.

JOB DESCRIPTION 

We are looking for an independent and creative Marketing Manager to join us in our growth journey. You will own the full spectrum of STYL Solutions' marketing communications (MarComm) and corporate communications (CorpComm) activities. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role spanning event marketing, content and campaign development, sales collateral, digital and social media, corporate website management, presentation branding, a physical product demo space, and internal communications. You will work closely with the Product, Sales and Management teams and, where required, external vendors and subcontractors, to plan, produce and measure marketing outcomes that support customer acquisition, brand consistency and employee engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES
A. Marketing Communications (MarComm)

Trade Show & Event Marketing

  • Plan and coordinate STYL's participation in trade shows and industry events in Singapore and overseas, from booth concept to on-site execution.
  • Design the booth layout and develop event collateral (backdrop, banners, brochures) and event gifts, including sourcing quotations and managing vendors and job orders.
  • Develop pre-event promotional eDMs and email signature banners; set up lead-collection methods for the event team.
  • Consolidate post-event leads, produce a post-event report, coordinate lead nurturing with Sales, and publish post-event social media content.

Content & Inbound Marketing

  • Work with Product Owners and Sales to plan a campaign calendar (topics, audience, timing) promoting STYL's SaaS solutions.
  • Maintain and grow the leads database; develop and broadcast eDM campaigns with clear, customer-focused messaging and calls to action.
  • Track campaign performance (delivery, open and click-through rates, conversions) and hand qualified leads to Sales for follow-up.
  • Produce blogs, whitepapers, case studies and product videos, and distribute them across the website, social media and sales channels; report on content performance and lead generation.

Product & Solution Pitch Decks and Brochures

  • Review and refresh existing brochures and Product-team pitch decks for clarity, professionalism and consistent STYL branding.
  • Simplify technical content into customer-focused messaging and finalise materials for use by Product, Sales and Marketing.

Product Advertising & Campaigns

  • Plan and execute advertising and marketing campaigns with Product and Sales teams, from objective-setting through channel selection and content creation.
  • Launch campaigns across selected channels, track reach, engagement and leads, and report results with recommendations for future campaigns.

STYL Marketplace Marketing Support

  • Support the Marketplace team's campaigns for merchants and the parent/student community, including decal designs, artwork and supporting digital materials.
  • Ensure all Marketplace marketing materials follow STYL branding and track campaign performance where applicable.

B. Corporate Communications (CorpComm)

Internal Communications

  • Develop a company-wide internal communications plan covering CEO messages, Town Halls, product updates and newsletters.
  • Coordinate with Management and other teams to produce and distribute clear, consistent internal content through appropriate channels.

Corporate Website Management

  • Keep the STYL corporate website accurate, current and optimised for SEO; monitor traffic and page performance.
  • Publish company news, events and articles, and coordinate with internal teams or the website vendor on content, design and functionality updates.

Social Media Management

  • Develop and maintain a LinkedIn content calendar; create on-brand posts and visuals covering company activities, products and events.
  • Schedule and publish approved content, and monitor performance (impressions, engagement, follower growth) to continuously improve STYL's social presence across various platforms (i.e. LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook).

Presentation Templates & Branding

  • Standardise STYL's corporate PowerPoint templates — layout, fonts, colours and slide types — for consistent, professional use across teams.

Product & Solution Demo Space

  • Plan a dedicated demo space to showcase STYL's products, including layout, branding, signage and content requirements.
  • Prepare cost estimates and budget for management approval, and coordinate with vendors and subcontractors on installation, then test and finalise the space for customer visits.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Here at STYL Solutions, we value proactive ownership and require independence and hands-on involvement in our daily responsibilities. We seek entrepreneurial candidates with the following:
Experience

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in marketing communications and/or corporate communications, ideally in a B2B technology, hardware or SaaS environment.
    Demonstrated experience planning and executing trade shows or corporate events, from concept to post-event reporting.
    Experience running digital and content marketing campaigns (eDM, webinars, social media, SEO) and managing a leads database.
    Experience liaising with external vendors, printers, designers or subcontractors, including obtaining quotations and managing budgets, is an advantage.
    Prior exposure to internal communications (newsletters, Town Halls, management messaging) is an advantage.

Education & Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Mass Communications, Business Administration or a related field.

Skills

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical product information into clear, customer-friendly messaging.
  • Working knowledge of digital marketing tools (eDM platforms, basic SEO, social media scheduling and analytics).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Word for presentation and collateral development; working knowledge of design tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) or the ability to brief designers effectively.
  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel for tracking campaign metrics, budgets and reporting.
  • Project and vendor management skills, including budgeting, timeline management and coordination of multiple external suppliers.

Aptitudes & Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised self-starter, able to independently manage multiple concurrent work streams across events, content, digital and internal communications.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to work closely with Product, Sales and Management to align marketing output with business needs.
  • Creative and detail-oriented, with sound judgement on brand consistency and messaging.
  • Comfortable working hands-on across both strategic planning and operational execution.
  • Adaptable and resourceful, comfortable operating with a lean or single-person marketing function.

What measures the success of the role

  • Event Execution & Lead Generation: Successful planning and execution of trade shows and corporate events, resulting in qualified lead collection and timely post-event sales nurturing.
  • Digital Campaign & Content Performance: Engagement levels, open/click-through rates, and lead conversions from eDM, social media, and website campaigns.
  • Brand Consistency & Collateral Quality: Delivery of clear, standardized, and customer-focused product pitch decks, marketing collateral, and corporate presentation templates.
  • Website & Social Media Growth: Up-to-date corporate website and steady growth in follower reach and engagement on the Company’s social media accounts. 
  • Internal & Operational Delivery: On-time execution of internal communication initiatives, demo space setup, and efficient vendor and budget management.

title: Sales Support Engineer
description:
We are currently recruiting a Sales Support Engineer to support the operations of Distech Controls, a brand within the Acuity Inc. group, which is our parent company.

Distech Controls is a Canadian-based company located in Brossard, on the South Shore of Montreal (QC), with a European headquarter in Brignais (Lyon), France. We are proud to be part of the Acuity Brands family since 2015. Our mission is to connect people with intelligent building solutions for better health, better space, better efficiencies through our forward-thinking technologies and services. Our passion for innovation, quality and sustainability guides our business on a daily basis, as we light the way to a brilliant, productive and connected world.

Job Summary

We are looking for a problem solver with an application engineering and/or programming background in BAS controls to help support our network of System Integrators and End-User customers with adoption of the best technology our industry has to offer.

As a Sales Support Engineer you will be the product subject matter expert and dynamic thinker for our Sales Team engaging in various types of support activities.

You will work directly with your System Integrators, End User Customers, and Regional Sales Managers to create and manage your own schedule of commitments.

You will be joining a solutions sales team with an incredible family-like culture. Your peers will be some of the brightest minds in our industry. We hope the thought of learning about the latest technology in the building controls industry and sharing that knowledge with customers sounds like fun. We look forward to meeting you.

This position is Remote (work from home), based in Singapore and does require company-paid travel.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities (Essential Functions):

  • New Product Introductions
  • Assist with the development and presentation of tech focused sessions/webminars/lunch and learns
  • Supporting new customer onboardings
  • Support industry trade show events by assisting with product demonstrations and support with lead generation during events
  • Product feature demonstrations
  • Providing supplemental product training
  • Supporting projects that are adopting new technology for the first time
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to stay informed about product capabilities, advancements, and limitations
  • Provide assistance in project tenders when collaborating with regional sales managers and system integrator partners

Skills And Minimum Experience Required:

  • Exceptional knowledge and understanding of the Tridium Niagara Framework. EC-Net (The Distech Brand of Tridium Niagara) is a cornerstone of a Distech Controls solution. You should be confident in your ability to take a station from scratch with no templates to a complete automation system.
  • A solid fundamental understanding of HVAC systems.
  • Ability to think logically and write programs for HVAC control.
  • Have a knack for explaining often tough and complicated topics in layman’s terms.
  • Fundamental understanding of protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, Lonworks
  • Fundamental understanding of MSTP and IP networking
  • Ability to show initiative when working independently as well as collaborate closely with internal/external stakeholders as required
  • Effective time management skills and ability to assess task urgency and importance to deliver high quality results

Preferred Skills, Experience And Education

  • Experience with IoT integrations and API’s
  • Ability to write code in computer programming languages such as Python, Java, C++
  • Your personal hobbies include tinkering, building, or creating
  • Advanced understanding of IP networking
  • Experience with Linux and or Docker/Containers
  • Tertiary education (either a degree or vocational) is preferred but not required

title: General Manager, Overseas Business Center
description:
About the role

This role involves developing and executing a 3–5-year overseas business strategy for semiconductor distribution, defining market entry strategies, establishing distributor networks, and building localized warehousing and logistics infrastructure. You will lead partnership negotiations with upstream semiconductor manufacturers and establish strategic partnerships with downstream customers including OEMs, ODMs, and solution providers to drive Design-in projects and expand business opportunities.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a 3–5-year overseas business strategy, defining market entry strategies, including distributor network development, localized warehousing and logistics infrastructure, and customer segmentation

  • Lead overseas partnership negotiations with upstream semiconductor manufacturers to secure regional distribution rights and resource support

  • Establish strategic partnerships with downstream customers, including OEMs, ODMs, and solution providers, to drive Design-in projects and expand business opportunities

  • Build and manage localized teams across sales, Field Application Engineering (FAE), and supply chain functions, implementing performance evaluation systems tailored to regional market characteristics

  • Optimize inventory turnover and cash flow while managing cross-border trade risks, including foreign exchange fluctuations, regulatory compliance, and payment terms

  • Drive the implementation of digital tools, such as online trading platforms and inventory management systems, across regional markets

  • Develop relationships with local industry associations, chambers of commerce, and trade show organizers to strengthen brand presence and influence in target markets

  • Identify potential mergers, acquisitions, and joint venture opportunities, integrating resources from small and medium-sized regional distributors

About you

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, International Business, or a related field

  • At least 10 years of experience in semiconductor distribution or franchised distribution, including a minimum of 5 years managing business operations across the Asia-Pacific, Europe, or North America

  • Demonstrated success in leading overseas market expansion from 0 to 1, supported by verifiable business performance data

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor demand trends across key sectors, including automotive electronics, industrial control, and consumer electronics

  • Established relationships with semiconductor manufacturers, key customers, and relevant government stakeholders in target markets

  • Proven experience leading multicultural teams and willingness to undertake frequent international business travel

  • Business-level English and Chinese proficiency sufficient for commercial negotiations

title: Visual Storyteller / Technical Illustrator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

Studio Mojo is a Singapore-based spatial design consultancy creating exhibitions, galleries, trade show booths and commercial interiors for corporate and institutional clients.

We're looking for a designer who can turn a client's technical story into something visitors understand at a glance. You'll sit with clients to understand what their gallery or exhibition needs to say, storyboard it, illustrate it, and work with our production team who build the interactive content, animation and 3D renders. You'll work alongside our Art Director.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Meet clients with the project team to understand content needs; present storyboards and drafts back to them
• Write storyboards and content briefs for interactive, video and screen content
• Produce technical illustrations: system diagrams, product cutaways, process flows, infographics
• Brief our production team and check their work against the storyboard before it goes to the client
• Attend installs to check content on site

REQUIREMENTS:

• 3+ years in exhibition, agency, museum or corporate content design
• Strong storyboarding and visual storytelling
• Technical illustration in Adobe Illustrator; engineering or industrial subjects a plus
• Comfortable speaking with corporate clients; clear spoken and written English
• Experience working with external designers, animators or developers
• Coding not required; you just need to be able to tell whether an interactive build works as intended

PORTFOLIO - please include:
1. A storyboard
2. Two technical illustrations or diagrams
3. A project where you worked directly with a client
With a short note on your role in each.

description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

The Global Centre for Maritime Decarbonisation (GCMD) was established as an independent, non-profit organisationon 1 August 2021 to help international shipping decarbonise through pilots and trials. Its mission is to support decarbonisation through four pillars: shaping standards, deploying solutions, financing projects, and fostering collaboration across sectors.

GCMD was founded with the support of industry partners, alongside funding from the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) for qualifying research and development programmes. Since its founding, GCMD has expanded its ecosystem to include more than 130 centre- and project-level partners contributing funds, expertise, and in-kind support to pilot, accelerate the deployment, and scale the adoption of decarbonisation solutions.

GCMD has launched four key initiatives to close technical and operational gaps in: enabling ammonia as a marine fuel, developing an assurance framework for drop-in green fuels, unlocking the carbon value chain through onboard carbon capture and articulating the value chain of captured carbon dioxide, as well as closing the data-financing gap to scale the adoption of energy efficiency technologies.

title: Communications Executive (Compassionate Leave Cover 6 months)
description:
We're Hiring: Communications Executive

Quintessential Education | Full-Time or Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore

About QE

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 700 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates. 

The Role

We're looking for a Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help keep our marketing materials and partner relationships in good order. We are open to full-time or part-time candidates, so tell us the arrangement that works for you.

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

This is a temporary role for 6 months to cover a colleague on leave for 4-6 months. If desired, conversion to full time permanent can be discussed closer from the 5-6th month onwards.

*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

  • Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.

  • Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.

  • Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.

  • Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

  • Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.

  • Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.

  • Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.

  • Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.

  • Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

  • Prepare and track invoices and payments.

  • Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.

  • Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.

  • Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

  • Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.

  • Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.

  • Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.

  • Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

  • Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.

  • Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.

  • Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.

  • Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.

  • Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.

  • Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).

  • Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

  • Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.

  • Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).

  • Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Full-time or part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application.

  • Full-time: 5-day work week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, 4 days in office and 1 day remote

  • Part-time: Days and hours by arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries

Salary & Benefits

  • Monthly Salary: $4,500 upwards for full-time, depending on experience; pro-rated for part-time

  • Bonuses: Additional performance and team-based bonuses apply

  • Benefits Include: $500 Specialist Stipend per annum (e.g. medical or mental health support), $100 Dental Stipend per annum, $500 Personal Development Stipend per annum (for courses, books, conferences, etc.)

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short paragraph on why you're interested in the role to hr@qeducation.sg with the subject line: Application – Communications Executive (Full Time / Part Time)

We look forward to hearing from people who want to make a real difference to the families we work with.

title: Communications Executive
description:
Overview:

As an Account Executive, you will be an integral part of our client services team, supporting various accounts and assisting team members in executing strategic communications plans for our clients.

We are looking for passionate and creative individuals who want to hone their skills in communications, and work with industry experts to help brands and clients navigate the complex world we live in today.

You should be an amazing team player, someone who is not afraid to try new things, fail at these things and learn from mistakes. If you are ambitious, driven by excellence and inspired by creativity – we want to speak with you! Give us a call. 

Responsibilities:

Supporting the teamto build the Vero business in Singapore and across ASEAN. This includes supporting client work, client counsel and supporting new business development– and, in general, ensuring clients and stakeholders are satisfied with Vero’swork.

Client Management                          

  • Serve as a point of contact for clients, ensuring timely responses to requests and maintaining professional, positive relationships to foster trust and confidence in the agency’s abilities.
  • Attend meetings with clients, take notes, be responsive in client communication channels (emails or group chats), and ensure you stay up-to-date with your accounts’ activities, and help to keep track of deadlines and timelines.
  • Be prompt in providing support to senior members of the team.
  • Assist in preparing plans, reports and proposals – ensuring these deliverables are relevant, insightful and presented in a clear and concise manner.
  • Help to manage administrative duties such as scheduling meetings, organising files and maintaining project documentation.

Research & Analysis       

  • Research industry trends, clients’ competitors and target audiences to inform communication strategies.
  • Analyse mediacoverage and social media metrics to evaluate campaign performance, and provide insights/recommendations based on findings.

PR Strategy and Execution

  • Support team in developing PR strategies and plans for clients
  • Help develop media lists, media landscape deep dives, and maintain media databases.
  • Draft press releases, media pitches, advisories, feature articles, opinion editorials, and other related materials.
  • Support media outreach efforts, including pitching stories, coordinating interviews etc.

Social Media & Content Development

  • Support team in developing social media strategies and plans for clients.
  • Develop compelling content for various platforms, including but not limited to social media, websites, newsletters, blogs etc.
  • Community management for clients’ social media pages.
  • Track and analysisclient’s social media performance metrics and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, platform updates and emerging social media technologies to inform strategy development and implementation.

Influencer Management

  • Help to develop and curate influencer lists, profiles and maintain influencer databases, tracking key metrics such as reach, engagement and audience demographics.
  • Support team in developing influencer outreach strategies and plans for clients.
  • Initiate and manage outreach efforts to influencers, negotiating partnerships, securing collaborations for clients.
  • Manage influencer partnership/collaborations – such as reviewing content, managing approval processes etc.
  • Monitor influencer campaign performance, analyse data to assess effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

Criteria:

  • 1-2 years of working experience in an agency environment or similar (candidates without work experience but with relevant internship experience will be considered too)
  • Highly motivated, flexible, reliable, honest, and able to work under pressure                    
  • Structured, detail-oriented, responsible, and independent
  • Resourceful: You are a creative problem-solver; you know how to surround yourself with critical resources and research approaches (on and offline), and you can apply these approaches to uncover breakthrough insights for client work
  • Strong communications and presentation skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Comfortable working in a young, multicultural environment
  • Keen to develop a stellar career in the PR industry

Bonus Criteria

  • Experience(and/or passion) in sustainability is a bonus
  • Ability to speak/write in another ASEAN language is a bonus

Working at Vero:

You will be a member of a multicultural team of communication specialists spread across the region and brought together by their love for creative and efficient strategies and positive conversations. We pride ourselves in creating workplaces that are comfortable, informal, and intensely stimulating.

Other Benefits:

  • Unlimited Leave: Your allocated holiday time at Vero will be unlimited. We trust our people to use good judgment when given guidelines for making decisions about taking a holiday, and we know that our teams work better when they can rest and take a proper break from work. Our goal is that everyone takes an average of 15 days (minimum!) per person per year.
  • Working days: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm (including 1 hour of lunch break). This may be flexible depending on workload and client needs.
  • Wellness day off: One paid day per quarter for you to take time off, unplug, and treat yourself with something nice.
  • Thought Leadership and training: We sponsor team members with training tools and resources, both internal and external, and we even incentivise employees to complete classes. Details of training programs and incentives will be shared upon your onboarding. This includes training and development investments organised by the company and specialised programs that our executives may come across and feel are needed for their development.

title: Part Time Communications Executive
description:
We're Hiring: Part Time Communications Executive 

Quintessential Education | Part-Time | Orchard Road, Singapore

About QE

Quintessential Education is Singapore's leading provider of pre-tertiary academic programmes (IGCSE & IB) and university admissions advisory for top-tier global universities — Ivy League, Oxbridge, and NUS/NTU/SMU. Since 2012 we have worked with more than 1000 students, and most of our new families come to us through referrals. We deliver a fully integrated journey for families: academic mastery, guardianship, and university placement under one roof.

We aim to bring out the best in our students, ignite opportunities and nurture them towards success.

We are looking for committed and talented additions to our team. As an ideal candidate, you should display a proven ability to develop and maintain an environment of trust, diversity, and inclusion within the QE team. You should be able to work with the team to meet deadlines and instill a culture of continuous work improvement.

As part of the position, you will work with the founders, Ivy League and Oxbridge graduates and other high-performing teammates. 

The Role

We're looking for a Part Time Communications Executive to own the day-to-day relationship between QE and our families. You'll be the first person a parent speaks to when they enquire, and the person who keeps them informed once their child is with us. That means answering enquiries every day, matching students with the right tutors and mentors, and following up with students and parents regularly so nothing slips through.

You'll also help develop our marketing materials and partner relationships. 

If you're a confident communicator in both English and Mandarin*, stay calm and warm with demanding parents, and like being the person who makes sure things actually get done — we'd love to meet you.

*As a major group of customers are from China and are only able to converse in Mandarin.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Enquiries & Enrolment

  • Respond to daily parent and student enquiries via phone, WhatsApp, WeChat, and email, ideally within the same working day.

  • Explain our IGCSE, IB, and admissions programmes clearly and recommend the right fit for each student.

  • Match students with suitable tutors and mentors, and arrange trial lessons and consultations.

  • Track every enquiry through to enrolment and follow up with families who have not yet decided.

2. Student Follow-Up & Parent Relations

  • Check in regularly with enrolled students and parents on progress, attendance, and any concerns.

  • Collect lesson feedback from students and tutors, and deal with issues early before they become complaints.

  • Arrange class schedules, replacement lessons, and changes with tutors and families.

  • Keep parents informed ahead of key moments: exam periods, predicted grades, application deadlines, and results day.

  • Follow up on renewals and next-stage programmes (e.g. IGCSE to IB, IB to university applications).

3. Business Operations

  • Prepare and track invoices and payments.

  • Draft and manage service agreements for clients and tutors.

  • Keep client records, notes, and follow-up schedules up to date.

  • Keep a simple monthly record of enquiries, enrolments, and renewals for the founders.

4. Marketing & Partnerships

  • Keep brochures, website content, and newsletters accurate and up to date.

  • Work with design and digital marketing agencies on campaigns and collateral.

  • Support parent seminars and events, including Mandarin-language sessions with our China school partners.

  • Maintain relationships with partner schools, education consultants, and collaborators.

We're Looking For Someone Who:

  • Has experience in a client-facing role such as education, admissions, client services, or customer service. Fresh graduates with strong communication skills are welcome to apply.

  • Has excellent verbal and written communication in English and Chinese. This is required as some Chinese customers can only communicate in Chinese. Japanese and Korean are a bonus as some customers only communicate in these languages.

  • Is calm, warm, and professional with high-expectation parents, and comfortable handling difficult conversations.

  • Is highly organised, follows up without being reminded, and keeps clear records.

  • Can manage many families and a busy inbox at the same time without losing track of details.

  • Is proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Notion or Airtable, and marketing tools (Mailchimp, Canva).

  • Is comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) and light automation to streamline workflows.

Bonus If You:

  • Have experience in the education, tuition, or admissions sector.

  • Know the IB, IGCSE, or university application process (UK, US, or Singapore).

  • Are familiar with WeChat or Xiaohongshu.

Working Hours

Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-06/9, Singapore 238882. In Person role.

Start Date: As soon as possible

Commitment: Part-time. Propose the days and hours that suit you in your application. At least a 2 year commitment.

Part-time: Days and hours by mutual arrangement, with enough weekday cover to keep up with daily enquiries. Weekends welcome as well. 

Working Hours: 10 am - 7 pm, At least 2 days 

Salary:  $1000-2000

Commitment: Freelance Part-time

Expected Start Date: As soon as possible

Office Location: 545 Orchard Road, #14-09, S238882

Interested parties should email their CV to hr@qeducation.sg. and complete this form at https://airtable.com/appLOyBp6pO9hqRch/shrvuh9XnleFVLAkN. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interviews and assessments.

title: Marketing and Communications Executive
description:
Overview:

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, the successful candidate will support the day-to-day marketing activities for SCAL assigned programs and initiatives, and its subsidiaries where applicable. He or she will also work closely with the Executive Director to handle media enquiries.

Job Description:

• Support Senior Marketing Manager with end-to-end on planning, creative development, and execution of online and offline marketing campaigns.

• Custodian for all collaterals – Produce / edit / proofread content including but not limited to website, posters, brochures, banners, electronic direct mailers, press releases, speeches, articles, interviews etc.

• Custodian for all communication channels including but not limited to social media channels, Telegram, email marketing, website etc. Responsibilities include content planning, support the design of and subsequently deliver on schedule via these channels.

• Assist with the planning and execution of both online and physical events

• Liaise and work closely with vendors, internal teams, and stakeholders to conceptualize and produce content and creatives.

• Track and measure campaign performance across different platforms, provide key analytics through tracking systems.

• Maintain positive relationships with the media, stakeholders including government agencies, business partners and the general public.

• Work with Board/Executive Director to handle media queries.

• Support other marketing activities as required or any other duties as may be assigned by the Executive Director or by whomever the Executive Director so designates.

Job Requirements:

• Degree or diploma in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing or related field with at least 2 years of relevant experience. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills (ability to write in a journalistic style that is customary for corporate and external publications will be a plus)

• Some experience in social media, email, and/or content marketing is preferred

• Some experience in events planning is preferred

• Strong interpersonal skills

• Excellent organizational abilities (with attention to detail) and interpersonal skills. Self-driven, resourceful, fast learner.

• Ability to collaborate across teams, handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

• Basic design skills, including knowledge of Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop and Canva or a similar program added advantage

Adecco Group, headquartered in Zurich and a Fortune 500 company, leads global HR solutions with services in staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, and talent development across 60+ countries, combining global reach with local expertise and a commitment to diversity and sustainability.

  • Manage end-to-end corporate gifting processes, including sourcing and distribution

  • Experience using Google Analytics for data analysis

title: Senior Manager, Regional Marketing, APAC Electrophysiology
description:
The APAC Electrophysiology Marketing Lead is responsible for developing and executing regional marketing strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and commercial performance of the EP portfolio across Asia Pacific.

This role serves as the key regional marketing partner to global and local commercial teams, translating global strategies into impactful regional and local execution plans. The individual will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Sales, Medical Affairs, Commercial Excellence, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, and country marketing teams to enable successful product launches, strengthen customer engagement, and support sustainable business growth.

The role will have a particular focus on supporting strategic markets including Australia, New Zealand, and Japan while ensuring alignment across the broader APAC region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible to provide expertise and guidance to country team in Australia / Japan towards successful launch of new products and other enabling technology.

  • Collaborate with the ANZ / Japan marketing team to upskill talents with capabilities pertaining to future product launches

  • Support external customer engagements with KOL’s in ANZ / Japan

  • Translate global EP marketing strategy into APAC regional plans and local execution roadmaps.

  • Develop and manage regional brand plans, launches, product positioning, channel strategies, and integrated campaigns.

  • Lead market segmentation, customer journey mapping, and targeting for key APAC markets.

  • Create regional marketing assets, content briefs, and digital programs in collaboration with creative and communications teams; ensure regulatory and compliance review.

  • Drive multi-channel programs (digital, events, HCP/Patient engagement, KOL initiatives) optimized for APAC markets.

  • Provide commercial insights and competitive analysis to inform strategy and tactical decisions.

  • Support local affiliates with campaign toolkits, training materials, sales enablement, and field support.

  • Measure and report campaign performance and ROI; use analytics to optimize investments and tactics.

  • Manage external agencies and vendors for creative, digital, and market research projects.

  • Ensure adherence to company policies, local regulations, and ethical standards in all marketing activities.

  • Mentor and coordinate with junior marketing staff; foster cross-country collaboration across APAC.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or related field (MBA preferred).

  • 8+ years’ marketing experience, with at least 3–5 years in regional roles across APAC or large multi-country responsibilities.

  • Experience in healthcare/biopharma/medical device/related regulated industry strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated track record in brand management, product launches, and multi-channel campaign execution.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and supporting local affiliates across multiple markets.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic marketing mindset with strong commercial orientation.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across cultures and seniority levels.

  • Proficiency in digital marketing channels, CRM-driven campaigns, and marketing analytics.

  • Fluent in English; additional APAC language(s) an advantage.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable insights.

  • Comfortable with travel across APAC (typical expectation: up to 30–40% depending on business needs).

title: Regional Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic, highly motivated, and commercially driven Regional Marketing Manager to lead student acquisition initiatives across China, Southeast Asia, and the broader Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.

As a key brand representative, you will play a pivotal role in driving student recruitment through daily live streaming, digital marketing, and audience engagement. You will be responsible for hosting compelling live broadcasts that engage prospective students, build brand credibility, generate qualified leads, and convert audience interest into successful student applications and enrolments.

You will also manage supporting digital channels, particularly Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) and WeChat, to strengthen brand visibility, promote live streaming sessions, and support regional student recruitment objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Live Streaming & Student Acquisition

  • Plan, produce, manage, and host engaging daily live streaming sessions across relevant digital platforms.
  • Develop compelling live content that showcases the institution's programmes, educational offerings, student experiences, and value propositions.
  • Engage prospective students in real time, address enquiries, build trust, and guide audiences through the student recruitment and enrolment journey.
  • Implement effective audience engagement and conversion strategies to generate qualified leads and drive student applications and enrolments.

2. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

  • Manage and optimise regional digital marketing channels, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, to increase brand awareness and drive traffic to live streaming sessions.
  • Develop and execute content strategies to promote upcoming broadcasts, maintain audience engagement, and nurture prospective student leads.
  • Create localised digital content and promotional materials tailored to the preferences and behaviours of target audiences across China and Southeast Asia.
  • Maintain consistent brand messaging across all digital touchpoints.

3. Regional Brand Development & Market Intelligence

  • Develop compelling brand narratives and high-quality promotional materials to strengthen brand positioning across the APAC region.
  • Monitor regional education market trends, student mobility patterns, competitor activities, and consumer behaviour.
  • Analyse audience engagement and market feedback to identify new recruitment opportunities and refine live streaming content.
  • Apply cultural intelligence and market insights to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness across different markets.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with admissions, academic, and other relevant teams to ensure the accuracy and consistency of programme information communicated during live broadcasts.
  • Coordinate recruitment campaigns and promotional activities to support institutional enrolment targets.
  • Maintain effective communication with prospective students and build positive relationships throughout the recruitment process.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in digital marketing, regional marketing, student recruitment, education marketing, live streaming, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated commercial awareness and the ability to convert audience interest into qualified leads and measurable business outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Chinese digital platforms, particularly Xiaohongshu and WeChat, and their application in marketing and audience development.
  • Good understanding of the education market in China, Southeast Asia region.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret marketing data and implement improvement strategies.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish trust with prospective students.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in education recruitment, education consultancy, or marketing.
  • Experience hosting regular live streaming sessions for marketing, sales, or customer acquisition.
  • Professional proficiency in Mandarin to engage effectively with Chinese-speaking audiences. Additional regional language capabilities will be an advantage.
  • Experience developing localised content and marketing campaigns for diverse Asian markets.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing, management systems, and conversion optimisation tools.

title: Regional Marketing Lead
description:
Zuellig Pharma is a leading healthcare solutions company in Asia, and our purpose is to make healthcare more accessible to the communities we serve. We provide world-class distribution, digital, and commercial services to support the growing healthcare needs in this region.

The company was started a hundred years ago and has grown to become a multibillion-dollar business covering 17 markets with over 12,000 employees. Our people serve more than 200,000 medical facilities and work with over 450clients, including the top 20 pharmaceutical companies in the world.

Purpose of the Role:

To be the strategic architect of our in-market success. This role acts as a Center of Excellence for Trade Marketing, responsible for translating brand strategy into best-in-class execution across our Own Brands and for our top-tier Agency partners.

As a critical leader on the regional team, you will build the commercial capabilities, frameworks, and strategies that ensure our brands win at the point of sale. This position is pivotal in driving launch excellence for our innovation pipeline and establishing a new standard for trade, pharmacist, and key account engagement.

What You’ll Do:

Trade Excellence Strategy& Innovation

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive trade excellence strategy with a primary focus on accelerating the growth of our Own Brands.
  • Create and embed regional best-practice frameworks for trade marketing, ensuring sustained execution excellence for both Own Brands and Key Agency partners.
  • Innovate new trade marketing and demand generation programs by leveraging our proprietary B2B platforms (e.g., ezRx+) to create a seamless online-to-offline experience for customers.
  • Establish and govern a rigorous ROI-based approach to trade spend, optimizing investments to maximize growth.

Key Account Management& Joint Business Planning

  • Design and deploy a standardized regional framework for Key Account Management, including strategic segmentation, tiering, and engagement protocols.
  • Personally lead the creation and execution of annual Joint Business Plans (JBPs) for top-tier retail partners (e.g., Watsons, Guardian, Mercury Drug) in priority markets, delivering mutual growth for our Own Brands and select Key Agency clients.

Commercial Capability Building

  • Act as the region’s foremost expert and coach for local sales and marketing teams, elevating skills in trade marketing, key account management, and in-store execution.
  • Create and deliver a targeted curriculum of training modules to upskill country teams on best-in-class commercial capabilities.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement by identifying and scaling best practices across all markets.

Pharmacist Marketing & Engagement

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive pharmacist marketing strategy to build strong relationships and trusted advocacy for our Own Brands.
  • Create targeted engagement programs, educational materials, and in-store tools to effectively communicate product benefits and drive pharmacist recommendations.

In-Store & Launch Excellence

  • Serve as the commercial lead for new product introductions, ensuring channel readiness, distribution, on-shelf availability, and trade activation are flawlessly executed.
  • Drive best practices in merchandising, planogramming, and Point of Sale (POS) development to maximize on-shelf impact and deliver a superior shopper experience.

Must-Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in Trade Marketing, Key Account Management, or Commercial Excellence roles within a leading Consumer Healthcare (CHC) or FMCG company.
  • A proven 'builder' with demonstrated success in creating new commercial capabilities, processes, and teams from the ground up.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in creating and executing multi-year Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with major regional or national retail accounts.
  • Expertise in leveraging retail, shopper, and syndicated data (e.g., retail audit, panel data) to generate actionable insights that drive commercial strategy.
  • A strong understanding of the diverse retail channels across Southeast Asia (e.g., pharmacy, modern trade, convenience, e-commerce).

Advantage to Have:

  • Direct experience in developing and executing pharmacist engagement or expert marketing programs.
  • Significant in-market experience in the Philippines, Thailand, Indonesia, or Malaysia.
  • Exceptional influencing and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to lead and deliver results in a complex, matrixed environment without direct authority.

What we offer:

§  We champion diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring every individual feels valued, respected, and treated fairly.

§  As a leading multi-market healthcare solutions provider, we empower our employees to gain comprehensive knowledge and expertise in the dynamic healthcare industry across the region.

§  Enjoy the flexibility to effectively balance your work and personal life while taking charge of your career journey through our empowering growth opportunities.

§  Our Total Rewards program is designed to support your overall well-being in every aspect.

title: General Manager, Regional Marketing
description:
Nippon Shokubai (Asia) Pte. Ltd. (NSA) is seeking an experienced General Manager to lead regional marketing and business development for Nippon Shokubai Group products in Southeast Asia and India. Paints and coatings will be one of NSA’s core marketing pillars and an important area for future growth. The role requires a rare combination of technical expertise, marketing capability and commercial experience, particularly in paints, coatings, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals and related application technologies.

Job Description

  • Lead the development and execution of NSA’s regional marketing strategy for Nippon Shokubai Group products in Southeast Asia and India, with paints and coatings positioned as one of the principal growth areas.
  • Identify growth opportunities in paints, coatings and related applications through market research, competitor analysis, customer interviews and engagement with customers’ R&D, technical and procurement functions.
  • Develop technically differentiated proposals by applying deep knowledge of emulsion products, coating formulations, surrounding raw materials and application technologies to customers’ performance, sustainability and cost requirements.
  • Work closely with Nippon Shokubai’s R&D, marketing and sales organizations in Japan to translate key regional customers (ASEAN, India and Japan) needs into product development, technical evaluation, sample work and commercialization plans in line with the Group’s strategy.
  • Lead new application exploration, market development and overseas business development projects, and manage a prioritized pipeline of opportunities across ASEAN and India from initial identification through customer evaluation and commercial readiness.
  • Coordinate the handover of commercially qualified opportunities to Nippon Shokubai’s responsible sales organization, which will lead commercial negotiations and enter into sales contracts, while NSA continues to support regional customer and market development.

Job Requirements

  1. A minimum of 20 years of hands-on research and development experience in paints, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related industries, gained at a globally listed chemical manufacturing company or its overseas subsidiaries.
  2. A minimum of 2 years of practical experience in the sales and development of products for paints, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related applications, including customer proposals, technical discussions, product evaluation and application development. The successful candidate must have gained this experience within the last 2 years.
  3. A minimum of 5 years in a managerial role, leading cross-functional projects and coordinating effectively with R&D, marketing and sales teams in Japan and with customers across the region.
  4. Experience in overseas business expansion, market development or new market entry projects, together with sound knowledge of key customers, market structures, competitors, distribution channels and business practices in ASEAN and India.
  5. Demonstrated hands-on knowledge of resins, additives, related raw materials and formulation technologies used in paints, coatings, adhesives, emulsion polymers, construction chemicals or related applications.
  6. Business-level proficiency in written and spoken English and Japanese language proficiency equivalent to JLPT N1 is required for technical and commercial discussions with key regional customers from ASEAN, India and Japan.　
  7. Willingness to travel within ASEAN, India and Japan is required.

description:
Job Description & Requirements

Samyang Foods SEA Pte. Ltd. is the Southeast Asia regional subsidiary of Samyang Foods, a leading South Korean food company established in 1961. Renowned for globally recognized brands such as Buldak Hot Chicken Flavor Ramen, Samyang Foods has grown into an international food company with a presence across Asia, North America, Europe, and other key markets.

As the company continues its global expansion, Samyang Foods SEA Pte. Ltd. plays a key role in strengthening the brand's presence and supporting business growth across Southeast Asia.

At Samyang Foods SEA, we foster a collaborative, dynamic, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are empowered to contribute, innovate, and develop their careers while supporting the continued success of one of Korea's most recognized food brands.

We are seeking an experienced individual to join us as Regional Trade Marketing, Team Lead. This role operates within a matrix organization, reporting directly to the Director, Head of Commercial Marketing Sector, APAC and functionally working closely with Sales, Trade Marketing & Marketing divisions at the headquarter & close collaboration with the distributors.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Regional Trade Marketing Team Leader, SEA/APAC to drive brand penetration and sales growth across SEA by developing and executing channel marketing strategies and shopper-focused activation plans, with a special focus on improving execution in Modern Trade (MT) and building presence and relevance in General Trade (GT). This role will work closely with Sales, Distributors, and Brand/Communication to ensure excellent in-store execution, effective trade promotions, and locally relevant shopper marketing programs that deliver conversion at the point of purchase. Lead &develop talents and elevate organization trade marketing capabilities from strategy development, process refinement & plan execution.

Responsibilities

(1) Channel Strategy & Planning of Noodle, Sauce, Snack Categories:

  • Develop and maintain channel marketing plans for MT and GT across priority markets.
  • Translate brand strategy and campaigns into tailored channel execution plans.
  • Segment channels/customers and prioritize initiatives to drive growth.
  • Align plans with sales teams and distributors for joint business planning.

(2) Shopper Marketing Activation & In-Store Execution Excellence:

  • Design and deliver shopper marketing programs that drive trial, conversion and increase basket size.
  • Develop regionally adaptable toolkits (POSM, planograms, promotional mechanics) to support in-store execution.
  • Work with local teams to localize shopper programs based on outlet type, shopper missions, and cultural relevance.
  • Drive best-in-class execution of in-store presence across all channels and priority markets.

(3) Promotion & Activation Planning:

  • Plan and evaluate shopper promotions by channel, season, or campaign.
  • Test and recommend winning promo mechanics and bundling strategies.
  • Monitor ROI of trade promotions and provide improvement recommendations.

(4) Shoppers' insights:

  • Work with Market Insights team (MI) to develop for shopper insights & behavioural difference across different channels thus derive into constructive trade marketing strategies to address different shoppers' behaviours across different channels.

(5) Look of Success Champion:

  • Guardian of look of success for Samyang range of brands for Assortment, Merchandising, Pricing, Promotion, Shelf (AMPPS).
  • Lead the strategy & execution of AMPPS.
  • Ensure brand consistency across markets & channels.

(6) Team Management:

  • Coach & develop marketing talents in regional& local offices to elevate organization trade marketing capabilities & process improvements.


Requirements:

  • 12+ years of experience in shopper marketing, channel/trade marketing, or customer marketing roles within FMCG or consumer goods.
  • Experience working in the SEA headquarters of an FMCG multinational company
  • Strong understanding of shopper behavior, retail dynamics, and trade marketing.
  • Analytical with the ability to interpret market and sales data.
  • Excellent planning, execution, and project management skills.
  • Collaborative and able to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders in a start-up environment.
  • Proficiency in Korean is valuable.

  • 1–3 years of experience in account management, client success, marketing, advertising, social media or a related role
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through

title: Market Research Executive
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Market Research Executive to conduct market, customer and competitor research to support product, marketing and business planning for our digital financial software and applications.

The role involves analysing market information, customer needs, industry trends and competitor developments, and translating research findings into actionable insights and recommendations for business decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct market research on financial software, investment analysis tools and related digital products to identify customer needs, market trends and business opportunities.
  • Collect, organise and analyse market information from relevant internal and external sources.
  • Conduct customer research and analyse customer behaviour, preferences and feedback.
  • Conduct competitor research and monitor developments in financial technology and investment-related digital products.
  • Support the design and implementation of surveys, questionnaires and other market research activities.
  • Analyse research findings and identify insights relevant to product, marketing and business planning.
  • Prepare market research reports, presentations and recommendations for internal stakeholders.
  • Work with product, marketing and business teams to support data-informed business decisions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Sociology, Market Research, or a related discipline.
  • Good research, analytical and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to collect, organise and interpret qualitative and quantitative information.
  • Good report-writing, presentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate research findings into clear and practical recommendations.
  • Relevant research, project, internship or work experience is an advantage.

title: Operations Executive (Market Research)
description:

Coordinate and manage market research projects to ensure timely, high-quality survey execution and data delivery. Collaborate with internal teams, clients, and vendors to optimize fieldwork operations and improve research processes.

title: Field Executive, Market Research Operations (6 or 12 months Contract)
description:
JOB SCOPE

We are seeking a dynamic and driven individual to join our team. The candidate may be a recent graduate, although 1–2 years of experience in market research would be advantageous.

The role entails two key fundamental areas:

Fieldwork Operations

-         Support in managing the fieldwork team that comprises of field supervisors and interviewers/ surveyors to ensure smooth operations on the ground.

-         Recruit, brief and train new surveyor/interviewer hires to ensure that they are knowledgeable about the project requirements and execute their tasks smoothly.

-         Assist in fieldwork planning by assigning surveyors to various projects or schedules.

-         Build strong rapport with the supervisors and interviewers.

-         Monitor fieldwork progress/quotas closely.

-         Conduct quality control checks on fieldwork as well as data to ensure accuracy and reliability.

-         Able to run fieldwork based on a diverse array of survey methodologies and sampling methods.

-         Escalate and address fieldwork issues in a timely manner.

Project Management

-         Ensure project plans and schedules, including timelines and milestones, are adhered to.

-         Support in establishing fieldwork plan,schedule, documentation, standard operating procedure (SOPs) and training materials.

-         Ensure compliance with processes and documentations (e.g. consent forms, acknowledgement forms, call logs/updates)for the projects.

-         Provide regular updates on the progress of projects to leadership and broader team.

-         Manage project within budgeted cost and time and the resources required (e.g. tablets and incentives) are ready for deployment.

-         Support the process of data cleaning and processing.

-         Work with cross-functional teams to ensure successful completion of research projects.

Job requirements and expectations

-         Minimum qualification of diploma. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field will be advantageous.  

-         Fresh graduates (polytechnics or university) are welcome to apply.

-         Strong attention to detail and being highly organised are important.

-         Able to perform and remain poise even in challenging situations.

-         Possesses great soft skills and personality -approachable, candid, go-getting and collaborative.

-         Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and fieldworkers.

-         Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

About us

Welcome to the Insights Table. We are a market research agency that see ourselves being able to do better for the industry. On our table, we are proud of our drive, conviction, and authenticity to deliver best-in-class insights and value to our clients. We strive to create a work environment that excites and motivates our people on the table. An environment where individuals can be excited about starting their day, with a purpose, every day.

This is a table where insights are uncovered, curiosity leads to answers, important agenda are discussed, and informed decisions are made. Above all, everyone on the table enjoys coming together.
